abstract: Clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) guides-biopsy and treatment decisions, yet its non-invasive diagnosis remains challenging. The incremental value of PSMA PET/CT beyond multiparametric MRI (mpMRI), and the optimal strategy for multimodal fusion, remain unclear. We established a real-world, multicentre benchmark using 527 patients from three hospitals with fully paired PSMA PET, CT, T2-weighted MRI, and diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), together with pathology-confirmed biopsy labels. Models were developed in one centre ( n = 363) and independently evaluated in two external centres ( n = 164). We compared frozen pretrained encoders, fine-tuned 2D and 3D CNN and Vision Transformer models, three fusion strategies, and an interpretable cross-modal Transformer. PSMA PET provided the greatest incremental value, with its removal producing the largest AUC reduction internally (−0.077) and externally (−0.055), supported by the highest attention attribution (αPET = 0.45). PSMA PET/CT also outperformed mpMRI externally (AUC 0.753 vs. 0.653). DWI was the principal source of domain shift, as its exclusion improved external AUC by 0.079 amid inter-centre b-value heterogeneity. Intermediate fusion performed most consistently internally, whereas late fusion and pretrained 2D models generalised better externally. This benchmark supports robust, non-invasive csPCa diagnosis by identifying modalities and fusion strategies that generalise reliably across institutions.
zh_abstract: 具有临床意义的前列腺癌（csPCa）指导活检和治疗决策，但其无创诊断仍具挑战性。PSMA PET/CT 相对于多参数 MRI（mpMRI）的增量价值，以及多模态融合的最佳策略，仍不明确。我们利用来自三家医院的 527 例患者建立了真实世界多中心基准，这些患者均具有完整配对的 PSMA PET、CT、T2 加权 MRI 和扩散加权成像（DWI），并有病理证实的活检标签。模型在一个中心开发（n = 363），并在两个外部中心独立评估（n = 164）。我们比较了冻结的预训练编码器、微调的 2D 和 3D CNN 及 Vision Transformer 模型、三种融合策略，以及一种可解释的跨模态 Transformer。PSMA PET 提供了最大的增量价值：去除该模态后，内部（−0.077）和外部（−0.055）AUC 下降幅度均最大，且其注意力归因最高（αPET = 0.45）。在外部验证中，PSMA PET/CT 的表现也优于 mpMRI（AUC 0.753 vs. 0.653）。DWI 是域偏移的主要来源，在各中心 b 值不一致的情况下，排除 DWI 使外部 AUC 提高了 0.079。中间融合在内部表现最为一致，而晚期融合和预训练 2D 模型在外部的泛化能力更好。该基准通过识别能够在不同机构间可靠泛化的模态和融合策略，支持稳健的 csPCa 无创诊断。

abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes may reduce documentation burden, but little is known about their adoption during enterprise-scale ambulatory rollout. We conducted a retrospective observational cohort study of 2901 ambulatory clinicians at an integrated academic health system using linked electronic health record and vendor usage data from December 2024 through May 2025. Clinician adoption was defined as any use during the study period, and monthly visit-level uptake as the proportion of eligible ambulatory visits in which the ambient AI scribe was used. Adoption and uptake varied substantially across practice settings, specialties, and clinician types. Clinician-level adoption was highest in community internal medicine (67%), community general pediatrics (69%), and academic neurology (53%), and lowest in academic general surgery (16%), obstetrics and gynecology (18%), and psychiatry (19%). Community attending physicians and advanced practice providers showed marked increases in median visit-level uptake, reaching approximately 80%-90% in some groups by May 2025. Distinct longitudinal patterns included slow and steady adoption, early use followed by discontinuation, transient use, and late adoption. These findings suggest that implementation support and evaluation strategies should be tailored to local practice context rather than applied uniformly across a health system.
zh_abstract: 环境式人工智能（AI）抄写员可能减轻文书记录负担，但对其在企业级门诊推广过程中的采用情况知之甚少。我们在一家综合性学术医疗系统中对 2901 名门诊临床医生开展了一项回顾性观察队列研究，使用 2024 年 12 月至 2025 年 5 月的关联电子健康记录和供应商使用数据。临床医生采用定义为研究期间有任何使用，月度就诊层面的使用率定义为使用环境式 AI 抄写员的符合条件门诊就诊所占比例。采用率和使用率在不同执业环境、专科和临床医生类型之间差异显著。临床医生层面的采用率在社区内科（67%）、社区普通儿科（69%）和学术神经科（53%）最高，在学术普通外科（16%）、妇产科（18%）和精神科（19%）最低。社区主治医师和高级实践提供者的就诊层面使用率中位数显著上升，到 2025 年 5 月部分群体达到约 80%–90%。纵向模式各不相同，包括缓慢稳步采用、早期使用后停用、短暂使用以及晚期采用。这些发现提示，实施支持和评估策略应根据当地执业环境量身定制，而不是在整个医疗系统中统一应用。

title: Visual-affective decoding enhances neurofunctional objective and generalizable signatures in unseen adolescent depression diagnosis

zh_title: 视觉-情感解码提升青少年抑郁症诊断的神经功能特征泛化性

reason: 新颖异常检测方法，有独立泛化测试，但样本仅200例、特异度偏低，属值得一看档
abstract: Adolescent major depressive disorder is a highly prevalent and debilitating condition, yet objective and generalizable neurofunctional signatures remain elusive. Existing neuroimaging approaches largely rely on resting-state fMRI, or controlled tasks often lack ecological validity and generalizable signatures of depression-related neural dysfunctions. This study proposes a Visual–Affective Decoding (VAD) framework integrating cross-subject visual and affective decoding from whole-brain fMRI acquired during naturalistic movie viewing. A dual-pathway anomaly detection model trained exclusively on healthy controls establishes normative brain function and identifies MDD through deviations from this norm. In 200 adolescents (112 MDD, 88 HC), VAD achieved an AUC of 0.87, 95.56% sensitivity, 83.89% accuracy, and 72.22% specificity. Using the same anomaly threshold, it generalized to an independent external adolescent cohort (70 MDD, 68 HC), achieving an AUC of 0.81 with an accuracy of 75.36%, supporting its cross-site generalizability. VAD further revealed interpretable neurofunctional signatures, including blunted emotional reactivity, attenuated visual representation, and affective patterns consistent with emotional rumination. Region-level contribution analyses identified dissociable visual- and affective-sensitive cortical regions, consistent with dysfunctions in visual, default-mode, salience, and higher-order associative networks. These findings demonstrate that VAD provides objective, interpretable, and generalizable neurofunctional signatures for adolescent depression diagnosis and clinically relevant biomarker development.
zh_abstract: 青少年重度抑郁症（MDD）高度流行且致残，但客观且可泛化的神经功能特征仍然缺乏。现有神经影像方法主要依赖静息态 fMRI，或受控任务，往往缺乏生态效度，也缺少可泛化的抑郁相关神经功能障碍特征。本研究提出一种视觉–情感解码（VAD）框架，对自然观影期间采集的全脑 fMRI 进行跨被试的视觉和情感解码。一个仅用健康对照训练的双通路异常检测模型建立正常脑功能基线，并通过偏离该基线来识别 MDD。在 200 名青少年（112 例 MDD，88 名健康对照）中，VAD 的 AUC 为 0.87，敏感度 95.56%，准确率 83.89%，特异度 72.22%。使用相同的异常阈值，该模型可泛化至独立的外部青少年队列（70 例 MDD，68 名健康对照），AUC 为 0.81，准确率 75.36%，支持其跨站点泛化能力。VAD 还揭示了可解释的神经功能特征，包括情绪反应迟钝、视觉表征减弱，以及与情绪反刍一致的情感模式。脑区层面的贡献分析识别出可分离的视觉敏感和情感敏感皮层区域，与视觉、默认模式、突显及高阶联合网络的功能障碍相一致。这些发现表明，VAD 为青少年抑郁症诊断及具有临床意义的生物标志物开发提供了客观、可解释且可泛化的神经功能特征。

title: Masked Position Modeling as a Pre-Training Strategy for Foundational Deformable Image Registration Models.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 掩码位置建模：可变形图像配准基础模型的预训练策略
summary: 提出MPM-Reg，一种模态无关的掩码位置建模预训练范式，使纯Transformer模型可用于可变形图像配准基础模型。
key_points: 针对DIR缺乏合适预训练方案的问题

reason: 新预训练方法，摘要信息有限，属值得一看档，基础模型方向小幅加分
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The core objective of deformable image registration (DIR), estimating a displacement vector field that aligns two images, is fundamentally the same across imaging modalities and anatomical regions. Although this shared objective should imply the use of foundation models, most deep learning approaches for DIR operate within narrow domain-specific settings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) are the predominant choice for foundation models in many image processing tasks due to their excellent generalization capabilities and robustness to domain shifts. However, their use remains largely underexplored for DIR, which we attribute to a lack of suitable pre-training schemes. To address this need, we introduce MPM-Reg, a transferable, modality-agnostic training paradigm based on masked position modeling (MPM), enabling the use of fully transformer-based models as foundation models for image registration. Unlike conventional masked data modeling, which predicts the content of masked image patches, MPM masks the positional information and predicts the spatial relationship between image patches. Initially, we employ MPM on single images, which naturally aligns self-supervised pre-training of ViTs with the downstream registration task. Subsequently, we extend MPM to predict the positions of target patches within source images, re-formulating DIR through the lens of MPM. Experiments across eleven diverse datasets demonstrate MPM-Reg's competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, MPM-Reg benefits from heterogeneous multi-domain data, which degrades the performance of existing methods, paving the way for scalable foundation models for DIR.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 可变形图像配准（deformable image registration，DIR）的核心目标是估计使两幅图像对齐的位移向量场，这一目标在不同成像模态和解剖区域之间本质上是相同的。尽管这一共同目标本应意味着可以使用基础模型，但大多数用于DIR的深度学习方法仍局限于狭窄的特定领域场景。视觉Transformer（Vision Transformers，ViTs）因其出色的泛化能力和对领域偏移的鲁棒性，是许多图像处理任务中基础模型的主要选择。然而，其在DIR中的应用在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索，我们将其归因于缺乏合适的预训练方案。为满足这一需求，我们提出了MPM-Reg，这是一种基于掩码位置建模（masked position modeling，MPM）的、可迁移且与模态无关的训练范式，使完全基于Transformer的模型能够作为图像配准的基础模型。与预测被掩码图像块内容的传统掩码数据建模不同，MPM对位置信息进行掩码，并预测图像块之间的空间关系。我们首先在单幅图像上应用MPM，使ViT的自监督预训练与下游配准任务自然契合。随后，我们将MPM扩展为预测目标图像块在源图像中的位置，从MPM的视角重新表述DIR。在11个不同数据集上的实验表明，MPM-Reg与最先进的基线方法相比具有竞争力。至关重要的是，MPM-Reg能够从异质的多领域数据中获益，而这类数据会降低现有方法的性能，这为可扩展的DIR基础模型铺平了道路。

title: GliaDose: An alternative approach for clinical CAR-T dose prediction via PBPK–glioblastoma-on-a-chip integration

summary: 提出GliaDose混合框架，将生理药代动力学（PBPK）模型与血管化胶质母细胞瘤芯片平台结合，用于CAR-T疗法的首次人体剂量定量预测。

abstract: Abstract Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive brain tumor with poor prognosis and limited treatment options. Chimeric antigen receptor T cell (CAR-T) therapy has emerged as a promising immunotherapy for GBM. However, unlike conventional drugs, CAR-T cells are living therapeutics that exhibit non-linear pharmacokinetics, expansion, and complex tissue trafficking, making conventional animal-to-human dose extrapolation unreliable. Furthermore, species-specific differences and the vasculature limit the translational relevance of preclinical models. To address these challenges, we developed GliaDose, a hybrid framework that integrates physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling with a vascularized glioblastoma-on-a-chip (GoC) platform to support quantitative first-in-human dose (FIHD) prediction for CAR-T therapy. The PBPK model was parameterized exclusively with human physiological data and incorporates a brain-tumor compartment to explicitly capture CAR-T transport across the vasculature. Complementarily, the GoC platform recapitulates key features of the GBM microenvironment, including three-dimensional tumor architecture, extracellular matrix, and perfusable human vascular networks, enabling assessment of CAR-T transmigration under flow conditions. Integration of GoC-derived efficacy data into the PBPK framework enabled quantitative dose–response predictions and identified vascular barriers as critical determinants of CAR-T tumor access. GliaDose provides a human-relevant, mechanistic alternative to animal-based dose selection and may improve FIHD prediction and personalized CAR-T therapy for GBM.
zh_abstract: 摘要 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种侵袭性很强的脑肿瘤，预后差，治疗选择有限。嵌合抗原受体 T 细胞（CAR-T）疗法已成为有前景的 GBM 免疫治疗方法。然而，与传统药物不同，CAR-T 细胞是活的治疗制剂，表现出非线性药代动力学、扩增以及复杂的组织转运，使得传统的动物到人剂量外推不可靠。此外，物种特异性差异和脉管系统限制了临床前模型的转化相关性。为应对这些挑战，我们开发了 GliaDose，这是一种混合框架，将基于生理的药代动力学（PBPK）建模与血管化胶质母细胞瘤芯片（GoC）平台相结合，以支持 CAR-T 疗法的首次人体剂量（FIHD）定量预测。该 PBPK 模型仅使用人体生理数据进行参数化，并纳入脑–肿瘤隔室以明确刻画 CAR-T 跨血管的转运。与之互补，GoC 平台再现了 GBM 微环境的关键特征，包括三维肿瘤结构、细胞外基质和可灌注的人血管网络，从而能够在流动条件下评估 CAR-T 的跨内皮迁移。将 GoC 得到的疗效数据整合入 PBPK 框架，实现了定量的剂量–反应预测，并确定血管屏障是 CAR-T 到达肿瘤的关键决定因素。GliaDose 为基于动物的剂量选择提供了一种与人体相关、基于机制的替代方案，并可能改进 GBM 的 FIHD 预测和个体化 CAR-T 治疗。

abstract: [Journal of pain and symptom management] This article describes integration of a large language model (LLM) into the electronic health record (EHR) to identify unstructured goals-of-care (GOC) documentation or discrete data entry. To determine whether a prompt-engineered LLM reliably detects GOC documentation in clinical notes comparable to human experts and can display this evaluation to clinicians in real time. An interdisciplinary team of palliative care experts created an adjudicated reference standard, which was used to evaluate LLM models in detecting GOC documentation. Given this, the best-fit model (GPT-4o) was then integrated with the EHR for a six-month pilot at four hospitals, then released enterprise-wide. GPT-4o achieved the best performance (specificity 0.95, recall 0.74, precision 0.78). Manual audit on AI-flagged notes (n=325) confirmed substantial expert agreement (86%). In subgroup analyses, there was no statistically significant differences across race, sex, or age (specificity range 0.91-1; all p-values > 0.05). At enterprise scale, the model identified 37,000 patients with GOC documentation within approximately two months. In comparison to those without, patients with AI-flagged GOC documentation had higher acuity rates (ICU stay ≥5 days: 30.2% vs 8.2%; in-hospital mortality: 14.9% vs 0.6%; hospice discharge: 10.5% vs 0.4%). Code status changes were also significantly more frequent (29.3% vs 9.9%; p<0.05). Our initiative met the original objectives by providing a financially sustainable EHR optimization that converts unstructured, high-value GOC narratives into real-time discoverable and trackable documentation. Detecting and displaying these conversations is crucial, increasing clinical situational awareness while reducing documentation burden, leading to enhanced goal-concordant care.
zh_abstract: [疼痛与症状管理杂志] 本文介绍了将大语言模型（LLM）整合到电子健康记录（EHR）中，以识别非结构化的照护目标（GOC）文档或离散数据录入。目的是确定经提示工程优化的LLM能否可靠地检测临床记录中的GOC文档，其表现是否可与人类专家相当，并能否将该评估结果实时显示给临床医生。一个由姑息治疗专家组成的跨学科团队建立了经裁定的参考标准，用于评估LLM模型检测GOC文档的能力。据此，最佳拟合模型（GPT-4o）随后与EHR整合，在四家医院进行了为期六个月的试点，之后在全企业范围内推广。GPT-4o取得了最佳性能（特异度0.95，召回率0.74，精确率0.78）。对AI标记记录（n=325）的人工审核证实专家一致性较高（86%）。在亚组分析中，不同种族、性别或年龄之间无统计学显著差异（特异度范围0.91-1；所有P值>0.05）。在全企业规模下，该模型在约两个月内识别出37,000名有GOC文档的患者。与没有GOC文档的患者相比，被AI标记有GOC文档的患者病情危重程度更高（ICU住院≥5天：30.2%对8.2%；院内死亡率：14.9%对0.6%；转入临终关怀出院：10.5%对0.4%）。复苏状态（code status）变更也显著更频繁（29.3%对9.9%；p<0.05）。我们的举措实现了最初的目标，提供了一种经济上可持续的EHR优化方案，可将非结构化的高价值GOC叙述转化为可实时发现和追踪的文档。检测并显示这些沟通内容至关重要，可提高临床情境感知，同时减轻文档负担，从而促进符合照护目标的医疗。

abstract: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters. Current artificial intelligence (AI) solutions remain limited, typically operating as opaque "black boxes" or focusing on narrow tasks that fail to capture the holistic, guideline-driven reasoning of a clinician. Here we introduce EchoChat, a generative multimodal vision-language model that performs comprehensive echocardiographic analysis to support clinician interpretation. By emulating the cognitive workflow of a cardiologist, EchoChat integrates vast medical knowledge with a chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to explicitly ground its conclusions in visual evidence. Trained on echocardiography-instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations, our model establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse cohorts from six international medical centers. It supports the broadest diagnostic scope of 33 cardiac conditions and findings, including 15 newly added conditions for which it achieves an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations. It surpasses existing best-performing foundation models in cardiac condition recognition (improving average recall by 13.54% on shared tasks) and quantification (average R2 score increase of 0.275 on shared tasks). Furthermore, in a source-blinded echocardiographer reader study, echocardiography reports co-generated with EchoChat were rated higher in diagnostic accuracy and completeness by two senior echocardiographers, and improved diagnostic performance from 72.78% to 82.75% in terms of F1 score over routine-reader only reports. These results demonstrate that integrating clinical reasoning into multimodal AI can democratize specialist expertise and transform the standard of cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: 超声心动图是心血管诊断的基石，但经验丰富的判读者严重短缺限制了其在全球的应用。目前的人工智能（AI）方案仍然有限，通常作为不透明的“黑箱”运行，或专注于狭窄的任务，无法体现临床医生整体性、以指南为导向的推理。在此，我们介绍 EchoChat，一种生成式多模态视觉-语言模型，可进行全面的超声心动图分析以辅助临床医生判读。通过模拟心脏科医生的认知工作流程，EchoChat 将海量医学知识与思维链推理机制相结合，使其结论明确基于视觉证据。该模型在来自 46,358 次检查的超声心动图-指令配对数据上训练，在来自六个国际医疗中心的多样化队列中确立了新的最先进水平。它支持最广的诊断范围，涵盖 33 种心脏疾病和表现，其中包括 15 种新增疾病，在可用的外部评估中对这些新增疾病的平均 F1 为 73.7%。在心脏疾病识别（共有任务上平均召回率提高 13.54%）和定量分析（共有任务上平均 R2 得分提高 0.275）方面，它超过了现有表现最佳的基础模型。此外，在对来源设盲的超声心动图医师读片研究中，两位资深超声心动图医师认为由 EchoChat 协同生成的超声心动图报告在诊断准确性和完整性方面评分更高，并且相较于仅由常规读片者出具的报告，F1 得分所反映的诊断性能从 72.78% 提高到 82.75%。这些结果表明，将临床推理融入多模态 AI 可使专科专业知识更加普及，并提升心血管诊疗的标准。

abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder and anxiety disorders are highly prevalent in youth and frequently co-occur, yet substantial within- and cross-disorder heterogeneity limits neurobiological specificity and complicates treatment selection. Here we conducted an observational cohort analysis and developed a deep learning framework that integrates clinically salient functional connectivity with cognitive and behavioral measures to identify interpretable transdiagnostic dimensions and biologically grounded biotypes. In 3,508 children aged 9–11 years from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study, the model revealed two reproducible brain–behavior dimensions reflecting cognitive control and emotion–attention regulation. These dimensions yielded three biotypes (externalizing–disinhibited, internalizing–distressed and mixed dysregulation) with distinct symptom profiles, network organization and brain development. They generalized to 224 age-matched Healthy Brain Network participants and were detectable before symptom onset, indicating preclinical expression. These findings support brain–behavior dimensions for parsing transdiagnostic heterogeneity and motivating early risk stratification and mechanism-informed intervention in youth mental health.
zh_abstract: 注意缺陷/多动障碍和焦虑障碍在青少年中高度流行且常常共病，但障碍内部及障碍之间存在显著异质性，限制了神经生物学特异性，也使治疗选择变得复杂。在此，我们开展了一项观察性队列分析，并开发了一个深度学习框架，该框架将具有临床显著性的功能连接与认知和行为测量相整合，以识别可解释的跨诊断维度和具有生物学基础的生物型。在青少年大脑认知发育（Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development）研究中 3,508 名 9–11 岁儿童中，该模型揭示了两个可重复的脑–行为维度，分别反映认知控制和情绪–注意调节。这两个维度产生了三种生物型（外化–去抑制型、内化–痛苦型和混合失调型），它们具有不同的症状特征、网络组织和大脑发育情况。这些生物型可推广至 224 名年龄匹配的健康大脑网络（Healthy Brain Network）参与者，并且在症状出现之前即可检测到，提示其临床前表达。这些发现支持利用脑–行为维度解析跨诊断异质性，并为青少年心理健康的早期风险分层和基于机制的干预提供依据。

abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] Rapid advancements in technology have led to an increased use of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in medicine and bioinformatics research. In anticipation of this, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) assembled the Bridge to Artificial Intelligence (Bridge2AI) consortium to coordinate development of "AI-ready" datasets that can be leveraged by AI models to address grand challenges in human health and disease. The widespread availability of genome sequencing technologies for biomedical research presents a key data type for informing AI models, necessitating that genomics data sets are "AI-ready." To this end, the Genomic Information Standards Team (GIST) of the Bridge2AI Standards Working Group has documented a set of recommendations for maintaining AI-ready genomics datasets. In this report, we describe recommendations for the collection, storage, identification, and proper use of genomics datasets to enable them to be considered "AI-ready" and thus drive new insights in medicine through AI and machine learning applications.
zh_abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] 技术的快速进步使人工智能（AI）技术在医学和生物信息学研究中的应用日益增多。为应对这一趋势，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）成立了“通往人工智能之桥”（Bridge2AI）联盟，协调开发“AI就绪”数据集，使AI模型能够利用这些数据集应对人类健康与疾病领域的重大挑战。基因组测序技术在生物医学研究中的广泛应用提供了一类可为AI模型提供信息的关键数据，因此基因组学数据集必须“AI就绪”。为此，Bridge2AI标准工作组的基因组信息标准团队（GIST）记录了一套维护AI就绪基因组学数据集的建议。在本报告中，我们描述了有关基因组学数据集的收集、存储、识别和正确使用的建议，使其能够被视为“AI就绪”，从而通过AI和机器学习应用推动医学领域的新见解。

title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
zh_title: ClinVerse：用于训练与评估医疗智能体的真实多智能体诊断环境
summary: 基于15万例真实电子病历诊断病例构建的交互式多智能体环境，支持六种临床角色协作，用于训练和评估诊断智能体。

abstract: Disease diagnosis is a key application of large language model (LLM) agents in healthcare. However, existing medical agents are primarily trained and evaluated with static question-answering data, providing limited opportunities to learn active information acquisition, examination decision-making, and dynamic clinical interaction. To address this limitation, we present ClinVerse, an interactive, real-data-grounded multi-agent environment designed for training and evaluating medical diagnostic agents. Built on ClinPatient, a scalable dataset comprising 150k diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records, ClinVerse supports coordinated interactions among six specialized clinical roles. Specifically, a doctor agent starts from an initial patient complaint, progressively gathers clinical evidence through patient interviews and examination requests, and ultimately produces a diagnosis. For each interaction trajectory, a rule-based scoring framework quantifies information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy. These trajectory-level scores serve as reward signals for agent training while also enabling scalable evaluation. In experiments, we evaluate various general-purpose and medical-domain models and show that nine self-evolution methods across three categories consistently improve agents' diagnostic capabilities within ClinVerse. We further analyze the interplay among model capability, environment feedback, and self-evolution methods.
zh_abstract: 疾病诊断是大语言模型（LLM）智能体在医疗领域的一项关键应用。然而，现有的医疗智能体主要使用静态问答数据进行训练和评估，在学习主动获取信息、检查决策和动态临床交互方面的机会有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出了ClinVerse，这是一个以真实数据为基础、用于训练和评估医疗诊断智能体的交互式多智能体环境。ClinVerse建立在ClinPatient之上，后者是一个可扩展的数据集，包含源自真实世界电子健康记录的15万例诊断病例；ClinVerse支持六种专业临床角色之间的协同交互。具体而言，医生智能体从患者的初始主诉出发，通过问诊和检查申请逐步收集临床证据，并最终给出诊断。对于每条交互轨迹，基于规则的评分框架对信息获取、检查开具和诊断准确性进行量化。这些轨迹级评分既可作为智能体训练的奖励信号，也可用于可扩展的评估。在实验中，我们评估了多种通用模型和医学领域模型，结果表明，三类共九种自我进化方法在ClinVerse中均能持续提升智能体的诊断能力。我们还进一步分析了模型能力、环境反馈与自我进化方法之间的相互作用。

abstract: [Genomics, proteomics & bioinformatics] Messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccines offer promising therapeutic potential for combating various diseases, yet their inherent chemical instability hampers long-term efficacy. Although several methods have been developed to predict mRNA degradation, they often suffer from limited accuracy and lack the capability for rational codon optimization. Here, we propose RNASTOP, a novel framework that integrates deep learning with heuristic search to simultaneously predict and optimize mRNA chemical stability. RNASTOP achieves a 13% improvement in accuracy over the top-performing model on the Stanford OpenVaccine competition dataset and demonstrates robust generalization in predicting full-length mRNA degradation. When applied to mRNA codon optimization, RNASTOP reduces the minimum free energy of the varicella-zoster virus vaccine sequence by 75.73% while maintaining high translation efficiency. Overall, RNASTOP serves as a powerful tool for predicting and optimizing mRNA chemical stability, accelerating the development of mRNA therapeutics. The source code of RNASTOP is available at https://github.com/xlab-BioAI/RNASTOP.
zh_abstract: [基因组学、蛋白质组学与生物信息学] 信使RNA（mRNA）疫苗在对抗多种疾病方面具有广阔的治疗前景，但其固有的化学不稳定性限制了长期疗效。尽管已有多种方法用于预测mRNA降解，但这些方法往往准确性有限，且缺乏进行合理密码子优化的能力。在此，我们提出RNASTOP，这是一种将深度学习与启发式搜索相结合的新型框架，可同时预测并优化mRNA的化学稳定性。在斯坦福OpenVaccine竞赛数据集上，RNASTOP的准确率较表现最佳的模型提高了13%，并在预测全长mRNA降解方面表现出稳健的泛化能力。应用于mRNA密码子优化时，RNASTOP使水痘-带状疱疹病毒疫苗序列的最小自由能降低了75.73%，同时保持了较高的翻译效率。总体而言，RNASTOP是预测和优化mRNA化学稳定性的有力工具，可加速mRNA治疗药物的研发。RNASTOP的源代码可在 https://github.com/xlab-BioAI/RNASTOP 获取。

abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] The rapid growth of genomic and metagenomic data has created a large gap between protein sequence discovery and enzyme functional characterization. Deep learning has become an important tool for enzyme-related prediction tasks, including EC and GO annotation, substrate specificity, catalytic-residue identification, kinetic-parameter estimation, thermostability, pH optima, and candidate discovery. This review summarizes recent progress with an emphasis on benchmark design rather than reported scores alone. We compare representative methods by input modality, training data, split strategy, leakage control, evaluation metric, and validation evidence. Across tasks, apparent performance gains can arise from dataset scale, annotation quality, homolog overlap, negative sampling, or endpoint definition rather than architecture alone. Current models are valuable for annotation and candidate prioritization, but robust discovery of remote homologs, rare functions, or new catalytic activities still requires low-identity or out-of-distribution evaluation and experimental validation.
zh_abstract: [ACS Synthetic Biology] 基因组和宏基因组数据的快速增长，造成了蛋白质序列发现与酶功能表征之间的巨大差距。深度学习已成为酶相关预测任务的重要工具，这些任务包括 EC 和 GO 注释、底物特异性、催化残基识别、动力学参数估计、热稳定性、最适 pH 以及候选酶发现。本综述总结了近期进展，重点关注基准设计而非仅仅报告的分数。我们按输入模态、训练数据、数据划分策略、泄漏控制、评估指标和验证证据对代表性方法进行了比较。在各项任务中，表观性能的提升可能源于数据集规模、注释质量、同源序列重叠、负样本采样或终点定义，而不仅仅是模型架构。目前的模型对于注释和候选酶优先排序具有价值，但要稳健地发现远缘同源物、稀有功能或新的催化活性，仍需要低序列一致性或分布外评估以及实验验证。

title: The Patient Is Always Right? Evaluating Sycophancy in Medical Diagnosis with Graded Patient Beliefs

abstract: More people are seeking out general-purpose AI models for medical advice, including diagnosis. Yet, AI models are susceptible to sycophancy, like validating users' beliefs even when they are untrue, which could lead to false positive diagnoses. Here, we evaluate how nine AI models change their diagnostic decision when a patient presents a belief that they have a specific (but incorrect) medical condition. We vary how close the user belief is to the clinical evidence presented. Models sycophantically adopt the patient's belief on average 23.2\% of the time---sometimes even when the patient proposes a fictional, made-up condition. We also varied different personas, including a Rare Disease Claimer that got models to accept their belief 43.0\% of the time. Additional analyses find that medical fine-tuning and model scale makes models less susceptible to changing their diagnoses. Sycophantic bias in medical diagnosis raises implications for safety, especially as more people are using AI for health support.
zh_abstract: 越来越多的人向通用AI模型寻求医疗建议，包括诊断。然而，AI模型容易出现谄媚行为，例如即使用户的信念并不正确也予以认同，这可能导致假阳性诊断。在此，我们评估了九个AI模型在患者提出自己患有某种特定（但不正确）疾病的信念时，其诊断决策如何改变。我们改变了用户信念与所呈现临床证据的接近程度。模型平均有23.2%的情况下会谄媚地采纳患者的信念——有时甚至在患者提出的是虚构、杜撰的疾病时也是如此。我们还改变了不同的人设，其中“罕见病声称者”使模型接受其信念的比例达43.0%。进一步分析发现，医学微调和模型规模的增大会使模型更不易改变其诊断。医学诊断中的谄媚偏差对安全性具有重要影响，尤其是在越来越多的人使用AI获取健康支持的情况下。

title: Exhaustive white blood cell extraction and profiling across whole-slide images of blood and bone marrow smears
zh_title: HemAutomaton：全玻片血液与骨髓涂片白细胞全面提取
summary: 预印本提出基于神经元胞自动机的 HemAutomaton 框架，无需手动选区即可在全玻片图像中提取白细胞，在三个血液肿瘤队列中提取超过 1 亿个单细胞图像。

abstract: Blood and bone marrow smears are central to diagnosing hematological disorders. While whole-slide scanning enables automated single-cell profiling at scale, the computational burden of gigapixel images has confined automated analysis to manually pre-selected regions of interest. Here, we present HemAutomaton, a framework built on neural cellular automata that extracts white blood cells across entire whole-slide images without manual region selection and with minimal annotation requirements. HemAutomaton matches the in-domain detection accuracy of Faster R-CNN while surpassing it under domain shifts, operating at a fraction of the computational cost and with over 10,000-fold fewer parameters. Across three blood cancer cohorts, we extract over 100 million single-cell images and achieve annotation-efficient differential counting via few-shot classification using a pretrained hematology foundation model. Slide-wide spatial analysis uncovers consistent blast-frequency gradients across smears and demonstrates that automated blast counts match expert evaluations within inter-expert variability. Scaling automated profiling from hundreds to tens of thousands of cells per smear overcomes conventional sampling limits and establishes the foundation for more sensitive AI supported hematological assessments.
zh_abstract: 血涂片和骨髓涂片是诊断血液系统疾病的核心手段。尽管全玻片扫描使大规模自动化单细胞分析成为可能，但十亿像素级图像的计算负担使自动化分析一直局限于人工预先选定的感兴趣区域。在此，我们提出HemAutomaton，一个基于神经元胞自动机（neural cellular automata）的框架，可在无需人工选择区域且标注需求极少的情况下，从整张全玻片图像中提取白细胞。HemAutomaton在域内检测准确率上与Faster R-CNN相当，而在域偏移下则优于后者，其计算成本仅为其一小部分，参数量少10,000倍以上。在三个血液肿瘤队列中，我们提取了逾1亿张单细胞图像，并利用预训练的血液学基础模型通过少样本分类实现了标注高效的分类计数。全玻片范围的空间分析揭示了涂片间一致的原始细胞比例梯度，并表明自动化原始细胞计数与专家评估相符，且在专家间变异范围之内。将自动化分析规模从每张涂片数百个细胞扩展到数万个细胞，突破了传统的取样限制，为更敏感的人工智能辅助血液学评估奠定了基础。

abstract: [Der Nervenarzt] Early detection of psychotic disorders is complicated by nonspecific symptoms, heterogeneous trajectories and the limited ability of established clinical instruments to generate accurate individual-level predictions. Data-driven artificial intelligence can integrate complex clinical and biological data and achieves moderate to good predictive performance, which often declines on external validation. Despite substantial methodological advances, a marked translational gap between model development and clinical application persists, mainly due to limited generalizability as well as practical, ethical and regulatory requirements. Artificial intelligence can complement clinical expertise and facilitate access to appropriate psychiatric care provided that it is implemented transparently and close to real-world care, subject to health economic evaluation and developed with the active involvement of experts by experience.
zh_abstract: [Der Nervenarzt] 精神病性障碍的早期识别受到症状不特异、病程轨迹异质以及现有临床工具生成准确个体水平预测的能力有限等因素的制约。数据驱动的人工智能可以整合复杂的临床和生物学数据，并取得中等至良好的预测性能，但在外部验证中性能往往下降。尽管方法学上取得了显著进展，模型开发与临床应用之间仍存在明显的转化差距，主要原因是泛化能力有限，以及实际应用、伦理和监管方面的要求。如果人工智能的实施做到透明并贴近真实世界的诊疗、接受卫生经济学评价，并在有亲身经历的专家（experts by experience）积极参与下开发，则可以补充临床专业知识，并促进获得适当的精神科诊疗。

title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
zh_title: PathKGen：知识图谱辅助多模态大模型实现可解释组织病理报告生成
summary: 提出PathKGen，将知识图谱外部结构化知识注入MLLM，用于WSI病理报告生成，并使推理过程可见。
key_points: 以知识图谱外化医学知识，弥补参数知识局限
使中间推理对人类可解释
面向病理报告生成这一探索不足的方向
reason: 病理MLLM新方法，贴合偏好，但摘要无外部验证
abstract: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.

title: Meta-CLIP: Metadata-Conditioned Contrastive Learning for Zero-Shot Disease Inference
zh_title: Meta-CLIP：用DICOM元数据条件对比学习实现零样本疾病推断
summary: 提出利用DICOM采集元数据核函数重加权跨模态负样本的医学视觉-语言预训练框架，推理时无需元数据，并在胸片等任务评估。
key_points: 核函数基于DICOM数值与类别字段定义间隔
提升采集条件相似负样本的权重
推理沿用标准双编码器，无需元数据
reason: 医学VLM预训练新方法，有新意但为预印本，证据有限
abstract: Medical vision--language pretraining learns transferable representations from paired images and radiology reports, yet differences in scanners and acquisition protocols can impair transfer. Existing approaches primarily enrich clinical semantics, leaving structured acquisition information in DICOM headers underused. We introduce Meta-CLIP, a metadata-conditioned contrastive framework that uses acquisition similarity to reweight cross-modal negatives during pretraining. A kernel over numerical and categorical DICOM fields defines a bounded pairwise margin. This margin increases the contribution of acquisition-similar negatives, emphasizing distinctions among studies that share imaging conditions. The kernel remains fixed during image--text optimization, and inference follows the standard dual-encoder architecture without requiring metadata. We evaluate Meta-CLIP on chest radiography and volumetric chest CT through zero-shot classification, appearance perturbations, grounding, and representation analyses. On CT-RATE, Meta-CLIP improves macro-AUROC over CT-CLIP by 1.41 points, with a 95\% paired bootstrap confidence interval of 0.96--1.85 points. It also achieves the highest macro-AUROC on four of five CXR benchmarks. An exploratory BrgSA evaluation extends the analysis to another CT backbone. These findings support acquisition metadata as a practical training-time prior for medical vision--language learning. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言预训练可从配对的图像和放射学报告中学习可迁移的表征，但扫描仪和采集方案的差异可能损害迁移效果。现有方法主要侧重丰富临床语义，而DICOM头文件中的结构化采集信息未得到充分利用。我们提出Meta-CLIP，这是一种以元数据为条件的对比学习框架，在预训练期间利用采集相似性对跨模态负样本重新加权。基于数值型和类别型DICOM字段构建的核函数定义了一个有界的成对间隔（margin）。该间隔增加了采集相似的负样本的贡献，从而强调共享成像条件的检查之间的差异。在图像-文本优化过程中，该核函数保持固定；推理时遵循标准的双编码器架构，无需元数据。我们通过零样本分类、外观扰动、定位（grounding）和表征分析，在胸部X线摄影和容积胸部CT上评估Meta-CLIP。在CT-RATE上，Meta-CLIP的宏平均AUROC比CT-CLIP高1.41个百分点，配对bootstrap 95%置信区间为0.96–1.85个百分点。在五个CXR基准中的四个上，其宏平均AUROC也最高。一项探索性的BrgSA评估将分析扩展到另一种CT骨干网络。这些结果支持将采集元数据作为医学视觉-语言学习中一种实用的训练阶段先验。论文发表后将公开代码。

title: Learning When to Collaborate: Selective Multi-Agent Medical Reasoning via Uncertainty-Aware Routing
zh_title: 学习何时协作：基于不确定性路由的选择性多智能体医学推理
summary: 提出完全本地运行的多智能体方法SMART-Med，以不确定性路由决定直接作答或召集少数专家智能体协作，面向多模态医学推理（预印本）。
key_points: 挑战始终密集协作与依赖云端大模型的假设
不确定性驱动路由决定是否协作
本地部署以兼顾隐私与效率
reason: 医疗多智能体新方法，摘要未见具体结果；命中偏好
abstract: Multi-agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for multimodal medical reasoning, but existing methods rely on two assumptions that hinder practical deployment: (i) always-active dense collaboration among multiple agents, and (ii) dependence on large cloud-based models that raise privacy and efficiency concerns. In this paper, we challenge both assumptions and propose SMART-Med, a fully local multi-agent method that treats collaboration as a learnable decision rather than a default behavior. Our key insight is that not every medical query requires costly multi-agent deliberation: many can be reliably solved by a single well-trained agent, while only uncertain cases benefit from expert collaboration. Based on this insight, SMART-Med introduces an uncertainty-driven routing mechanism that adaptively decides when to answer directly and when to recruit a small subset of expert agents, effectively converting dense multi-agent reasoning into selective, query-adaptive coordination. To make this routing reliable, we curate a new multimodal medical dataset MedVR-3K with high-quality reasoning traces and a difficulty hierarchy, and then fine-tune local agents using GRPO with two complementary rewards: a certainty-aware accuracy reward and a vision-language reward model for correctness and reasoning quality respectively. Experiments on four medical visual question answering benchmarks show that SMART-Med achieves competitive performance compared to existing MAS approaches while substantially reducing inference cost (reducing inference time by more than 3.8x and token usage by 72%). Moreover, after fine-tuning on MedVR-3K, SMART-Med yields an average improvement of 6.7% across Slake, PathVQA, VQA-RAD, and PMC-VQA.
zh_abstract: 多智能体系统已成为多模态医学推理中一种很有前景的范式，但现有方法依赖两个阻碍实际部署的假设：（i）多个智能体始终处于激活状态的密集协作；（ii）依赖会引发隐私和效率问题的大型云端模型。本文对这两个假设提出挑战，并提出 SMART-Med，一种完全本地化的多智能体方法，将协作视为可学习的决策，而非默认行为。我们的核心见解是：并非每个医学问题都需要代价高昂的多智能体讨论——许多问题可由一个训练良好的单一智能体可靠解决，只有不确定的病例才会从专家协作中获益。基于这一见解，SMART-Med 引入了一种由不确定性驱动的路由机制，自适应地决定何时直接作答、何时召集一小部分专家智能体，从而有效地将密集的多智能体推理转变为选择性的、随查询自适应的协调。为使该路由可靠，我们构建了一个新的多模态医学数据集 MedVR-3K，其包含高质量的推理轨迹和难度层级，随后使用 GRPO 对本地智能体进行微调，并采用两种互补的奖励：分别用于衡量正确性的、考虑确定性的准确率奖励，以及用于衡量推理质量的视觉-语言奖励模型。在四个医学视觉问答基准上的实验表明，与现有多智能体系统方法相比，SMART-Med 取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时大幅降低了推理成本（推理时间减少 3.8 倍以上，token 使用量减少 72%）。此外，在 MedVR-3K 上微调后，SMART-Med 在 Slake、PathVQA、VQA-RAD 和 PMC-VQA 上平均提升 6.7%。

title: Auditing evaluation artifacts and data leakage in large language model systems for rare disease diagnosis
zh_title: 罕见病诊断LLM系统的评测伪影与数据泄露审计
summary: 基于6万余例公开及独立临床队列，审计增强型LLM罕见病诊断评测，发现候选空间污染会虚高性能，严格跨数据集隔离后表现明显下降。
key_points: 使用超6万例公开与独立临床队列
复现最先进的智能体框架进行审计
跨数据集隔离后平均Recall@1由54.3%下降
reason: 大规模审计揭示评测泄露，证据标准意义明确；预印本，居中档
abstract: Augmented large language model (LLM) systems have reported high benchmark accuracies in rare disease diagnosis, yet their real-world clinical utility remains unproven. A recent meta-analysis flagged augmented LLM diagnostic evaluations as having a high risk of bias due to suspected data leakage; however, the precise impact of these vulnerabilities on model inference has yet to be fully quantified. In this study, we present a comprehensive empirical audit to quantify evaluation artifacts across prevailing AI paradigms, using a repository of over 60,000 cases from diverse public and independent clinical cohorts. By reconstructing a state-of-the-art agentic framework, we demonstrate that candidate-space contamination artificially inflates performance: enforcing strict cross-dataset isolation resulted in a marked performance decline, with the cross-dataset mean Recall@1 decreasing from 54.3% (under conventional one-vs-rest evaluation) to 40.3% (Hedges' g = 0.94). Similar spatial overfitting in supervised classifiers caused diagnostic accuracy to drop from an internal mean of 42.9% to 16.7% across external cohorts (Cohen's d = 2.01). Furthermore, we quantify how LLMs infer diagnoses by exploiting retrospective therapeutic cues in clinical narratives, and how temporal misalignment in foundational knowledge bases leads to performance fluctuations. We conclude that prevailing evaluation protocols for augmented LLM systems inadvertently reflect data leakage rather than genuine medical reasoning. To address these systematic artifacts, we propose a rigorous evaluation framework - coupling strict data-isolation protocols with standardized benchmarking safeguards - to ensure future diagnostic AI for rare diseases is evaluated on actual clinical robustness.
zh_abstract: 增强型大语言模型（LLM）系统在罕见病诊断基准测试中报告了较高的准确率，但其真实临床实用性尚未得到证实。一项近期的荟萃分析指出，增强型LLM诊断评估因疑似数据泄露而存在较高的偏倚风险；然而，这些漏洞对模型推理的确切影响尚未得到充分量化。在本研究中，我们开展了一项全面的实证审计，利用来自多种公共及独立临床队列的6万余例病例库，对当前主流人工智能范式中的评估伪影进行量化。通过重建一个最先进的智能体（agentic）框架，我们证明候选空间污染会人为抬高性能：实施严格的跨数据集隔离后，性能显著下降，跨数据集平均Recall@1由54.3%（常规one-vs-rest评估下）降至40.3%（Hedges' g = 0.94）。监督分类器中类似的空间过拟合导致诊断准确率由内部平均42.9%降至外部队列的16.7%（Cohen's d = 2.01）。此外，我们量化了LLM如何通过利用临床叙述中的回顾性治疗线索来推断诊断，以及基础知识库中的时间错位如何导致性能波动。我们的结论是，当前增强型LLM系统的主流评估方案在不经意间反映的是数据泄露，而非真正的医学推理。为解决这些系统性伪影，我们提出了一个严格的评估框架——将严格的数据隔离方案与标准化的基准测试保障措施相结合——以确保未来的罕见病诊断人工智能是依据其实际临床稳健性来评估的。

title: U-NeXt: General-purpose event detection for neonatal EEG
zh_title: U-NeXt：新生儿脑电通用事件检测
summary: 基于语义分割的新生儿EEG事件检测框架，在超11,000小时数据训练，并在Helsinki与Cork两个独立发作数据集上评估（预印本）。
key_points: 覆盖低电压、伪迹、发作三类事件
三名专家标注的130名新生儿独立测试
各事件类型检测均优于ConvNeXt基线
reason: 大规模数据并有独立外部测试集，但为预印本
abstract: We developed U-NeXt, a general framework for neonatal electroencephalography (EEG) event detection based on semantic segmentation. Its convolutional encoder-decoder directly segments individual channels using long input segments to preserve temporal context. A shared architecture and training framework were developed using low-voltage interval, artefact, and seizure datasets containing 51, 98, and 278 neonates, respectively, comprising over 11,000 hours of EEG and 82,000 annotated events. Performance was compared with task-specific ConvNeXt classifiers. For seizure detection, we also evaluated U-NeXt+, trained on an expanded dataset. Both U-NeXt variants and the ConvNeXt baseline were evaluated on two independent held-out seizure datasets, Helsinki and Cork, comprising 130 neonates, with recordings annotated by three experts. U-NeXt improved detection across all three event types, with particular gains in sensitivity for short events. U-NeXt+ achieved Matthews correlation coefficients of 0.862 and 0.891 on Helsinki and Cork, respectively, and improved hourly seizure burden correlations by 30-40% relative to ConvNeXt. U-NeXt+ met the criterion for expert-level performance on both datasets (p < 0.001). In separate computational benchmarks, U-NeXt reduced batch inference time relative to ConvNeXt by 254-fold on a central processing unit and 200-fold on a graphics processing unit. A common segmentation framework improves detection across diverse neonatal EEG event types while substantially reducing inference time. Accurate seizure burden estimates and performance comparable to expert reviewers support its potential use in continuous monitoring and clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了 U-NeXt，一个基于语义分割的新生儿脑电图（EEG）事件检测通用框架。其卷积编码器-解码器使用较长的输入片段直接对单个通道进行分割，以保留时间上下文。我们利用分别包含 51、98 和 278 名新生儿的低电压间期、伪迹和癫痫发作数据集，开发了共享的架构和训练框架，这些数据集共包含超过 11,000 小时的 EEG 和 82,000 个已标注事件。我们将其性能与针对特定任务的 ConvNeXt 分类器进行了比较。对于癫痫发作检测，我们还评估了在扩充数据集上训练的 U-NeXt+。两种 U-NeXt 变体和 ConvNeXt 基线均在两个独立的留出癫痫发作数据集（Helsinki 和 Cork，共 130 名新生儿，记录由三位专家标注）上进行了评估。U-NeXt 提高了全部三类事件的检测效果，对短时事件的敏感性提升尤为明显。U-NeXt+ 在 Helsinki 和 Cork 上的 Matthews 相关系数分别为 0.862 和 0.891，与 ConvNeXt 相比，每小时癫痫发作负荷的相关性提高了 30–40%。U-NeXt+ 在两个数据集上均达到专家水平性能的标准（p < 0.001）。在单独的计算基准测试中，与 ConvNeXt 相比，U-NeXt 在中央处理器上将批量推理时间缩短了 254 倍，在图形处理器上缩短了 200 倍。统一的分割框架在显著缩短推理时间的同时，改善了对多种新生儿 EEG 事件类型的检测。准确的癫痫发作负荷估计以及与专家评阅者相当的性能，支持其在持续监测和临床决策支持中的潜在应用。

title: scMAC: large language model-enhanced single-cell functional priors for completing functional context in bulk T cell receptor repertoires.
zh_title: scMAC：大模型增强的单细胞功能先验补全bulk TCR功能背景
summary: 提出scMAC框架，利用配对单细胞RNA/TCR数据作为功能先验，为bulk TCR库推断反映转录状态的功能表征，并借助大语言模型增强。
key_points: 针对bulk TCR缺乏转录状态信息的问题
构建去噪的单细胞功能参考以迁移先验
通过TCR功能表征估计库水平功能组成
reason: 新方法但摘要未见外部验证细节，属增量档
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Bulk T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing enables scalable immune repertoire profiling but does not measure the transcriptional states required to infer T cell functional programs. Paired single-cell RNA/TCR sequencing offers a single-cell functional prior by jointly observing TCR identity and transcriptomic states. However, transferring this prior to bulk repertoires is challenging: sparse and noisy single-cell profiles can distort the functional reference, and the probabilistic relationship between TCR identity and transcriptome-inferred functional state makes direct cell-level alignment unstable, potentially biasing repertoire-level functional composition estimation. We present scMAC, a single-cell-guided framework for functional context completion that infers TCR functional representations reflecting transcriptome-derived T-cell states. scMAC builds a denoised functional reference by integrating multi-scale expression modeling with gene-semantic priors derived from large language model encodings of gene and protein descriptions, improving gene-level functional coherence. It then learns a prototype-guided TCR-to-function mapping that combines paired cell-level latent alignment with functional prototype regularization, enabling robust repertoire-level functional composition estimation. Across real single-cell and paired RNA/TCR datasets, scMAC outperformed existing single-cell representation methods in fine-grained cell-state representation, gene functional consistency, expression recovery, and disease-relevant pathway analysis, achieving an adjusted Rand index of 0.656 on a colorectal cancer dataset with 83 cell subtypes. For repertoire-level functional composition estimation, scMAC closely matched single-cell-derived functional proportions, with an R2 of 0.979 and a Bray-Curtis distance of 0.075. These results support scMAC as a practical route for transferring single-cell-derived functional knowledge to bulk TCR repertoire analysis beyond clonotype identity and clonal abundance. scMAC is publicly available at https://github.com/Bioinformatics7181/scMAC.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 批量（bulk）T 细胞受体（TCR）测序可实现可扩展的免疫库分析，但无法测量推断 T 细胞功能程序所需的转录状态。配对的单细胞 RNA/TCR 测序通过同时观察 TCR 身份和转录组状态，提供了单细胞水平的功能先验。然而，将该先验迁移到 bulk 免疫库具有挑战性：稀疏且有噪声的单细胞图谱可能扭曲功能参照，而 TCR 身份与转录组推断的功能状态之间的概率性关系使得直接的细胞水平比对不稳定，可能使免疫库水平功能组成的估计产生偏倚。我们提出 scMAC，一种单细胞引导的功能背景补全框架，用于推断反映转录组来源 T 细胞状态的 TCR 功能表征。scMAC 通过整合多尺度表达建模与源自基因和蛋白质描述的大语言模型编码的基因语义先验，构建去噪的功能参照，从而提高基因水平的功能一致性。随后，它学习一种原型引导的 TCR 到功能的映射，将配对的细胞水平潜在空间比对与功能原型正则化相结合，从而实现稳健的免疫库水平功能组成估计。在真实的单细胞数据集和配对 RNA/TCR 数据集上，scMAC 在细粒度细胞状态表征、基因功能一致性、表达恢复和疾病相关通路分析方面均优于现有单细胞表征方法，在包含 83 个细胞亚型的结直肠癌数据集上取得了 0.656 的调整兰德指数。在免疫库水平功能组成估计方面，scMAC 与单细胞来源的功能比例高度吻合，R2 为 0.979，Bray-Curtis 距离为 0.075。这些结果支持 scMAC 作为一种实用途径，可将单细胞来源的功能知识迁移到 bulk TCR 免疫库分析中，超越克隆型身份和克隆丰度。scMAC 公开可用，网址为 https://github.com/Bioinformatics7181/scMAC。

abstract: [European journal of obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive biology] Embryo selection is one of the most critical determinants of success in in vitro fertilization (IVF). Conventional approaches based on static morphological grading and time-lapse imaging (TLI) remain subjective and show only modest predictive accuracy. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools, including deep learning-based platforms such as iDAScore and KIDScore, have emerged as potentially more standardized alternatives, yet their true clinical impact on per-transfer outcomes remains uncertain. To determine whether AI-assisted embryo selection offers measurable clinical advantages over conventional morphology-based methods in IVF. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted by searching four electronic databases (PubMed, Scopus, Embase, and the Cochrane Library) from January 2013 to April 2024. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohort studies evaluating AI-assisted embryo selection versus conventional morphology in IVF cycles without preimplantation genetic testing for aneuploidy (PGT-A), reporting at least one of clinical pregnancy rate (CPR), implantation rate (IR), or live birth rate (LBR). Two reviewers independently screened records and extracted data. Study quality was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool for the RCT and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for observational studies. Where arm-level data were available, risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were pooled using a random-effects model. Ten studies were included. Only two reported arm-level outcomes suitable for meta-analysis. The pooled estimate showed no significant difference in clinical pregnancy rate between AI-assisted and morphology-based selection (RR = 0.99, 95% CI 0.87-1.12; I2 = 26.5%), with no statistically significant difference between the two methods. The remaining eight studies reported predictive performance metrics with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values of 0.85-0.96, though these did not consistently translate into improved per-cycle outcomes. Implantation and live birth rates were inconsistently reported and could not be pooled. AI-based embryo scoring showed no statistically significant difference compared with conventional morphology for per-transfer clinical pregnancy rate, with potential advantages in standardization and inter-observer consistency. zh_abstract: [European journal of obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive biology] 胚胎选择是体外受精（IVF）成功与否的最关键决定因素之一。基于静态形态学分级和延时成像（TLI）的传统方法仍具主观性，预测准确性也仅属一般。包括iDAScore和KIDScore等基于深度学习的平台在内的人工智能（AI）工具已成为可能更为标准化的替代方案，但其对每次移植结局的真正临床影响仍不确定。目的是确定在IVF中，AI辅助胚胎选择相比传统基于形态学的方法是否具有可测量的临床优势。我们开展了一项系统综述和荟萃分析，检索了四个电子数据库（PubMed、Scopus、Embase和Cochrane图书馆），时间范围为2013年1月至2024年4月。纳入评估未进行胚胎植入前非整倍体遗传学检测（PGT-A）的IVF周期中AI辅助胚胎选择与传统形态学比较的随机对照试验（RCT）和观察性队列研究，且至少报告临床妊娠率（CPR）、着床率（IR）或活产率（LBR）之一。两名评审员独立筛选文献并提取数据。RCT采用Cochrane偏倚风险2工具评估研究质量，观察性研究采用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表。在有分组数据时，采用随机效应模型合并风险比（RR）及95%置信区间（CI）。共纳入10项研究，其中仅2项报告了适合荟萃分析的分组结局。合并估计显示，AI辅助与基于形态学的选择在临床妊娠率上无显著差异（RR = 0.99，95% CI 0.87-1.12；I2 = 26.5%），两种方法之间无统计学显著差异。其余8项研究报告了预测性能指标，受试者操作特征曲线下面积为0.85-0.96，但这些并未一致地转化为每周期结局的改善。着床率和活产率的报告不一致，无法合并。在每次移植的临床妊娠率方面，基于AI的胚胎评分与传统形态学相比无统计学显著差异，但在标准化和观察者间一致性方面可能具有优势。然而，其优越性仍未得到证实，包括累积活产率、流产率和妊娠时间在内的关键以患者为中心的结局……（原文至此截断）

title: An Agentic AI Workflow for Liver Lesion Segmentation and Structured Radiology Reporting
zh_title: 肝脏病灶分割与结构化放射报告的智能体AI工作流
summary: 提出以nnU-Net分割、确定性定量与LLM结构化报告相连的智能体框架，在51例LiTS病例上肝脏Dice 0.947，病灶敏感性75.6%。
key_points: TotalSegmentator类nnU-Net分割肝脏、Couinaud段与病灶
LLM按预设模式生成报告并做数值一致性检查
51例LiTS：病灶敏感性75.6%，PPV 68.9%
reason: 预印本，样本小仅公开数据集，但智能体报告思路有新意
abstract: Despite advances in automated liver lesion segmentation, a gap remains between image-derived predictions and clinically interpretable radiology reports. Bridging this gap requires quantitative measurements that are both reproducible and traceable. We present an evidence-grounded agentic AI framework that connects liver and lesion segmentation with deterministic quantification and structured reporting. TotalSegmentator-based nnU-Net models delineate the liver, Couinaud segments, and lesions, while computational tools extract volumes, dimensions, counts, and anatomical locations. A large language model (LLM) organizes these measurements into a predefined reporting schema, with numerical consistency checks against source measurements. On 51 LiTS cases, the segmentation stage achieved a liver Dice score of 0.947, lesion sensitivity of 75.6%, and positive predictive value of 68.9%. Exploratory screening of 25,494 MERLIN reports identified 10,208 (40.0%) with liver-related abnormalities. By connecting quantitative imaging evidence with agentic report generation, this work takes a step toward human-centered medical AI that prioritizes traceability and clinical relevance.
zh_abstract: 尽管肝脏病灶自动分割技术不断进步，但基于图像的预测与临床上可解释的放射学报告之间仍存在差距。弥合这一差距需要既可重复又可追溯的定量测量。我们提出了一个以证据为基础的智能体（agentic）AI框架，将肝脏和病灶分割与确定性定量及结构化报告相连接。基于TotalSegmentator的nnU-Net模型勾画肝脏、Couinaud肝段和病灶，计算工具提取体积、尺寸、数量和解剖位置。大语言模型（LLM）将这些测量结果组织到预定义的报告模式中，并对照源测量值进行数值一致性检查。在51例LiTS病例中，分割阶段的肝脏Dice系数为0.947，病灶敏感性为75.6%，阳性预测值为68.9%。对25,494份MERLIN报告的探索性筛查发现，10,208份（40.0%）存在肝脏相关异常。通过将定量影像证据与智能体报告生成相结合，这项工作朝着优先考虑可追溯性和临床相关性的以人为本的医学AI迈出了一步。

title: AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives
zh_title: AskGLP1：基于知识图谱的LLM智能体探索GLP-1用药体验
summary: 系统从约850万条Reddit帖子中筛选，构建含385,790条药物-副作用/用途关系的知识图谱，并支持问答，与FAERS比较。
key_points: LLM流水线结合MedDRA术语筛选患者叙述
163,135条帖子加2,506条WebMD评论入图
与FAERS共有常见胃肠症状，另突出疲劳、厌食
reason: 预印本，规模大的真实世界叙述挖掘，缺临床验证
abstract: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. Online narratives share the most common gastrointestinal symptoms with FAERS, but they foreground everyday burdens such as fatigue and food aversion, whereas FAERS reports more often include injection-site reactions and selected serious diagnoses such as pancreatitis. We further find that posts report less nausea and vomiting for tirzepatide than for semaglutide, more fatigue for Wegovy than Ozempic and for Zepbound than Mounjaro. Evaluations show that the agent answers with verifiable evidence and declines requests for medical advice. Our findings reveal gaps between what FAERS captures and what people report online, and they call for patient-centered approaches to pharmacovigilance. Code, prompts, and evaluation questions are available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1.
zh_abstract: GLP-1 类药物越来越多地用于体重管理，许多人在网上分享自己的用药经历。这些叙述揭示了人们为何使用这些药物以及他们的体验，但仍是非结构化的，且与正式的药物警戒相脱节。因此，我们提出 AskGLP1，这是一个将在线患者叙述转化为知识图谱（KG）并回答有关用药体验问题的系统。通过一条以 MedDRA 术语为依据、由大语言模型（LLM）辅助的流程，AskGLP1 从近 850 万条 Reddit 帖子中筛选用药体验，提炼出其中 163,135 条，并结合 2,506 条 WebMD 评价，构建了包含 385,790 个药物-副作用及药物-用途关系的知识图谱。我们发现，GLP-1 药物的使用体验具有来源特异性和药物特异性。在线叙述与 FAERS 共有最常见的胃肠道症状，但更突出疲劳和食物厌恶等日常负担，而 FAERS 报告中更常包含注射部位反应以及胰腺炎等部分严重诊断。我们还发现，帖子中替尔泊肽（tirzepatide）相关的恶心和呕吐报告少于司美格鲁肽（semaglutide），Wegovy 相关的疲劳报告多于 Ozempic，Zepbound 相关的疲劳报告多于 Mounjaro。评估表明，该智能体能够以可验证的证据作答，并拒绝提供医疗建议的请求。我们的研究结果揭示了 FAERS 所捕获的信息与人们在网上所报告内容之间的差距，并呼吁采用以患者为中心的药物警戒方法。代码、提示词和评估问题可在 https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1 获取。

title: Acute Stroke Classification Using Asymmetric Data Standardization and Orthogonal-Focal Loss Optimized CNN-ViT Cross-Attention Fusion: A Multicenter External Validation Study
zh_title: CNN-ViT交叉注意力融合用于急性卒中分类：多中心外部验证
summary: 提出CNN与ViT交叉注意力融合的分层卒中CAD系统，内部F1为95.48%，并在AISD、BHSD、PhysioNet等多中心数据上做外部验证。
key_points: 采用放射学窗宽预处理与正交-焦点损失
内部数据集F1为95.48%
外部验证针对快捷学习与域偏移问题
reason: 预印本，有多中心外部验证但摘要未见外部结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Background/Objectives: Rapid differentiation of ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke subtypes is vital for acute management. Although current deep learning models achieve high single-dataset accuracy, they suffer from "shortcut learning" and domain shift in external validation. This study proposes a hierarchical computer-aided diagnostic (CAD) system mimicking emergency triage. Methods: We introduce a 3-channel Radiology-Focused Preprocessing pipeline that feeds radiological Hounsfield Unit (HU) windows into Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Vision Transformer (ViT) backbones via asymmetric formats (.mat and .png). The architecture utilizes a novel joint cross-attention fusion network optimized by an Integrated Orthogonal-Focal Loss. Results: Our system achieved a 95.48% F1-score on the internal stroke dataset. However, multi-center external validation (AISD, BHSD, PhysioNet) using a Mask Anchor filter revealed a drop to the 58-62% range, exposing the "internal validation illusion" caused by hardware noise. Critically, models exhibited high precision (77%) but low sensitivity (57%) for ischemic stroke, proving prone to hemorrhage overdiagnosis. Multi-seed variance analysis demonstrated that the DenseNet201+ViT backbone yielded the lowest deviation (0.59) and highest stability, making it the most reliable architecture for real-world clinical integration. Conclusions: To overcome diagnostic challenges, future research must focus on multimodal architectures that combine 3D volumetric extraction with clinical data.
zh_abstract: 【背景/目的】缺血性与出血性卒中亚型的快速鉴别对急性期处理至关重要。尽管现有深度学习模型在单一数据集上达到较高准确率，但在外部验证中存在“捷径学习”和域偏移问题。本研究提出一种模拟急诊分诊的分层计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统。【方法】我们提出一条三通道放射学聚焦预处理流程，通过非对称格式（.mat 和 .png）将放射学亨氏单位（HU）窗输入卷积神经网络（CNN）和视觉 Transformer（ViT）骨干网络。该架构采用一种新型联合交叉注意力融合网络，并通过集成正交-焦点损失（Integrated Orthogonal-Focal Loss）进行优化。【结果】我们的系统在内部卒中数据集上取得 95.48% 的 F1 分数。然而，使用 Mask Anchor 过滤器进行的多中心外部验证（AISD、BHSD、PhysioNet）显示性能下降至 58–62% 区间，揭示了由硬件噪声造成的“内部验证幻觉”。关键的是，模型对缺血性卒中表现出较高的精确率（77%）但较低的敏感度（57%），证明其易于过度诊断出血。多随机种子方差分析表明，DenseNet201+ViT 骨干网络的偏差最低（0.59）、稳定性最高，是最适合真实临床整合的可靠架构。【结论】为克服诊断挑战，未来研究必须着眼于将三维容积提取与临床数据相结合的多模态架构。

title: Regional prediction of hematoma expansion from non-contrast computed tomography in spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage patients
zh_title: 基于非增强CT的自发性脑出血血肿扩大区域预测
summary: 研究用基于传输的形态学（TBM）从非增强CT提取区域特征，在ERICH推导、VISTA验证，预测脑出血血肿扩大。
key_points: ERICH队列推导，VISTA队列独立验证
按脑叶、基底节、丘脑分区定义血肿扩大
线性分类器作用于传输表示，强调可解释性
reason: 有独立队列外部验证，但为预印本且摘要信息有限
abstract: Background The combination of hematoma location, expansion and final volume influence neurological outcome. The aim of this study was to derive and validate a quantitative and interpretable region-based NCCT image feature model for predicting hematoma expansion. Methods The Ethnic/Racial Variations of Intracerebral Hemorrhage(ERICH) study was used for derivation and the Virtual International Trials in Stroke Archive(VISTA) was used for validation. NCCT images at presentation and 24+/-6hours were pre-processed, segmented and categorized into lobar, basal ganglia or thalamic regions. Hematoma expansion was defined by region and according to its effect on clinical outcome. Transport-based morphometry (TBM) produced a unique transport-based representation from each NCCT hematoma image. Linear classifiers applied to transport representations were used to derive a predictive model. The regional TBM model's performance was compared to alternate methods using AUROC analyses. Results The derivation dataset included 574 patients, comprising 162 lobar, 257 basal ganglia and 155 thalamic hematomas. The validation dataset included 196 patients, comprising 31 lobar, 119 basal ganglia and 46 thalamic hematomas. A combined regional model predicted hematoma expansion in the validation dataset with an AUROC of 0.787. The principal image features which varied by location were size, heterogeneity, eccentricity and density distribution towards the hematoma periphery. The regional TBM model outperformed alternative clinician based and machine-learning methods. Conclusions TBM discriminated and visualized regional features of hematoma expansion from presentation NCCT scans. This provides preliminary evidence for regional radiographic features of hematoma expansion. It has the potential to improve hematoma expansion prediction and understanding of hematoma expansion pathophysiology.
zh_abstract:
【背景】血肿的位置、扩大及最终体积共同影响神经功能结局。本研究旨在推导并验证一种基于区域的、可量化且可解释的非增强CT（NCCT）图像特征模型，用于预测血肿扩大。
【方法】采用脑出血种族/民族差异（Ethnic/Racial Variations of Intracerebral Hemorrhage，ERICH）研究进行模型推导，采用卒中虚拟国际试验档案库（Virtual International Trials in Stroke Archive，VISTA）进行验证。对入院时及24±6小时的NCCT图像进行预处理、分割，并归类为脑叶、基底节或丘脑区域。血肿扩大按区域并依据其对临床结局的影响进行定义。基于传输的形态测量学（transport-based morphometry，TBM）从每幅NCCT血肿图像生成唯一的基于传输的表示。将线性分类器应用于传输表示以推导预测模型。采用AUROC分析，将区域TBM模型的性能与其他方法进行比较。
【结果】推导数据集纳入574例患者，包括162例脑叶血肿、257例基底节血肿和155例丘脑血肿。验证数据集纳入196例患者，包括31例脑叶血肿、119例基底节血肿和46例丘脑血肿。联合区域模型在验证数据集中预测血肿扩大的AUROC为0.787。随位置而变化的主要图像特征为大小、异质性、偏心率以及向血肿周边的密度分布。区域TBM模型优于基于临床医生和机器学习的其他方法。
【结论】TBM能够从入院时的NCCT扫描中区分并可视化血肿扩大的区域性特征。这为血肿扩大的区域性影像学特征提供了初步证据，有望改善血肿扩大的预测并加深对血肿扩大病理生理的理解。

title: Conviction Without Evidence: Verdict Stability Is Independent of Visual Grounding in Medical Vision--Language Models
zh_title: 无证据的笃定：医学视觉语言模型的判断稳定性与视觉依据无关
summary: 在60道意大利国考题上，用图像替换与对抗压力实验发现，无图像支撑的诊断并不比有图像的更易被推翻。
key_points: 60道意大利国考题，图像替换结合两级对抗压力
伪造共识下推翻率：有图94.4%，无图98.1%
判断稳定性不能用来识别缺乏视觉依据的回答
reason: VLM可靠性分析有新意，但样本小、预印本
abstract: Vision--language models applied to medical question answering can reach correct diagnoses without using the diagnostic image, inferring instead from the clinical vignette. We ask whether this is visible in how \emph{firmly} a model holds its answer: does a model defend a diagnosis derived from a blank placeholder as tenaciously as one derived from a real medical image? Crossing an image-substitution protocol with two levels of adversarial pressure on 60 Italian State Examination items, we find no evidence that ungrounded verdicts are more fragile. In a paired item-level analysis, fabricated consensus (L4) overturns 94.4\% of verdicts with the real image and 98.1\% without ($Δ= +0.037$; one-sided 95\% upper bound $+0.105$); contentless doubt (L1) overturns 62.5\% and 51.8\% ($Δ= -0.107$, 95\% CI $[-0.209, -0.001]$), the point estimate running opposite to the direction a grounding detector requires. The two levels nonetheless produce opposite \emph{dynamics}: under L4 the model flips once, always to the exact option argued for (110/110 first-turn flips), and then freezes, averaging 1.9 verdict changes over ten turns; under L1 it never settles, averaging 7.4 changes. Instability under contentless doubt tracks intrinsic item ambiguity rather than evidence availability, and so does not serve as a grounding signal. Flips are almost entirely corrupting (99/100 across both levels). The model is not unaware of the missing evidence---it flags the blank image at baseline on 35 of 60 items and abstains on 4--6---yet those abstentions do not survive contact with pressure. None of the epistemic signals a user could plausibly consult distinguishes a grounded diagnosis from a confabulated one.
zh_abstract: 应用于医学问答的视觉-语言模型可以在不使用诊断图像的情况下得出正确诊断，而是根据临床病例描述进行推断。我们探讨这一现象能否从模型坚持其答案的\emph{牢固程度}中体现出来：模型对基于空白占位图得出的诊断，是否与对基于真实医学图像得出的诊断一样顽强地坚持？我们在60道意大利国家考试题目上，将图像替换方案与两种程度的对抗性压力交叉设计，结果未发现无依据的判断更脆弱的证据。在配对的题目层面分析中，伪造共识（L4）使有真实图像时94.4%的判断被推翻，无图像时为98.1%（$Δ= +0.037$；单侧95%上限$+0.105$）；无内容的质疑（L1）分别推翻62.5%和51.8%（$Δ= -0.107$，95% CI $[-0.209, -0.001]$），其点估计方向与基于依据的检测器所需的方向相反。然而，这两种程度的压力产生了相反的\emph{动态}：在L4下，模型只改变一次答案，且总是改为所主张的那个确切选项（首轮改变110/110），随后便固定不变，十轮中平均判断改变1.9次；在L1下，模型始终无法稳定，平均改变7.4次。无内容质疑下的不稳定性反映的是题目本身固有的模糊性，而非证据的可得性，因此不能作为依据性信号。答案改变几乎全部是由错误导致的（两种程度合计99/100）。模型并非未察觉证据缺失——基线时它在60道题中的35道标记了空白图像，并在4–6道题上选择弃答——但这些弃答在压力下并未保持。用户可能参考的各类认知信号，均无法区分有依据的诊断与虚构的诊断。

title: GRASP: Group-Adaptive Hybrid RL-SFT Post-Training for Medical VQA without Reasoning Annotations
zh_title: GRASP：无需推理标注的医学VQA分组自适应RL-SFT混合后训练
summary: 针对医学VQA缺少推理标注的问题，提出RL与SFT混合后训练方法，以兼顾答案监督与域外泛化（预印本）。
key_points: SFT易过拟合，GRPO在全对/全错组缺乏信号

abstract: Adapting general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) to medical visual question answering (VQA) is valuable for helping clinicians read images and make diagnoses, but annotated data are scarce and provide only short answers, without reasoning annotations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fits these labels but overfits to them and amplifies their biases, eroding out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) better preserves generalization but never uses the gold answer as a training target: GRPO-style algorithms learn from the contrast between correct and incorrect answers within a group of sampled responses, so all-correct or all-wrong groups give no correctness signal. Existing SFT-RL hybrids either apply SFT and RL in separate stages or switch between them per question, or need reasoning traces from experts or stronger models, which medical VQA data lack. We propose GRASP, which combines RL and SFT in every update using only short answers: RL lets the model explore its own reasoning, SFT teaches the gold answer after that reasoning to supply the direct supervision RL lacks, and their balance adapts to how well the model answers each question. Tuning only about 1% of the parameters with LoRA, GRASP outperforms all compared training objectives both in domain and on OOD open-ended questions across Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3-8B and Gemma 3-4B. On an OOD benchmark spanning eight imaging modalities, GRASP-trained InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B beat all 10 compared general and medical VLMs in open-ended accuracy, including models trained on up to 2,600 times more data or with over 250 times more trainable parameters. We release MedTerse, a dataset of 12.9K short-answer questions, and our code at https://github.com/sea-comet/GRASP-MedVQA.

abstract: Reusing pretrained medical-imaging models offers an alternative to training from scratch. A model trained for the same task may perform poorly at a new hospital because imaging protocols and preprocessing differ. Effective adaptation depends on the model architecture, domain shift, and available labels and compute. Adaptation can improve scores on a small labeled set yet reduce performance on unseen data. We present MedAdaptAgent, an automatic harness that turns a supplied model, target data, and a free-text request into a new-site adaptation workflow. Its LLM-driven Adaptation Planner uses model-site evidence to choose compatible experiments and revise subsequent adjustments. The harness requires evidence of improvement over the pretrained model, then delivers the selected model as a complete, runnable package. Evaluation spans 26 segmentation and classification transfers across architectures and compute settings, with segmentation annotation budgets ranging from zero-shot transfer to few-shot adaptation. With 20 local annotations, mean segmentation Dice rises from 0.483 to 0.774 across 10 transfers, a 60.1% relative gain, with no harmful replacements. Mean classification AUROC rises from 0.810 to 0.837 across 13 transfers, a 3.4% relative gain. Comparing adapted models with the pretrained model reduces harmful classification replacements by 30.8% versus selecting the highest-scoring model on the available labels, using identical candidates. Seven public-model deployments demonstrate adaptation and reproducible package delivery across contrast and modality shifts. A CT-to-MRI study extends the evaluation to four LLM planners, including two open-weight models. We release the code on GitHub.

abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] Clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) and CRISPR-associated (Cas) proteins constitute adaptive immune systems in prokaryotes and have transformed life sciences, precision medicine, and synthetic biology as programmable genome-editing tools. Despite their broad utility, naturally occurring DNA-targeting Cas effectors remain constrained by several intrinsic limitations, including large protein size that complicates delivery, stringent protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) requirements that restrict targetable genomic space, and mismatch tolerance that can lead to off-target activity and potential genotoxicity. These challenges have made Cas protein engineering and the discovery of novel CRISPR and CRISPR-like systems from metagenomic resources central to the development of next-generation genome-editing platforms. This Review places recent advances within an integrated synthetic biology engineering continuum that links natural effector discovery, structure-guided hypothesis generation, high-throughput functional screening, machine learning-enabled model construction, and iterative redesign. This Review summarizes progress in the screening, optimization, and functional engineering of DNA-targeting CRISPR and CRISPR-like effectors, with emphasis on structure-guided rational design, directed evolution coupled with high-throughput screening, bioinformatics- and evolution-guided mining of novel systems from large-scale sequence databases, and artificial intelligence-assisted development. By integrating these strategies, we highlight how CRISPR effector engineering is moving toward design-build-test-learn (DBTL)-inspired workflows that expand the functional landscape of genome-editing technologies and advance genome editing toward improved efficiency, safety, and programmability.
zh_abstract: [ACS合成生物学] 成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列（CRISPR）及CRISPR相关（Cas）蛋白构成原核生物的适应性免疫系统，并作为可编程的基因组编辑工具，变革了生命科学、精准医学和合成生物学。尽管用途广泛，天然存在的靶向DNA的Cas效应蛋白仍受若干内在局限所制约，包括蛋白体积大而使递送复杂化、严格的原间隔序列邻近基序（PAM）要求限制了可靶向的基因组范围，以及错配耐受可导致脱靶活性和潜在的基因毒性。这些挑战使Cas蛋白工程以及从宏基因组资源中发现新型CRISPR和类CRISPR系统，成为下一代基因组编辑平台开发的核心。本综述将近期进展置于一个整合的合成生物学工程连续体之中，该连续体将天然效应蛋白的发现、结构指导的假设生成、高通量功能筛选、机器学习驱动的模型构建以及迭代重设计联系起来。本综述总结了靶向DNA的CRISPR及类CRISPR效应蛋白在筛选、优化和功能工程方面的进展，重点包括结构指导的理性设计、结合高通量筛选的定向进化、基于生物信息学和进化指导的从大规模序列数据库中挖掘新系统，以及人工智能辅助的开发。通过整合这些策略，我们强调CRISPR效应蛋白工程正朝着受“设计-构建-测试-学习”（DBTL）启发的工作流程发展，从而拓展基因组编辑技术的功能版图，并推动基因组编辑在效率、安全性和可编程性方面的提升。

abstract: [Chemical reviews] Peptide-based therapeutics are gaining popularity as next-generation drugs because of their potent bioactivity, high specificity, and broad applications in immunomodulatory, antiviral, anticancer, and antimicrobial therapy. Membrane-active peptides (MAPs) are particularly promising, yet poor solubility, stability, pharmacokinetics, manufacturing complexity, and limited delivery options have restricted their clinical translation. This review focuses on computational approaches developed to address these challenges at the peptide-design stage and bridge the gap between preclinical promise and clinical utility. The goal here is to provide a broad overview of tools for in silico MAP design, prediction of functional structural ensembles and physicochemical properties, structure-function relationships, drug-target interactions, and formulation strategies for in vivo delivery. These approaches span bioinformatics, molecular dynamics and molecular modeling, and emerging artificial intelligence and machine learning platforms, including hybrid computational-experimental strategies, chemical modification and conjugation, and nanotechnology-based delivery systems. These tools are improving key peptide-drug properties, including plasma stability, target specificity, efficacy, and delivery. Continued advances in computational design may enable MAPs to address challenging diseases, engage traditionally undruggable targets, and translate their substantial therapeutic potential into clinically effective treatments.

abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] Enzyme enantioselectivity remains a central challenge in the biocatalytic synthesis of chiral pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals. Conventional evolution methods, constrained by prolonged experimental cycles and computationally intensive processes, struggle to comprehensively explore complex protein sequences. Although machine learning (ML) has been successfully applied to optimize enzymatic properties, such as catalytic efficiency and stability, its potential in enantioselectivity engineering remains underexploited. This review systematically evaluates how machine learning integrates multimodal datasets, including sequence, structural, and functional performance data, to advance the discovery and engineering of naturally enantioselective enzymes, and enable the de novo design of artificial enzymes for reaction-relevant applications. Furthermore, key algorithmic frameworks are reviewed. Persistent challenges such as data heterogeneity and limited model generalization capabilities are also critically examined. Moreover, machine learning is increasingly expected to bridge molecular-level enantioselective design with pathway optimization and reactor-scale process engineering, enabling a more integrated and efficient chiral biomanufacturing pipeline. Overall, these advancements open new avenues for efficient chiral biosynthesis and provide theoretical foundations and technical blueprints for a paradigm shift toward intelligence-driven biocatalysis engineering.

abstract: Maybe not. The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) has become an oracle for millions of clinicians and health system developers worldwide. Researchers have increasingly used knowledge graphs derived from UMLS to enhance language models' factual accuracy and reasoning traceability in high-stakes tasks. Medical Question Answering (MQA) is a prime testbed for integration, with benchmarks usually involving professional exercises such as disease diagnosis and drug prescription from patient history. Despite the assumed benefits, empirical evidence shows that UMLS-based graph injection typically yields modest performance gains. This paper reviews existing MQA work, critically analyzing the selected UMLS sources and their usage with language models, and probes each of these choices in isolation. We uncover methodological issues never discussed in prior work, from low UMLS coverage to weak subgraph retrieval pipelines. Based on our findings, we provide actionable recommendations to unlock the untapped potential of UMLS as an external knowledge source.

abstract: De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain results unchanged. On MIMIC ICU nursing notes F1 falls to 0.48. The errors follow two properties our synthetic notes lack, telegraphic style and low identifier density, and three hand-written in-context examples recover 0.08 F1 without annotated target data.

abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. However, existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning are predominantly trained on high-quality large-scale datasets obtained from oximeters in hospital settings and often struggle to adapt to sparse and low-quality real-world datasets, thereby limiting their generalization to clinically relevant tasks on prevalent PPG data such as collected from wearable devices. Surprisingly, even after full fine-tuning, PPG foundation models cannot consistently outperform general-purpose time-series models. Therefore, a key question is how to effectively adapt PPG foundation models to target prediction tasks. Through empirical studies on various PPG foundation models, we find that pretrained models often exhibit inherent sparsity and computational redundancy, suggesting that PPG foundation models have learned to activate task-relevant network substructures for different prediction tasks. To preserve this valuable prior knowledge, we propose a structured pruning-and-fine-tuning framework, SPAFT, which regularizes the adaptive fine-tuning process by constraining it to a more relevant and compact parameter space based on parameter importance and structural redundancy. Extensive experiments across four PPG foundation models, five benchmark datasets, and ten downstream tasks demonstrate that SPAFT achieves win rates of 82.8% and 87.5% on regression and classification tasks, respectively. This prune-then-finetune paradigm often enables PPG foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance, laying a promising foundation for the real-world clinical deployment of PPG foundation models and the development of personalized PPG foundation models.
zh_abstract: 光电容积描记（PPG）在可穿戴健康监测和临床决策支持中发挥着核心作用。然而，现有的通用 PPG 表征学习方法主要在医院环境中由血氧仪获得的高质量大规模数据集上训练，往往难以适应稀疏且低质量的真实世界数据集，从而限制了其在可穿戴设备等采集的常见 PPG 数据上对临床相关任务的泛化能力。令人意外的是，即使经过完整微调，PPG 基础模型也无法始终优于通用时间序列模型。因此，一个关键问题是如何有效地使 PPG 基础模型适应目标预测任务。通过对多种 PPG 基础模型的实证研究，我们发现预训练模型常表现出固有的稀疏性和计算冗余，这表明 PPG 基础模型已学会针对不同预测任务激活与任务相关的网络子结构。为保留这一宝贵的先验知识，我们提出了一种结构化剪枝与微调框架 SPAFT，该框架基于参数重要性和结构冗余，将自适应微调过程约束在更相关、更紧凑的参数空间内，从而对其进行正则化。在四种 PPG 基础模型、五个基准数据集和十项下游任务上的大量实验表明，SPAFT 在回归和分类任务上的胜率分别为82.8%和87.5%。这种先剪枝后微调的范式通常能使 PPG 基础模型达到最先进的性能，为 PPG 基础模型在真实世界临床中的部署以及个性化 PPG 基础模型的开发奠定了有前景的基础。

title: MIS-VQA: An Annotation-Driven Surgical Vision-Language Dataset for Complex Surgical Understanding
zh_title: MIS-VQA：面向复杂手术理解的标注驱动视觉语言数据集
summary: 基于EndoVis18与CholecT50的标注，经LLM生成问答对，构建手术视觉语言数据集MIS-VQA（预印本，未经同行评审）。
key_points: 将阶段、器械、三元组、分割标注转为结构化场景文本
由LLM据此生成临床连贯的问答对
旨在克服模板化、稀疏标注的手术VQA局限
reason: 新手术VQA数据集，但规模与验证信息有限，预印本
abstract: Modern surgical AI increasingly requires multimodal understanding rather than isolated perception, yet existing datasets remain largely limited to single-task supervision such as recognition or templated question answering. Current medical VQA resources often rely on synthetic templates, lack natural descriptive supervision, or provide sparse annotations that hinder reasoning about spatial relations and procedural context. We introduce MIS-VQA, a surgical vision-language dataset generated through an annotation-driven pipeline that converts heterogeneous surgical annotations into structured textual scene representations. Using EndoVis18 and CholecT50, we transform phase, instrument, interaction, triplet, and segmentation labels into unified contexts that guide large language models to generate clinically coherent question-answer pairs. MIS-VQA supports four response types-concise and detailed descriptions, perception-level grounding, and multi-step reasoning-enabling hierarchical evaluation from atomic visual grounding to compositional reasoning. To address annotation sparsity, we incorporate confidence-filtered segmentation and cross-annotation consistency checks, enabling spatially grounded supervision at scale. MIS-VQA establishes a unified benchmark for surgical vision-language understanding with spatial supervision and multi-tier reasoning evaluation. To demonstrate its utility, we introduce LLaVA-SurgXpert, a family of surgical vision-language models with visual encoders to analyze how visual representations influence multimodal reasoning. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing surgical VQA baselines while revealing capability gaps between perceptual grounding and higher-level reasoning hidden in prior benchmarks.
zh_abstract: 现代外科人工智能日益需要多模态理解而非孤立的感知，然而现有数据集大多仍局限于单一任务监督，如识别或模板化问答。当前的医学视觉问答（VQA）资源常依赖合成模板，缺乏自然的描述性监督，或仅提供稀疏标注，从而妨碍对空间关系和手术流程情境的推理。我们提出 MIS-VQA，这是一个通过标注驱动流程生成的外科视觉-语言数据集，该流程将异质的外科标注转换为结构化的文本场景表示。基于 EndoVis18 和 CholecT50，我们将手术阶段、器械、交互、三元组和分割标签转化为统一的上下文，以引导大语言模型生成临床上连贯的问答对。MIS-VQA 支持四种回答类型——简洁描述、详细描述、感知层面的定位（grounding）以及多步推理——可实现从原子级视觉定位到组合式推理的分层评估。为解决标注稀疏的问题，我们引入了经置信度过滤的分割和跨标注一致性检查，从而能够大规模提供空间定位监督。MIS-VQA 建立了一个具有空间监督和多层级推理评估的外科视觉-语言理解统一基准。为展示其实用性，我们提出 LLaVA-SurgXpert，这是一族配备不同视觉编码器的外科视觉-语言模型，用于分析视觉表示如何影响多模态推理。实验显示，其相较现有外科 VQA 基线取得一致提升，同时揭示了先前基准中被掩盖的感知定位与高层推理之间的能力差距。

title: Development and Validation of an Automated Image-Based Method for Prognostic Stratification in Lung Adenocarcinoma using Immunohistochemical Markers
zh_title: 基于IHC图像的肺腺癌预后分层自动化方法
summary: 预印本提出MEL评分，自动量化免疫组化标志物表达，在128例肺腺癌的BRCA1、GLUT1、QKI染色图像上评估，并开源为Fiji/ImageJ工具。
key_points: MEL评分替代人工H-score
整合组织分割与肿瘤面积加权并做染色归一化
