abstract: We present an automated image-based framework for quantifying biomarker expression in immunohistochemical (IHC) images and introduce the Marker Expression Level (MEL) score as an objective alternative to visual H-scoring. MEL addresses key limitations of existing automated methods by integrating tissue-region segmentation with tumour-area-weighted marker quantification, normalization to mitigate inter-sample and inter-batch staining variability, and robust quantification of nuclear, cytoplasmic, and membrane-associated biomarkers. The complete pipeline was developed as an open-source Fiji/ImageJ tool and is publicly available. We evaluated MEL using IHC images from 128 lung adenocarcinoma patients stained for BRCA1, GLUT1, and QKI, three markers forming a prognostic signature previously described by our group. Tissue regions were segmented using a machine learning-based Fiji plugin, and MEL scores were calculated within tumour regions. A normalization strategy accounted for inter-TMA staining variability. Agreement with visual H-scores was assessed using Spearman correlation. Prognostic performance was evaluated using Cox regression to derive a Combined Prognostic Index (CPI) incorporating MEL scores and tumour stage. Segmentation achieved high accuracy across tissue regions (Dice coefficients 0.69-0.99), with lower performance in highly immune-infiltrated stromal areas. MEL scores significantly correlated with visual H-scores for all markers ({rho} = 0.61-0.69, p < 0.001). Normalization improved agreement for GLUT1 ({rho} = 0.39 to 0.62). The derived CPI stratified patients into distinct risk groups with significant differences in disease-free and overall survival (p < 0.05), comparable to visual scoring. MEL provides a reproducible and scalable alternative to expert visual H-scoring and standard semi-automated approaches such as QuPath. Its integration with prognostic modelling reproduced a validated survival signature with performance comparable to expert scoring, supporting clinical and translational applicability. MEL is not a marginal refinement of existing digital scoring methods, but rather a clinically oriented and biologically adaptable framework designed to improve the robustness and reproducibility of automated IHC quantification.
zh_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于图像的自动化框架，用于定量免疫组织化学（IHC）图像中的生物标志物表达，并引入标志物表达水平（Marker Expression Level，MEL）评分，作为目视H评分的客观替代方法。MEL解决了现有自动化方法的主要局限：它整合了组织区域分割与按肿瘤面积加权的标志物定量，通过归一化减轻样本间和批次间的染色差异，并可稳健地定量位于细胞核、细胞质和细胞膜的生物标志物。整个流程已开发为开源的Fiji/ImageJ工具并公开提供。我们使用128例肺腺癌患者的IHC图像评估了MEL，这些图像针对BRCA1、GLUT1和QKI染色，这三种标志物构成了我们课题组此前报道的一个预后特征。组织区域使用基于机器学习的Fiji插件进行分割，并在肿瘤区域内计算MEL评分。归一化策略用于校正不同组织芯片（TMA）之间的染色差异。采用Spearman相关评估其与目视H评分的一致性。采用Cox回归评估预后性能，得到整合MEL评分和肿瘤分期的联合预后指数（Combined Prognostic Index，CPI）。分割在各组织区域均达到较高准确度（Dice系数0.69–0.99），在免疫浸润程度高的间质区域表现较低。所有标志物的MEL评分均与目视H评分显著相关（ρ = 0.61–0.69，p < 0.001）。归一化改善了GLUT1的一致性（ρ由0.39提高至0.62）。所得CPI将患者分层为无病生存期和总生存期均存在显著差异的不同风险组（p < 0.05），与目视评分相当。MEL为专家目视H评分以及QuPath等标准半自动方法提供了可重复、可扩展的替代方案。其与预后建模的结合重现了一个经过验证的生存特征，性能与专家评分相当，支持其临床和转化应用。MEL并非对现有数字化评分方法的细微改良，而是一个以临床为导向、具有生物学适应性的框架，旨在提高自动化IHC定量的稳健性和可重复性。

title: Population-scale machine learning models to estimate individual-level risk for acute respiratory infection

summary: 该预印本利用新西兰约485万至536万人的关联行政数据（2017–2024），训练模型预测年度呼吸道感染相关住院风险，比较六种算法与八组变量。

abstract: Background: Models based on administrative population health records can help improve understanding of disease and hospitalisation risk. This understanding can support evidence-based population health policy and processes. Influenza and other acute respiratory diseases place a large, inequitable burden on the New Zealand population and health care resources. We have developed and evaluated models using retrospective New Zealand hospitalisation records linked to other administrative data. Methods: We analysed linked annual records for approximately 4.85 - 5.36 million people in 2017 - 2024. For each year, models were trained to distinguish people who experienced at least one hospitalisation associated with respiratory infectious disease from those without such a hospitalisation during that year. Six algorithms and eight variable sets were assessed using five-fold cross-validation grouped by demographic profile. Variables comprised demographics, continuous hospital-based (M3) and pharmaceutical-based (P3) morbidity indices, and influenza vaccination status. Models trained on one year were also evaluated on data from the following year. Performance measures were the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the average precision score (APS). SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) described model contributions, including paired vaccination-input changes in 2024. Among vaccinated individuals, SHAP analysis indicated that vaccination contributed most strongly towards lower model-estimated hospitalisation risk in the oldest age group. 【背景】基于行政性人群健康记录的模型有助于加深对疾病和住院风险的理解，这种理解可为循证的人群健康政策和流程提供支持。流感及其他急性呼吸道疾病给新西兰人群和医疗资源带来了沉重且不公平的负担。我们利用与其他行政数据关联的新西兰回顾性住院记录，开发并评估了相关模型。

title: A Knowledge Database of Physical Activity Interventions for Hypertension using Large Language Models

abstract: Physical exercise lowers blood pressure, but guidelines address broad populations and rarely consider age, comorbidities, medications or baseline severity. No structured, queryable database of exercise interventions for hypertension exists, and manual curation is not scalable. We present PAHD (Physical Activity for Hypertension Database), built with large language models (LLMs). An LLM screened 2,548 PubMed records by title and abstract, then full text, selecting 255 studies. LLMs extracted each study's groups, exercise protocols, patient characteristics and results; two LLMs cross-checked the study structure, and every value carries a verbatim quote. Code standardized and joined the extractions into 17,312 records from 254 studies, one per reported comparison. Against adjudicated benchmarks, screening reached 86.3% recall and 80.6% precision, and extraction recovered 90.1% of blood pressure values with 90.5% precision. A web portal matches patients' hypertension stage and comorbidities to studies. PAHD provides a structured evidence base for personalized exercise interventions on hypertension management.
zh_abstract: 体育锻炼可降低血压，但指南针对的是广泛人群，很少考虑年龄、合并症、药物或基线严重程度。目前不存在结构化、可查询的高血压运动干预数据库，而人工整理难以规模化。我们介绍了借助大语言模型（LLM）构建的 PAHD（Physical Activity for Hypertension Database，高血压身体活动数据库）。一个 LLM 先按标题和摘要、再按全文对 2,548 条 PubMed 记录进行筛选，选出 255 项研究。LLM 提取了每项研究的分组、运动方案、患者特征和结果；两个 LLM 对研究结构进行交叉核对，且每个数值均附有原文逐字引文。代码将提取结果标准化并合并，形成来自 254 项研究的 17,312 条记录，每条对应一个报告的比较。与经裁定的基准相比，筛选的召回率为 86.3%、精确率为 80.6%，提取恢复了 90.1% 的血压数值，精确率为 90.5%。一个网络门户可根据患者的高血压分期和合并症匹配相应研究。PAHD 为高血压管理中的个体化运动干预提供了结构化的证据基础。

title: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
zh_title: 基于社交痕迹的抑郁严重程度估计：心理引导的证据推理
summary: 提出UMer框架，利用用户特异性心理先验与证据推理，从社交媒体文本估计抑郁严重程度，以改进现有分类和量表补全方法。

abstract: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.
zh_abstract: 抑郁严重程度评估对心理健康评估和干预至关重要，但传统方法依赖临床访谈或自评问卷，需要用户主动参与。随着在线社交媒体的广泛使用，用户留下了可能反映其心理状态的丰富社交痕迹，这推动了基于社交媒体的抑郁严重程度评估任务。现有工作已从基于文本特征的分类发展到基于大语言模型（LLM）、针对标准化量表条目的问卷填写，但在用户特异性心理先验建模、多样化语义检索以及对心理证据的细粒度推理方面仍存在不足。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 UMer，一个用于基于社交痕迹的抑郁严重程度评估的用户特异性心理证据推理框架。UMer 首先从历史社交痕迹中提炼出用户特异性的心理先验，以捕捉用户的心理倾向、行为模式和自我表达风格。然后，它进行量表引导的多查询检索，从与条目相关的帖子中构建证据记忆。最后，它进行由粗到细的证据感知推理，以区分直接证据和间接证据，并预测条目级得分并给出可解释的理由。在真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，UMer 不仅相较现有基线取得了有竞争力的性能，还提供了以证据为基础的可解释性，并可泛化到其他基于量表的任务。

title: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance

abstract: Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores. Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Agent-generated rationales informed human-assisted scoring. A consensus expert reference standard covered 215 ICSRs and 1,562 drug-event combinations (DECs) from FAERS (Q1-Q2 2025). Agreement was measured using percentage agreement and Cohen's kappa. Results: Question-level agreement was 96.8% for Naranjo Q2 (kappa = 0.491; 95% CI 0.265-0.663), 85.4% for Q5 (kappa = 0.269; 95% CI 0.180-0.340), and 96.8% for Q10 (kappa = 0.922; 95% CI 0.885-0.951). Final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (95% CI 71.8-85.3; kappa = 0.587, 95% CI 0.450-0.690). In a retrospective subset of 60 DECs, agreement was higher for RAG-labelled than non-RAG scores for Q5 (83.3% vs 65.0%) and Q10 (100.0% vs 18.3%). Discussion: MARCA-assisted assessment showed substantial variation in agreement across Naranjo questions, with lower concordance for alternative causes. Retrospective RAG comparisons are exploratory and do not establish prospective effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 【引言】个体病例安全报告（ICSR）数量不断增加，对药物警戒中由专家主导的因果关系评估构成挑战。我们开发了MARCA（Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment，多智能体检索增强因果关系评估），这是一个基于Naranjo量表评估的四智能体框架，并评估了其与人类专家的一致性，以及非RAG评分与RAG标注评分之间的探索性差异。【方法】MARCA使用Gemini 2.5 Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2，整合了科学文献检索、药品说明书评估、客观证据分类和临床因果推理。智能体生成的推理依据用于辅助人工评分。专家共识参考标准涵盖来自FAERS（2025年第一至第二季度）的215份ICSR和1,562个药物-事件组合（DEC）。一致性采用百分比一致性和Cohen's kappa进行衡量。【结果】Naranjo各问题层面的一致性：Q2为96.8%（kappa = 0.491；95% CI 0.265-0.663），Q5为85.4%（kappa = 0.269；95% CI 0.180-0.340），Q10为96.8%（kappa = 0.922；95% CI 0.885-0.951）。最终因果关系分类的一致性为79.4%（95% CI 71.8-85.3；kappa = 0.587，95% CI 0.450-0.690）。在60个DEC的回顾性子集中，RAG标注评分的一致性高于非RAG评分：Q5为83.3%对65.0%，Q10为100.0%对18.3%。【讨论】MARCA辅助评估在各Naranjo问题之间的一致性差异显著，其中对替代原因的一致性较低。回顾性RAG比较属于探索性分析，不能证明其前瞻性有效性。

title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 超越离散token：医学视觉语言模型中保留数值连续性
summary: 提出HAD-VLM混合自回归-扩散框架，用于提示条件下的超声定量测量，在EchoNet-LVH四项超声心动图测量任务上评估（预印本，未经同行评审）。
key_points: 自回归文本生成与连续测量预测共享骨干
扩散过程预测卡尺端点坐标与长度
采用坐标-长度一致性与集成后处理
reason: 有新意的VLM方法，证据有限，预印本
abstract: Objective: To develop a unified vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that addresses the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-based numerical prediction. Methods: This article presents HAD-VLM, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion framework that combines autoregressive text generation with continuous measurement prediction within a shared backbone. Visual prompt tuning adapts the vision encoder to ultrasound images. A diffusion process predicts a five-component representation comprising caliper endpoint coordinates and measurement length. A post-processing strategy combining the proposed coordinate-length consistency mechanism with ensemble prediction is introduced to refine measurement estimates. We evaluate four echocardiographic measurement tasks on EchoNet-LVH, with additional assessments of medical question answering and X-ray vertebral measurement. Results: HAD-VLM achieves mean absolute errors of 1.36, 2.77, 3.05, and 1.16 mm for IVSd, LVIDd, LVIDs, and LVPWd, respectively, reducing errors by 21.4-37.6\% relative to the Vicuna-based autoregressive baseline. It also outperforms fine-tuned Qwen3-VL and direct MLP regression across all four tasks. Medical question answering performance is preserved on the evaluated dataset. For X-ray vertebral measurement, HAD-VLM reduces mean absolute error from 11.4 to 6.7 pixels. Conclusion: Integrating autoregressive language generation with diffusion-based continuous prediction improves quantitative medical image measurement while retaining prompt-conditioned task flexibility. Significance: HAD-VLM provides a unified approach to combining language interaction with anatomically grounded numerical prediction for quantitative medical image analysis.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发一种统一的视觉-语言模型，用于提示条件下的超声定量测量，以解决连续测量目标与基于离散token的数值预测之间的不匹配问题。【方法】本文提出HAD-VLM，一种混合自回归-扩散框架，在共享骨干网络中将自回归文本生成与连续测量预测相结合。视觉提示微调使视觉编码器适应超声图像。扩散过程预测由测径点端点坐标和测量长度组成的五分量表示。引入一种后处理策略，将所提出的坐标-长度一致性机制与集成预测相结合，以优化测量估计。我们在EchoNet-LVH上评估了四项超声心动图测量任务，并另外评估了医学问答和X线椎体测量。【结果】HAD-VLM在IVSd、LVIDd、LVIDs和LVPWd上的平均绝对误差分别为1.36、2.77、3.05和1.16 mm，相比基于Vicuna的自回归基线，误差降低21.4-37.6%。其在全部四项任务中也优于微调后的Qwen3-VL和直接MLP回归。在所评估的数据集上，医学问答性能得以保持。对于X线椎体测量，HAD-VLM将平均绝对误差从11.4像素降至6.7像素。【结论】将自回归语言生成与基于扩散的连续预测相结合，可改善医学图像定量测量，同时保留提示条件下的任务灵活性。【意义】HAD-VLM为医学图像定量分析提供了一种将语言交互与具有解剖学依据的数值预测相结合的统一方法。

title: Learning Pathology-Sensitive Representations for Unsupervised Retinal OCT Anomaly Detection
zh_title: 面向无监督视网膜OCT异常检测的病理敏感表征学习
summary: 提出无需疾病标注的视网膜OCT异常检测与定位框架，通过解剖感知重建和合成扰动引导的对比三元组学习适配预训练视觉表征（预印本）。
key_points: 基于预训练视觉基础模型适配正常解剖
合成结构扰动引导对比三元组学习
系统考察预训练策略与异常评分机制
reason: 眼科影像新方法，有系统比较，证据有限
abstract: Deep learning approaches for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) predominantly rely on predefined disease categories, limiting their ability to detect rare or previously unseen abnormalities. While visual foundation models provide transferable representations, their effectiveness in identifying pathological deviations from normal retinal anatomy remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce an unsupervised framework for retinal OCT anomaly detection and localization that adapts pretrained visual representations to normal retinal anatomy through anatomy-aware reconstruction and contrastive triplet learning guided by synthetic structural perturbations, without requiring disease-specific annotations. We systematically investigate the influence of pretraining strategies, anatomy-aware representation adaptation, and anomaly scoring mechanisms on the detection and localization of unseen retinal abnormalities. Our findings demonstrate that adapting pretrained representations to normal retinal structure improves anomaly sensitivity, while pixel-space reconstruction errors and feature-space deviations provide complementary signals for identifying pathological changes. These findings underscore the importance of anatomy-aware representation learning and offer insights into developing generalizable retinal anomaly detection frameworks beyond predefined disease categories.
zh_abstract: 用于视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）的深度学习方法主要依赖预先定义的疾病类别，限制了其检测罕见或未见异常的能力。虽然视觉基础模型可提供可迁移的表征，但其在识别偏离正常视网膜解剖结构的病理改变方面的有效性仍未被充分了解。在本研究中，我们提出一种用于视网膜OCT异常检测与定位的无监督框架，该框架通过解剖感知重建以及由合成结构扰动引导的对比三元组学习，使预训练视觉表征适应正常视网膜解剖结构，无需疾病特异性标注。我们系统研究了预训练策略、解剖感知表征适应和异常评分机制对检测与定位未见视网膜异常的影响。研究结果表明，使预训练表征适应正常视网膜结构可提高异常敏感性，而像素空间重建误差与特征空间偏差可为识别病理改变提供互补信号。这些发现强调了解剖感知表征学习的重要性，并为开发超越预定义疾病类别的可泛化视网膜异常检测框架提供了启示。

title: End-to-end prostate lesion segmentation and detection from undersampled diffusion-weighted MRI
zh_title: 基于欠采样扩散加权MRI的端到端前列腺病灶分割与检测
summary: 提出VarNet-Seg，将k空间变分网络与3D U-Net端到端结合，利用多线圈复数DWI数据做前列腺病灶分割，使用269例fastMRI前列腺检查（预印本）。
key_points: 纳入269例检查，64例含PIRADS 4/5病灶
k空间变分网络加图像空间3D分割U-Net
与线圈合并、RSS、SENSE重建对照并做消融
reason: 端到端方法有基线对比，样本较小，预印本
abstract: Automated prostate lesion detection from diffusion-weighted MR imaging (DWI) conventionally relies on reconstructed images and does not fully use all acquisition information. We present an end-to-end network that uses complex multicoil DWI data and coil sensitivity information for prostate lesion segmentation. We included 269 fastMRI prostate examinations with additional voxel-level lesion annotations. Of these, 64 examinations contained PIRADS 4 or 5 lesions. The proposed network, VarNet-Seg, consists of a k-space variational network (VarNet) with six variational cascades and an image-space 3D segmentation U-Net. Comparator models used the same segmentation architecture with fully coil-combined images (CC-Seg), fixed root-sum-of-squares reconstruction (RSS-Seg), or fixed SENSE reconstruction (SENSE-Seg). We performed ablations with end-to-end training and data consistency (DC) enabled or disabled. We evaluated lesion segmentation using Dice and patient-level detection using AUROC in five-fold cross-validation with full sampling, simulated undersampling, added noise, or both. VarNet-Seg achieved the highest Dice at every undersampling level. At eight-fold acceleration, Dice was 0.22 for VarNet-Seg, 0.14 for SENSE-Seg and 0.16 for VarNet-Seg (no DC). The paired difference from SENSE-Seg was 0.08 (95% CI, 0.04-0.11). With full sampling, VarNet-Seg and RSS-Seg performed similarly (0.40 vs 0.39). Patient-level AUROC decreased from 0.75 with full sampling to 0.63 at eight-fold acceleration; corresponding RSS-Seg AUROCs were 0.76 and 0.64. The proposed multicoil network improved prostate lesion segmentation under simulated undersampling compared to conventional models. Matched ablations supported contributions from both end-to-end training and data consistency. Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether this approach can be used clinically in accelerated prostate DWI.
zh_abstract: 基于扩散加权磁共振成像（DWI）的前列腺病灶自动检测通常依赖重建图像，未能充分利用全部采集信息。我们提出一种端到端网络，利用复数多线圈DWI数据和线圈敏感度信息进行前列腺病灶分割。我们纳入了269例fastMRI前列腺检查，并附有额外的体素级病灶标注，其中64例检查含有PIRADS 4或5级病灶。所提出的网络VarNet-Seg由具有六个变分级联的k空间变分网络（VarNet）和图像空间三维分割U-Net组成。对照模型使用相同的分割架构，分别采用完全线圈合并图像（CC-Seg）、固定的平方和根重建（RSS-Seg）或固定的SENSE重建（SENSE-Seg）。我们进行了消融实验，分别启用或禁用端到端训练和数据一致性（DC）。我们在五折交叉验证中，于全采样、模拟欠采样、添加噪声或两者兼有的条件下，以Dice评估病灶分割，以AUROC评估患者水平检测。VarNet-Seg在每个欠采样水平下均获得最高Dice。在八倍加速时，VarNet-Seg的Dice为0.22，SENSE-Seg为0.14，VarNet-Seg（无DC）为0.16。与SENSE-Seg的配对差值为0.08（95% CI，0.04-0.11）。在全采样条件下，VarNet-Seg与RSS-Seg表现相近（0.40对0.39）。患者水平AUROC从全采样时的0.75降至八倍加速时的0.63；对应的RSS-Seg AUROC分别为0.76和0.64。与传统模型相比，所提出的多线圈网络在模拟欠采样条件下改善了前列腺病灶分割。匹配的消融实验支持端到端训练和数据一致性均有贡献。需要开展前瞻性评估，以确定该方法能否用于临床加速前列腺DWI。

title: Compression of Vision Foundation Models for Retinal OCT via Growing-Neural-Gas Codebooks and Graph-Guided Masked Image Modeling
zh_title: 基于GNG码本与图引导掩码建模压缩视网膜OCT基础模型
summary: 提出拓扑感知离散化框架，将视网膜OCT基础模型蒸馏为码本并用于掩码图像建模，把8600万参数教师压缩为2200万参数学生，FLOPs至少减少3.6倍。
key_points: Growing Neural Gas 码本加图距离软交叉熵
仅用383个Duke iAMD OCT体数据预训练学生
学生22M参数，FLOPs降低至少3.6倍
reason: 眼科基础模型压缩有新意，但为预印本，证据有限
abstract: Vision foundation models for retinal imaging are large and computationally demanding, limiting point-of-care deployment. We ask how much of such a model's downstream utility survives compression into a smaller network. We propose a topology-aware discretization framework that distills a continuous foundation model into a discrete codebook, then uses it as the reconstruction target for masked image modeling (MIM). It combines gradient-free codebook learning via Growing Neural Gas, which yields an adjacency graph over the codes, with a graph-distance soft cross-entropy loss that replaces one-hot MIM targets with topologically graded supervision. With student pretraining on 383 public Duke iAMD optical coherence tomography (OCT) volumes, the pipeline distills an 86M-parameter teacher into a 22M-parameter student with at least 3.6x fewer FLOPs. The student performs close to, and in some settings above, its teacher across three classification and two segmentation benchmarks, with the magnitude and direction of the difference depending on the teacher, task, metric, and student capacity. On the external OLIVES benchmark, it surpasses its MIRAGE teacher on every metric (98.06% vs. 95.22% balanced accuracy). It works with two Vision Transformer (ViT-Base) teachers, retinal (MIRAGE) and natural-image (DINOv3); with the out-of-domain teacher, the student outperforms it on retinal-layer segmentation, indicating that the added value of retina-specific pretraining is task-dependent: largest for segmentation, while a general-domain teacher is competitive for classification. These results yield compact retinal models potentially suitable for deployment, transferring across OCT datasets, devices, and clinical tasks, including three datasets not used in the student's pretraining.
zh_abstract: 用于视网膜成像的视觉基础模型体积庞大、计算要求高，限制了其在床旁的部署。我们探讨此类模型的下游效用在压缩为更小网络后能保留多少。我们提出了一种拓扑感知离散化框架，将连续的基础模型蒸馏为离散码本，再将其用作掩码图像建模（MIM）的重建目标。该框架结合了通过Growing Neural Gas进行的无梯度码本学习（可生成码之间的邻接图），以及一种图距离软交叉熵损失，用拓扑分级的监督取代独热的MIM目标。利用383个公开的Duke iAMD光学相干断层扫描（OCT）容积数据对学生模型进行预训练，该流程将8600万参数的教师模型蒸馏为2200万参数的学生模型，FLOPs至少减少3.6倍。在三个分类基准和两个分割基准上，学生模型的表现接近其教师模型，在某些设置下甚至更优，差异的幅度和方向取决于教师模型、任务、指标和学生模型容量。在外部OLIVES基准上，其在每项指标上均超过其MIRAGE教师模型（平衡准确率98.06%对95.22%）。该方法适用于两种Vision Transformer（ViT-Base）教师模型，即视网膜专用的（MIRAGE）和自然图像的（DINOv3）；使用域外教师模型时，学生模型在视网膜层分割上优于该教师，表明视网膜特异性预训练的附加价值取决于任务：对分割最大，而通用领域教师模型在分类上具有竞争力。这些结果产生了可能适合部署的紧凑型视网膜模型，可在不同OCT数据集、设备和临床任务之间迁移，包括三个未用于学生模型预训练的数据集。

title: AlphaGenome informed machine learning for pathogenicity prediction of germline mutations
zh_title: AlphaGenome 赋能的胚系突变致病性预测模型 AGVarPred
summary: 预印本提出梯度提升分类器 AGVarPred，整合 gnomAD 频率、VEP 注释与 AlphaGenome 功能基因组评分，覆盖 SNV 与插入缺失，在 ClinVar 基因级划分测试中 AUC-ROC 为 0.9753。
key_points: 基于 134,002 个 ClinVar 变异、9,222 个基因，按基因划分
整合 gnomAD、Ensembl VEP 与 AlphaGenome 评分
覆盖剪接位点、UTR、内含子等非编码区变异
reason: 预印本，基因级划分有一定验证，但无独立临床外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate interpretation of germline variants remains a central challenge in clinical genomics. Existing in silico pathogenicity predictors often provide incomplete coverage or restricted to missense variants from the coding region, leaving the variants from splice sites, -UTR, and intronic regions under-scored. We present AGVarPred, a gradient-boosted classifier designed to predict the pathogenicity of germline mutants, with a broad consequence-class coverage across SNVs and indels. Here, the population allele frequency from gnomAD, functional consequence annotations from Ensembl VEP, and cell-type-specific functional genomic scores from the AlphaGenome platform were integrated to develop the classifier. Using a gene-level split of 134,002 high-confidence ClinVar variants across 9,222 genes, AGVarPred achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.9753 (95% CI 0.9731-0.9775) and a AUC-PR of 0.9606 on 12,385 scored internal test variants. A paired DeLong analysis showed that the full model significantly outperformed an allele-frequency-plus-VEP model ({Delta}AUC = 0.1539, 95% CI 0.1489-0.1589; p < 1 x 10-300), supporting a substantial incremental contribution from AlphaGenome-derived features. Performance remained strong when restricted to SNVs (AUC-ROC 0.9558) and was also high for indels (AUC-ROC 0.9532). On five external benchmarks, AUC-ROCs ranged from 0.528 on a functional-assay-derived benchmark to 0.977 on a clinically curated deafness database, reflecting its dependence on benchmark composition and label source. A separate analysis of the VIP Database, whose pathogenic labels are ClinVar-derived, showed consistent performance (AUC-ROC of 0.892) in held-out genes. AGVarPred scored 100% of evaluated variants in the external benchmarks, whereas AlphaMissense and REVEL covered only small fractions of non-missense variants. Model interpretation indicated that gnomAD allele frequency was the dominant individual predictor; the 111 AlphaGenome features provided complementary functional signal, with splicing and chromatin assays contributing to the largest share of the AlphaGenome SHAP mass. A web-based interface for AGVarPred is available at https://pankaj357.github.io/AGVarPred/ to facilitate the submission of normalized GRCh38 germline variants and retrieval of pathogenicity predictions using the frozen AGVarPred model.
zh_abstract: 准确解读胚系变异仍是临床基因组学的核心挑战。现有的计算机模拟致病性预测工具往往覆盖不全，或仅限于编码区的错义变异，使得剪接位点、-UTR和内含子区域的变异评分不足。我们提出了AGVarPred，这是一种梯度提升分类器，旨在预测胚系突变的致病性，对SNV和插入缺失（indel）具有广泛的后果类别覆盖。该分类器整合了gnomAD的人群等位基因频率、Ensembl VEP的功能后果注释，以及AlphaGenome平台的细胞类型特异性功能基因组评分。基于涉及9,222个基因的134,002个高置信度ClinVar变异，采用基因水平划分，AGVarPred在12,385个获得评分的内部测试变异上取得了0.9753的AUC-ROC（95% CI 0.9731–0.9775）和0.9606的AUC-PR。配对DeLong分析显示，完整模型显著优于等位基因频率加VEP模型（ΔAUC = 0.1539，95% CI 0.1489–0.1589；p < 1 x 10-300），支持来自AlphaGenome的特征具有显著的增量贡献。仅限于SNV时性能依然强劲（AUC-ROC 0.9558），对indel同样较高（AUC-ROC 0.9532）。在五个外部基准上，AUC-ROC从基于功能实验的基准上的0.528到临床整理的耳聋数据库上的0.977不等，反映出其对基准构成和标签来源的依赖性。对VIP数据库（其致病标签源自ClinVar）的单独分析显示，在留出基因中性能一致（AUC-ROC为0.892）。AGVarPred对外部基准中100%的被评估变异进行了评分，而AlphaMissense和REVEL仅覆盖一小部分非错义变异。模型解释表明，gnomAD等位基因频率是占主导地位的单个预测因子；111个AlphaGenome特征提供了互补的功能信号，其中剪接和染色质检测在AlphaGenome SHAP贡献中占最大份额。AGVarPred的网页界面可通过 https://pankaj357.github.io/AGVarPred/ 访问，便于提交标准化的GRCh38胚系变异，并使用冻结的AGVarPred模型获取致病性预测。

title: Spectrally optimized implicit neural representations mitigate acquisition-related image quality trade-offs in intracranial 4D Flow MRI
zh_title: 谱优化隐式神经表示缓解颅内4D Flow MRI画质权衡
summary: 提出基于WIRE激活函数、谱偏置可调的隐式神经表示框架，无监督重建颅内4D Flow MRI速度场，以缓解分辨率、时间与噪声权衡。
key_points: 无需配对高分辨率训练数据
速度场表示为连续坐标神经场
针对不同解剖、疾病严重度与采集质量的稳健性
reason: 有新意的无监督重建方法，预印本，证据有限
abstract: 4D Flow MRI promises opportunities for non-invasive mapping of neurovascular hemodynamics, but its clinical utility faces trade-offs between resolution, acquisition time, and noise. Deep learning-based super-resolution offers a post-scan solution, but supervised approaches require paired or domain-specific data, while patient-specific physics-informed models can be computationally demanding. This creates a need for unsupervised reconstruction models that can adapt to individual acquisitions without paired high-resolution training data, while remaining robust across anatomy, disease severity, and acquisition quality. To address this, we introduce a spectrally tuned implicit neural representation (INR) framework for intracranial 4D Flow MRI, representing the velocity field as a continuous coordinate-based neural field using WIRE activation functions with tunable spectral bias. Data-driven and physics-informed variants were evaluated in nine cerebrovascular cases spanning healthy controls and moderate-to-severe intracranial atherosclerotic disease, using CFD-derived high-resolution reference fields, MR-realistic synthetic low-resolution inputs, and direct fitting to acquired in-vivo data. Cohort-optimal spectral-bias settings generalized across subjects with only small increases in relative error compared with subject-specific optima, reducing the need for case-specific hyperparameter tuning. Physics-informed regularization provided modest additional accuracy but required substantially longer optimization, whereas the data-driven INR achieved near-comparable reconstruction performance within minutes. The framework also remained robust to acquisition-realistic noise and moderate VENC-dependent aliasing. These findings establish spectrally optimized INRs as a flexible unsupervised approach for mitigating acquisition-related trade-offs in intracranial 4D Flow MRI.
zh_abstract: 4D Flow MRI有望实现神经血管血流动力学的无创成像，但其临床应用受到分辨率、采集时间和噪声之间权衡的限制。基于深度学习的超分辨率提供了一种扫描后解决方案，但有监督方法需要配对数据或特定领域数据，而针对患者的物理信息模型计算量可能很大。因此需要无监督重建模型，能够在无需配对高分辨率训练数据的情况下适应个体采集，同时在不同解剖结构、疾病严重程度和采集质量下保持稳健。为此，我们提出一种用于颅内4D Flow MRI的频谱调谐隐式神经表示（INR）框架，使用具有可调频谱偏置的WIRE激活函数，将速度场表示为连续的基于坐标的神经场。我们在九个脑血管病例（涵盖健康对照以及中重度颅内动脉粥样硬化疾病）中评估了数据驱动和物理信息两种变体，采用基于CFD的高分辨率参考场、符合MR特性的合成低分辨率输入，以及对实际采集的在体数据的直接拟合。队列最优的频谱偏置设置可在受试者间泛化，与受试者特异性最优设置相比相对误差仅小幅增加，从而减少了针对个案进行超参数调优的需求。物理信息正则化带来的额外精度提升有限，但需要明显更长的优化时间，而数据驱动INR在数分钟内即可达到接近的重建性能。该框架对符合实际采集情况的噪声和中等程度的VENC相关混叠也保持稳健。这些发现表明，频谱优化的INR是一种灵活的无监督方法，可缓解颅内4D Flow MRI中与采集相关的权衡问题。

title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
zh_title: 自动化实验室中智能体自博弈的语义表示（VERID）
summary: 提出VERID，一种实验室工作单元的语义数字孪生基础设施，连接AI智能体推理与湿实验的物理执行。
key_points: 持续运行的高保真实验室语义数字孪生
提供可查询自省与时间压缩仿真等核心服务
面向生物发现中的智能体迭代自博弈
reason: AI驱动生物发现基础设施，预印本，摘要缺实证细节
abstract: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. Translating experimental designs into reliable physical execution remains bottlenecked by static laboratory automation and unmodeled physical variability. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. VERID is a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that provides four core services: queryable introspection for agentic reasoning, time-compressed simulation for protocol validation, comprehensive trace persistence for a complete scientific record, and a framework for safe execution. We present three case studies using aqueous dye and deionized water mixtures to validate the optical and fluidic foundations of VERID. These studies demonstrate how VERID enables pre-emptive detection of critical errors in experimental protocols, stateful mid-run error recovery and post-hoc identification of subtle physical failures. The simulation functions as a discrete accounting engine, allowing agents to safely and inexpensively explore experimental designs in silico and refine experimental strategies through iterative self-play. VERID also captures structured multimodal experimental data for downstream analysis, knowledge mining and agent training. We argue that this semantic layer is an essential prerequisite for deploying autonomous agents in the biochemical and biomedical sciences, ensuring data integrity, operational safety, and paving the way for tackling previously intractable grand challenges in biology.
zh_abstract: 在复杂的高维生物学搜索空间中进行探索，需要可扩展的物理智能与计算智能，通过在构想、实验和自动化之间的迭代自我博弈来超越局部最优。将实验设计转化为可靠的物理执行，仍受限于静态的实验室自动化以及未建模的物理变异性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了用于发现型实验室的经验证基础设施（VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories，VERID），这是一种基础性基础设施，旨在弥合人工智能（AI）智能体的高层推理与湿实验室中复杂、易出错的物理现实之间的差距。VERID是实验室工作单元的持久化、高保真语义数字孪生，提供四项核心服务：面向智能体推理的可查询内省、用于方案验证的时间压缩模拟、用于形成完整科学记录的全面轨迹持久化，以及安全执行框架。我们使用水性染料与去离子水混合物开展了三个案例研究，以验证VERID的光学和流体基础。这些研究展示了VERID如何实现对实验方案中关键错误的预先检测、有状态的运行中错误恢复，以及对细微物理故障的事后识别。该模拟作为离散核算引擎运行，使智能体能够在计算机中安全且低成本地探索实验设计，并通过迭代自我博弈完善实验策略。VERID还可采集结构化的多模态实验数据，用于下游分析、知识挖掘和智能体训练。我们认为，这一语义层是在生物化学和生物医学科学中部署自主智能体的必要前提，可确保数据完整性和操作安全，并为应对此前难以解决的生物学重大挑战铺平道路。

title: Image-Based Dietary Assessment Using Multimodal Large Language Models: Performance, Limitations, and Clinical Applicability in Diabetes
zh_title: 多模态大模型用于糖尿病饮食图像评估：性能与局限
summary: 构建开源基准SeeFood，在SNAPMe餐食照片上评估8个多模态大模型的营养素估计、食物识别与饮食质量评分；GPT-4o mini误差最低。
key_points: 80张照片评估8个模型，3个入围模型用1680张照片复评
评估热量、碳水、蛋白、脂肪、纤维及HEI-2020
按餐型、份量、参照标记等分析最佳模型误差
reason: 新基准与多模态LLM评估，但样本有限、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Background Image-based dietary assessment is useful for precision diabetes care. Multimodal Large Language Models (mLLMs) may greatly facilitate dietary self-monitoring. However, comprehensive evaluation of their real-world accuracy remains limited. Methods We developed SeeFood, an open-source benchmark, and evaluated eight commercial and open-source mLLMs on 80 real-world meal photographs from the SNAPMe dataset for nutrient and energy estimation (calories, carbohydrates, protein, fat, fiber), food-item identification, and day-level diet quality (Healthy Eating Index, HEI-2020). Three finalists were evaluated on the complete dataset (1680 photographs, 275 participant-days), and the best model was analyzed by meal type, portion size, sizing-marker use, ingredient visibility and meal complexity. Results GPT-4o mini achieved the lowest errors, with a significant advantage for carbohydrates; the three finalists performed similarly on other outcomes and on HEI-2020. Mean absolute percentage errors (MAPE) remained high (52%--90%), and the direction of bias was model-specific. The carbohydrate mean absolute error was 13.3 g (95% CI 12.4--14.3), and only 57% of meals were within +/- 10 g, a clinically relevant threshold for insulin dosing in type 1 diabetes. Calorie errors for lunch and dinner were in the range reported for human estimation on other images (~55% MAPE), whereas drink-only images had the highest relative errors (312% MAPE) because of dissolved sugars. Food items were reliably identified when fully visible (Dice = 0.74), and HEI-2020 estimates showed moderate agreement with reference values (RMSE = 12.5 points; r = 0.61). Larger portions were increasingly underestimated, and sizing references did not improve accuracy. Newer or larger models and chain-of-thought prompting did not consistently improve performance. Conclusions Current mLLMs can extract meaningful dietary information from real-world meal photographs, but substantial errors in nutrient and portion-size estimation currently limit their use for precision diabetes management. Integrating visual assessment with additional contextual information may enable more reliable, lower-burden dietary monitoring.

title: AI-Guided Histopathological and Molecular Phenotyping of Salivary Glands in Sjögren's Disease: Subtyping, Mechanistic Insights, and Translational Implications-A Systematic Review and Structured Functional Synthesis.
zh_title: AI引导的干燥综合征唾液腺组织病理与分子表型：系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入25项研究，评估AI/ML在干燥综合征唾液腺组织病理和分子分型中的应用，表型涵盖免疫/干扰素激活、组织结构、上皮应激等。
key_points: 检索PubMed、Scopus、Embase，纳入25项研究
AI/ML识别免疫、组织结构及上皮应激等表型
因方法异质性采用功能性综合而非定量合并
reason: 综述类、方法异质，属增量档；病理方向略加分
abstract: [Medical sciences (Basel, Switzerland)] Salivary-gland biopsy is central to Sjögren's disease (SjD) assessment, but conventional measures incompletely capture glandular heterogeneity. This systematic review evaluated artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) applications to SjD salivary-gland histopathology and molecular profiling, including biological and translational validation. PubMed, Scopus, and Embase were searched. Eligible studies used salivary-gland tissue as the primary analytical substrate or provided substantive glandular validation of systemic AI/ML findings. Evidence was synthesized functionally because of methodological heterogeneity. Twenty-five studies were included. AI/ML identified histopathological and molecular phenotypes spanning immune/interferon activation, tissue architecture and immune-cell organization, epithelial stress and metabolic/cell-death remodeling, and translational response. Only a limited subset progressed beyond computational or tissue-level confirmation to functional perturbation, pharmacological testing, in vivo validation, or human treatment-response assessment. Recurrent public-dataset reuse, small cohorts, heterogeneous pipelines, and limited independent validation constrained reproducibility. AI/ML supports multidimensional SjD glandular phenotyping and shows emerging translational potential, but demonstrated clinical or therapeutic utility remains unestablished. Prospective multicenter validation is required before AI-derived glandular phenotypes can inform routine patient stratification or therapeutic decision-making.
zh_abstract: [Medical sciences (Basel, Switzerland)] 唾液腺活检是干燥综合征（SjD）评估的核心，但传统指标不能完全反映腺体的异质性。本系统综述评估了人工智能（AI）/机器学习（ML）在SjD唾液腺组织病理学和分子谱分析中的应用，包括生物学和转化验证。检索了PubMed、Scopus和Embase。符合条件的研究以唾液腺组织作为主要分析基质，或对系统性AI/ML结果提供了实质性的腺体验证。由于方法学异质性，证据按功能进行综合。共纳入25项研究。AI/ML识别出的组织病理学和分子表型涵盖免疫/干扰素活化、组织结构和免疫细胞组织、上皮应激和代谢/细胞死亡重塑以及转化反应。只有少数研究从计算或组织水平的确认进一步推进到功能性干预、药理学检测、体内验证或人体治疗反应评估。公共数据集的反复使用、队列规模小、分析流程异质以及独立验证有限，限制了可重复性。AI/ML支持对SjD腺体进行多维表型分析，并显示出新兴的转化潜力，但其已证实的临床或治疗效用尚未确立。在AI衍生的腺体表型可用于常规患者分层或治疗决策之前，需要进行前瞻性多中心验证。

title: Multivariate Augmented Prediction-Powered Survival Inference for EHR Association Studies With Limited Chart Review
zh_title: 有限病历审阅下EHR生存关联研究的MAPS推断方法
summary: 提出MAPS回归，结合病历审阅标签与计算表型标签，以降低EHR生存关联研究的偏倚并提高精度。
key_points: 离散时间生存模型，complementary log-log链接估计HR
含数据自适应增强权重与逆概率抽样权重
在模拟及1,026例免疫检查点抑制剂患者irAE研究中比较
reason: 统计方法预印本，验证范围有限，属增量档
abstract: Objective: To reduce bias and improve precision in survival association studies using electronic health record (EHR) data when computational phenotypes (CPs) for outcomes and covariates are error-prone and chart review is limited. Materials and Methods: We developed Multivariate Augmented Prediction-Powered Survival (MAPS) regression, which combines chart-reviewed and CP-derived labels across different validation patterns. MAPS uses a discrete-time survival model with a complementary log-log link to estimate hazard ratios (HRs). It incorporates data-adaptive augmentation weights, inverse-probability sampling weights, and patient-level cluster-robust variance estimation. We compared MAPS with chart-reviewed data (CRD) and CP-only analyses in simulation studies and a masked-validation study of immune-related adverse events (irAEs) among 1,026 patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors. Results: In the main simulations, MAPS produced approximately unbiased estimates and generally near-nominal 95% confidence interval (CI) coverage, with narrower intervals than CRD. CP-only estimates became increasingly biased as CP errors increased. In the EHR analysis, MAPS estimates closely agreed with fully validated estimates and improved precision over CRD, particularly at lower validation rates. CP-only analysis suggested increased irAE risk associated with pre-existing autoimmune disease (AID; HR=1.53; 95% CI, 1.12-2.09), whereas the fully validated analysis did not (HR=0.93; 95% CI, 0.67-1.29). Discussion: Precision gains depended on CP quality and validation rates, while small validation samples may affect confidence interval coverage. Conclusion: MAPS provides a flexible and efficient approach to EHR-based survival inference by combining limited chart-reviewed data with error-prone CPs across different validation patterns.
zh_abstract: 【目的】当结局和协变量的计算表型（CP）易出错且病历审查有限时，减少使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据开展生存关联研究中的偏倚并提高精确度。【材料与方法】我们开发了多变量增强预测驱动生存（MAPS）回归，它在不同验证模式下结合病历审查标签和CP衍生标签。MAPS采用带互补双对数（complementary log-log）连接函数的离散时间生存模型来估计风险比（HR），并纳入数据自适应增强权重、逆概率抽样权重以及患者水平的聚类稳健方差估计。我们在模拟研究以及一项针对1,026名接受免疫检查点抑制剂治疗患者的免疫相关不良事件（irAE）的掩蔽验证研究中，将MAPS与病历审查数据（CRD）分析和仅CP分析进行了比较。【结果】在主要模拟中，MAPS产生的估计大致无偏，95%置信区间（CI）覆盖率总体接近名义水平，且区间比CRD更窄。随着CP误差增大，仅CP估计的偏倚越来越大。在EHR分析中，MAPS估计与完全验证后的估计高度一致，并较CRD提高了精确度，在验证率较低时尤为明显。仅CP分析提示既往自身免疫性疾病（AID）与irAE风险增加相关（HR=1.53；95% CI，1.12-2.09），而完全验证分析则未显示这一点（HR=0.93；95% CI，0.67-1.29）。【讨论】精确度的提高取决于CP质量和验证率，而较小的验证样本可能影响置信区间覆盖率。【结论】MAPS通过在不同验证模式下将有限的病历审查数据与易出错的CP相结合，为基于EHR的生存推断提供了一种灵活且高效的方法。

title: Shifted Window Temporal Transformer for YOLO-Guided Phase Recognition in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Surgery
zh_title: 面向腹腔镜胆囊切除术阶段识别的移位窗口时序Transformer与YOLO引导方法
summary: 提出结合Swin Transformer、时序Transformer编码器与YOLOv11s器械定位的框架，在Cholec80上同时识别手术阶段与器械。
key_points: Swin与时序编码器用于手术阶段识别
并行YOLOv11s进行实时器械定位
因果时序平滑以减少阶段预测抖动
reason: 单一公开数据集的预印本方法，无外部验证，增量档
abstract: Intelligent operating rooms require accurate awareness of surgical workflow for better intra-operative decisions, teamwork, and surgical documentation. Therefore, accurately recognizing surgical phase during surgery is crucial. However, previous artificial intelligence-based methods provide fluctuating predictions for the transitions, restricting their clinical use. To address this challenge, we propose a clinically meaningful framework that integrates a Swin Transformer and Temporal Transformer Encoder (TTE) for effective surgical phase recognition and a parallel YOLOv11s network for real-time surgical instrument localization. To avoid phase flickering and to produce stable workflow predictions, a causal temporal smoothing is applied. The proposed framework is tested on the Cholec80 dataset for the simultaneous recognition of the surgical phases and instruments. The overall phase recognition accuracy of this model was 92%, and the macro average F1-score was 0.86. This performance surpasses CNN based methods such as EndoNet (81.7%) and SV-RCNet (85.3%), as well as temporal convolutional and transformer-based approaches including TeCNO (88.6%), Trans-SVNet (90.9%), and LoViT (91.5%). Besides, the module of instrument detection achieved mAP@0.5 = 0.863. The reliability of the results is confirmed, obtaining a high recognition rate of the workflows, and a high accuracy of the localization of the instruments. The proposed framework can serve as a foundation for intelligent surgical assistance, enriching situation awareness, and potential robotic surgery applications. Code will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80
zh_abstract: 智能手术室需要对手术工作流程有准确的感知，以便做出更好的术中决策、开展团队协作并完成手术记录。因此，在手术过程中准确识别手术阶段至关重要。然而，以往基于人工智能的方法在阶段转换时给出的预测存在波动，限制了其临床应用。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种具有临床意义的框架，该框架整合了Swin Transformer和时序Transformer编码器（Temporal Transformer Encoder，TTE）以实现有效的手术阶段识别，并结合并行的YOLOv11s网络实现实时手术器械定位。为避免阶段闪烁并产生稳定的工作流程预测，应用了因果时序平滑。所提出的框架在Cholec80数据集上进行了测试，用于同时识别手术阶段和器械。该模型的总体阶段识别准确率为92%，宏平均F1分数为0.86。该表现超过了基于CNN的方法，如EndoNet（81.7%）和SV-RCNet（85.3%），也超过了时序卷积和基于Transformer的方法，包括TeCNO（88.6%）、Trans-SVNet（90.9%）和LoViT（91.5%）。此外，器械检测模块的mAP@0.5 = 0.863。结果的可靠性得到证实，工作流程识别率高，器械定位准确度高。所提出的框架可作为智能手术辅助、增强情境感知以及潜在机器人手术应用的基础。代码将公开发布于：https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80

title: FlexiMIND: Combined Pretrained Vision Features and Local Structure for Training-Free Deformable Medical Image Registration
zh_title: FlexiMIND：结合预训练视觉特征与局部结构的免训练可变形医学图像配准
summary: 提出免训练、免标注的两阶段配准框架，冻结FlexiCT-2D特征建立对应，MIND-SSC在ConvexAdam中细化形变，并比较多种特征耦合策略。
key_points: 冻结预训练编码器特征提供上下文对应
MIND-SSC在ConvexAdam中细化形变
在CT-CT、MR-MR等多数据集评估
reason: 新方法有多数据集比较，但样本小、预印本
abstract: Objective. Deformable image registration remains challenging because corresponding anatomy may exhibit different intensity relationships. Hand-crafted modality-robust descriptors such as Modality-Independent Neighborhood Descriptor with Self-Similarity Context (MIND-SSC) and features from pretrained vision encoders provide distinct representations for correspondence estimation, but how they should be combined remains unclear. We investigate whether tighter integration improves registration over a sequential, scale-separated design. Approach. We introduce FlexiMIND, a training-free and label-free two-stage framework in which frozen FlexiCT-2D encoder features establish contextual correspondence and MIND-SSC refines the deformation within ConvexAdam. Five alternative feature-coupling strategies were evaluated under a protocol across CT-CT (DIR-Lab 4DCT 4DCT, 10 cases), MR-MR (ACDC, 50 patients), and MR-CT (Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT, 8 pairs) registration. Performance was assessed using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (Dice), SDlogJ, and local folding. Main results. FlexiMIND achieved a TRE of 1.27 mm on DIR-Lab 4DCT, a DSC of 0.807 on ACDC, and an organ-averaged DSC of 0.825 on Abdomen MR-CT. Across 15 coupling-strategy dataset comparisons, only four outperformed the reference method, with a maximum absolute improvement of 0.0043 in Dice, whereas degradation reached 20.6 % in TRE and 37.9 % in Dice. Changes in registration accuracy were closely associated with changes in deformation-field regularity, and strategies that better preserved regularity generally remained closest to the reference performance. Landmark-level analysis showed that the pretrained encoder stage primarily reduced large correspondence errors rather than uniformly improving local precision. Code is available upon acceptance at https://github.com/mosaf/FlexiMIND.
zh_abstract:
目的：可变形图像配准仍具挑战性，因为对应的解剖结构可能表现出不同的强度关系。手工设计的模态鲁棒描述符，如带自相似上下文的模态无关邻域描述符（Modality-Independent Neighborhood Descriptor with Self-Similarity Context，MIND-SSC），以及预训练视觉编码器的特征，为对应关系估计提供了不同的表示，但二者应如何结合尚不明确。我们研究相较于顺序的、尺度分离的设计，更紧密的整合是否能改善配准。
方法：我们提出FlexiMIND，一种无需训练、无需标签的两阶段框架，其中冻结的FlexiCT-2D编码器特征用于建立上下文对应关系，MIND-SSC在ConvexAdam中细化形变。在CT-CT（DIR-Lab 4DCT，10例）、MR-MR（ACDC，50例患者）和MR-CT（Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT，8对）配准的统一方案下，评估了五种替代的特征耦合策略。采用目标配准误差（TRE）、Dice相似系数（Dice）、SDlogJ和局部折叠评估性能。
主要结果：FlexiMIND在DIR-Lab 4DCT上的TRE为1.27 mm，在ACDC上的DSC为0.807，在Abdomen MR-CT上的器官平均DSC为0.825。在15项耦合策略-数据集比较中，仅有四项优于参考方法，Dice的最大绝对提升为0.0043，而TRE最多下降20.6%，Dice最多下降37.9%。配准精度的变化与形变场规则性的变化密切相关，更好地保持规则性的策略通常最接近参考性能。标志点层面的分析显示，预训练编码器阶段主要减少了较大的对应误差，而非均匀提升局部精度。代码将在论文被接收后发布于 https://github.com/mosaf/FlexiMIND。

title: Assistive and adaptive technologies for dyscalculia: a bibliometric review and narrative synthesis of AI-supported screening and learning support.
source: PubMed · Disability and rehabilitation. Assistive technology
zh_title: 计算障碍辅助与自适应技术：AI筛查与学习支持的文献计量综述
summary: 对2005–2025年83篇文献做文献计量与叙事综合，梳理AI、自适应学习和辅助技术在计算障碍研究中的定位。
key_points: 纳入Web of Science与Scopus的83篇论文
分析关键词、共现网络与主题演化
早期偏神经认知解释，近期研究范围拓宽
reason: 小范围文献计量综述，综述类上限低
abstract: [Disability and rehabilitation. Assistive technology] This study aimed to map the development of assistive and adaptive technology-supported approaches to dyscalculia between 2005 and 2025 and to clarify how artificial intelligence, adaptive learning, and assistive technologies are positioned within this research field. A bibliometric review, complemented by a narrative synthesis, was conducted using 83 unique journal publications indexed in Web of Science and Scopus. The analysis included keyword frequency analysis, title-term distribution, keyword co-occurrence networks, thematic mapping, thematic evolution, and country-level collaboration analysis. The findings show that early research was largely grounded in neurocognitive explanations of dyscalculia, particularly numerical processing, working memory, and developmental learning difficulties. Recent publications indicate a broadening towards digital interventions, adaptive learning environments, serious games, augmented reality applications, and AI-supported assistive technologies. Studies using machine learning, deep learning, and probabilistic models suggest potential uses of AI for early screening, personalised feedback, individualised support, and cognitive support. However, AI remains an emerging rather than fully central organising theme. The review identified international collaboration patterns across Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and North America, alongside methodological and ethical issues, including limited longitudinal evidence, variability in intervention designs, biases in database and keyword selection, data privacy, and algorithmic transparency. Technology-assisted dyscalculia research has expanded from cognitive and developmental explanations towards more intervention-oriented, adaptive, and assistive technology-informed approaches. AI-supported assistive technologies appear promising for early identification, accessibility, individualised learning support, and participation in mathematics-related activities, but require stronger empirical validation, ethical implementation, user-centred evaluation, and integration into educational and rehabilitation-related support contexts.
zh_abstract: [残疾与康复。辅助技术] 本研究旨在梳理2005年至2025年间辅助与适应性技术支持的计算障碍（dyscalculia）干预方法的发展，并阐明人工智能、自适应学习和辅助技术在该研究领域中的定位。研究采用文献计量学综述，并辅以叙事性综合，纳入Web of Science和Scopus收录的83篇不重复期刊论文。分析内容包括关键词频率分析、标题词分布、关键词共现网络、主题图谱、主题演变以及国家层面的合作分析。结果显示，早期研究主要基于计算障碍的神经认知解释，特别是数字加工、工作记忆和发育性学习困难。近期的出版物表明，研究范围已拓展至数字化干预、自适应学习环境、严肃游戏、增强现实应用以及人工智能支持的辅助技术。使用机器学习、深度学习和概率模型的研究提示，人工智能可用于早期筛查、个性化反馈、个体化支持和认知支持。然而，人工智能仍属于新兴主题，而非完全居于核心地位的组织性主题。本综述发现了亚洲、中东、欧洲和北美之间的国际合作模式，同时也指出了方法学和伦理方面的问题，包括纵向证据有限、干预设计存在差异、数据库和关键词选择存在偏倚、数据隐私以及算法透明度。技术辅助的计算障碍研究已从认知和发育层面的解释，扩展到更以干预为导向、具有适应性并以辅助技术为基础的方法。人工智能支持的辅助技术在早期识别、可及性、个体化学习支持以及参与数学相关活动方面显示出前景，但仍需要更有力的实证验证、符合伦理的实施、以用户为中心的评估，以及与教育和康复相关支持环境的整合。

title: [Digital technology and sensors around the "patient journey" in trauma surgery].

abstract: [Unfallchirurgie (Heidelberg, Germany)] Technological progress in orthopedic trauma surgery is increasingly shifting from implant refinement to the digital augmentation and representation of the entire treatment pathway, the "patient journey" in order to be able to depict this longitudinally and to detect complications and negative influencing factors at an early stage. This narrative review explores new opportunities and developmental trends along this "patient journey", specifically focusing on the preoperative and postoperative treatment phases.
zh_abstract: [创伤外科（德国海德堡）] 骨科创伤外科的技术进步正日益从植入物的改进转向对整个治疗路径，即“患者旅程”的数字化增强与呈现，以便对其进行纵向描绘，并及早发现并发症和不利影响因素。本叙述性综述探讨了沿这一“患者旅程”出现的新机遇和发展趋势，特别聚焦于术前和术后治疗阶段。

title: Applications of Artificial Intelligence in Parasitology: A holistic perspective from diagnosis to therapeutics.
zh_title: AI在寄生虫学中的应用：从诊断到治疗的综合视角
summary: 叙述性综述，梳理AI在寄生虫检测、药物发现、基因组、流行病学和公共卫生决策中的应用，重点是显微图像诊断。
key_points: 机器学习用于显微图像中寄生虫检测与分类
涵盖疟疾、利什曼病、血吸虫病等
延伸至化合物筛选、药物重定位与毒性预测
reason: 叙述性综述，泛泛概述，属增量档
abstract: [Experimental parasitology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being investigated to address challenges in parasite detection, disease surveillance, and therapeutic development. This narrative review examines current and emerging AI applications in parasitology across diagnostics, drug discovery, genomics, epidemiology, education, and public health decision-making, with particular emphasis on diagnostic applications. Machine learning and deep learning methods support automated parasite detection, classification, and quantification in microscopic images, alongside medical image analysis and arthropod identification. Applications are discussed for malaria, leishmaniasis, schistosomiasis, cystic echinococcosis, soil-transmitted helminth infections, and intestinal protozoal infections. Beyond diagnosis, AI-assisted approaches support compound screening, drug repurposing, toxicity prediction, and prioritization of potential therapeutic targets. Genomic and transcriptomic analyses also offer opportunities to investigate parasite biology and predict drug resistance. Surveillance models may inform outbreak forecasting and targeted control, although their operational value requires evaluation in the intended settings. Educational applications remain emerging, and the benefits of digital learning should be distinguished from those attributable specifically to AI. Across these domains, performance on curated datasets does not establish clinical utility or generalizability. Major barriers include limited representative datasets, insufficient external and prospective validation, infrastructure constraints, and concerns regarding privacy, bias, and accountability. Future progress requires reproducible evaluation, experimental validation of therapeutic candidates, and assessment of clinical and public health benefits. AI is therefore best positioned as a complementary tool that supports parasitological expertise, with responsible implementation guided by transparency, equitable access, and human oversight.
zh_abstract: [实验寄生虫学] 人工智能（AI）在应对寄生虫检测、疾病监测和治疗药物开发方面的挑战中正受到越来越多的研究。本叙述性综述探讨了AI在寄生虫学中的现有及新兴应用，涵盖诊断、药物发现、基因组学、流行病学、教育和公共卫生决策，并特别侧重于诊断应用。机器学习和深度学习方法支持在显微图像中自动检测、分类和定量寄生虫，同时也支持医学图像分析和节肢动物鉴定。文中讨论了其在疟疾、利什曼病、血吸虫病、囊型包虫病、土源性蠕虫感染及肠道原虫感染中的应用。除诊断外，AI辅助方法还支持化合物筛选、药物重定位、毒性预测以及潜在治疗靶点的优先排序。基因组和转录组分析也为研究寄生虫生物学及预测耐药性提供了机会。监测模型可为疫情预测和针对性防控提供参考，但其实际应用价值需要在目标场景中加以评估。教育方面的应用仍处于起步阶段，数字化学习带来的益处应与AI本身带来的益处加以区分。在上述各个领域，在经过整理的数据集上的表现并不能证明其临床实用性或可推广性。主要障碍包括具有代表性的数据集有限、外部验证和前瞻性验证不足、基础设施限制，以及对隐私、偏倚和问责的担忧。未来的进展需要可重复的评估、对候选治疗药物的实验验证，以及对临床和公共卫生获益的评估。因此，AI最适合作为支持寄生虫学专业知识的补充工具，其负责任的实施应以透明、公平可及和人工监督为指导。

title: Fed-Universe: A Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) Stack for Negotiated Alignment in Federated Systems
zh_title: Fed-Universe：联邦系统协商式对齐的S-G-T-H架构
summary: 提出语义-几何-拓扑-人类四层联邦学习架构，用边缘LLM生成患者画像提示，并通过几何质量门控保留少数群体更新。
key_points: S层用边缘LLM将异构输入转为标准化患者画像提示
G层用余弦相似度门控保留少数站点更新
T层进行拓扑Pareto控制，摘要未完整给出
reason: 预印本新框架，摘要无充分验证信息，属增量档
abstract: Conventional federated learners implicitly optimize for global means, creating a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm that inevitably suppresses the minority under cross-site heterogeneity. To bridge this critical gap, we present Fed-Universe, a generalizable Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) architecture that transforms passive averaging into an active negotiation for decentralized alignment. The S-layer deploys an edge-capable LLM as a semantic surrogate to translate heterogeneous inputs into standardized patient profile prompts. The G-layer enforces geometric quality assurance (GQA) via a mapping f: Theta -> Q from the statistical parameter space to a physically interpretable quality domain, employing a cosine similarity gate to retain minority updates based on physical geometry rather than statistical proximity. The T-layer executes topological Pareto control, identifying a sensitivity-based knee point (lambda_k) to balance multi-objective aggregation without majority degradation. Finally, the H-layer operationalizes a cognitive twin dynamic to mirror the user's real-time psychological state, dynamically adapting human-computer interaction modes via active intent alignment. To ground this theoretical architecture empirically, we validated the S-G-T core on a binational synthetic clinical network simulation. This proof-of-concept demonstrated a "zero-sum escape": a minority node (<3% data volume) achieved utility parity (loss reduction from 0.857 to 0.340) alongside dominant hubs. Our Fed-Universe framework is being expanded along two focused pillars: institutional multimodal alignment (Fed-Ultra) and individual cognitive intent alignment (Fed-Human).
zh_abstract: 传统联邦学习器隐含地以全局均值为优化目标，形成了“一刀切”的范式，在跨站点异质性下不可避免地压制少数群体。为弥补这一关键缺口，我们提出Fed-Universe，一种可泛化的语义-几何-拓扑-人类（S-G-T-H）架构，将被动平均转变为面向去中心化对齐的主动协商。S层部署具备边缘能力的大语言模型（LLM）作为语义代理，将异质输入转换为标准化的患者画像提示。G层通过从统计参数空间到物理可解释质量域的映射 f: Theta -> Q 实施几何质量保证（GQA），并采用余弦相似度门控，依据物理几何而非统计接近程度来保留少数群体的更新。T层执行拓扑帕累托控制，识别基于敏感性的拐点（lambda_k），在不降低多数群体表现的前提下平衡多目标聚合。最后，H层实现认知孪生动态，以反映用户的实时心理状态，并通过主动意图对齐动态调整人机交互模式。为从实证上支撑这一理论架构，我们在一个两国合成临床网络模拟中验证了S-G-T核心。该概念验证展示了“零和逃逸”：一个少数节点（数据量<3%）与主导枢纽节点一样达到了效用对等（损失从0.857降至0.340）。我们的Fed-Universe框架正沿两大重点方向扩展：机构多模态对齐（Fed-Ultra）和个体认知意图对齐（Fed-Human）。

title: HerHealthGPT: An Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI System for Women's Reproductive Health Copy title

summary: 提出结合RAG、情境澄清与来源验证的女性生殖健康对话系统，用90个病例衍生的540条英文消息评估AI组件，并做原型问卷。
key_points: 整合检索增强生成、追问澄清与来源校验
评估使用90个病例的540条消息

abstract: "Why is my period late?" Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women's reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. We evaluate the AI components using 540 English messages derived from 90 reproductive-health cases and conduct a prototype questionnaire study with 30 adults. Evidence retrieval improves concern-category accuracy from 54.1% to 59.3% compared with fine-tuning alone. The clarification router achieves 85.6% recall and 86.2% specificity on constructed targets. In the user study, 83.3% of participants preferred the retrieval-enabled configuration, while 25 of 30 considered its follow-up questions relevant. These findings suggest that integrating evidence retrieval with interactive clarification offers a promising approach to more transparent, context-aware reproductive-health information systems, while further clinical validation remains necessary.
zh_abstract: “我的月经为什么推迟了？”有时，最有用的回应是从另一个问题开始的。然而，对话式人工智能系统在回应不完整的健康咨询时，可能不会寻求必要的背景信息，也不会将其指导建立在可验证的证据之上。本文介绍了 HerHealthGPT，这是一个以证据为基础的对话式人工智能系统，旨在应对女性生殖健康领域的这些挑战。HerHealthGPT 在交互式网页界面中整合了检索增强生成（RAG）、上下文感知的澄清以及来源验证。对于不完整的咨询，该系统不会立即作答，而是维持对话上下文、提出有针对性的追问、检查过早得出的结论，并将其回答建立在检索到的证据之上。我们使用源自90个生殖健康病例的540条英文消息对人工智能组件进行评估，并对30名成年人开展了原型问卷研究。与仅进行微调相比，证据检索将关注类别的准确率从54.1%提高到59.3%。在构建的目标上，澄清路由器的召回率为85.6%，特异度为86.2%。在用户研究中，83.3%的参与者更偏好启用检索的配置，30人中有25人认为其追问是相关的。这些发现表明，将证据检索与交互式澄清相结合，为构建更透明、更具上下文感知能力的生殖健康信息系统提供了一种有前景的方法，但仍需进一步的临床验证。

title: Interpretable and Steerable Molecular Graph Generation using Concept Bottlenecks
zh_title: 基于概念瓶颈的可解释、可操控分子图生成
summary: 在深度图生成器中引入概念瓶颈，使分子生成可解释、可调试、可操控，并降低FCD（预印本）。
key_points: 概念瓶颈用于分子图生成模型
分布保真度提升（FCD降低），有效性影响有限
探索Concept Controller优化式操控
reason: 药物发现可解释生成的方法探索，证据有限
abstract: Deep graph generators (DGGs) largely lack interpretability, which is a significant limitation for one of their most crucial applications, drug discovery, where interpretable and transparent generation could provide greater control over the desirability of generated molecules, thereby reducing trial-and-error in candidate selection. Common approaches to interpretability, such as disentanglement, cannot guarantee that the learned representations are human-interpretable. To address this, we propose incorporating concept bottlenecks into DGGs, allowing users to interpret, debug, and steer the generation process. We show that this consistently improves distributional fidelity (lower FCD), with only modest, non-systematic effects on validity and uniqueness. We further explore Concept Controller, an optimization-based steering approach that has proven to be effective for steerable image generation. We evaluate our approach on a one-shot molecular graph generation framework, though the underlying ideas can be transferred to sequential graph generation as well.
zh_abstract: 深度图生成器（DGG）在很大程度上缺乏可解释性，这对其最关键的应用之一——药物发现——是一项重大局限；在该领域，可解释且透明的生成可以更好地控制所生成分子的理想程度，从而减少候选物筛选中的反复试错。诸如解耦（disentanglement）等常见的可解释性方法无法保证所学表示是人类可解释的。为此，我们提出在 DGG 中引入概念瓶颈（concept bottleneck），使用户能够解释、调试并引导生成过程。我们表明，这一做法持续改善了分布保真度（FCD 更低），而对有效性和唯一性仅有轻微且无系统性的影响。我们还进一步探索了 Concept Controller，这是一种基于优化的引导方法，已被证明对可引导的图像生成有效。我们在一种一次性（one-shot）分子图生成框架上评估了该方法，不过其基本思想同样可迁移到序列式图生成。

title: Mathematical AI Predicts 40% and 57% Influenza Vaccine Effectiveness Against H1N1 and H3N2, Respectively, for the 2026--2027 U.S. Season
zh_title: 数学AI预测2026–27美国流感疫苗对H1N1/H3N2有效性
summary: 预印本利用2010–2025年美国HA序列与疫苗株的氨基酸距离，结合26个已发表VE观测，预测2026–27季H1N1和H3N2疫苗有效性分别约40%和57%。
key_points: 基于GISAID美国HA序列与疫苗株距离
与26个已发表VE估计配对建模
预测H1N1约40%、H3N2约57%
reason: 预印本，样本仅26个观测，缺外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Background: Clinical influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) has often been low over the past two decades, highlighting the need for preseason VE forecasting. Timely forecasts could help health authorities plan prevention strategies and allocate healthcare resources. However, preseason forecasting of clinical influenza VE remains relatively uncommon. Methods: We obtained hemagglutinin (HA) sequences from GISAID for U.S. specimens collected in August--September before each influenza season from 2010--2011 through 2024--2025. After quality screening, we compared each virus with the corresponding vaccine target strain for the same season and subtype or lineage using two mathematical distances based on amino acid patterns in the HA protein. We calculated mean distances for each season and subtype or lineage and paired them with published clinical VE estimates, yielding 26 observations across 13 seasons. Using a mathematical AI approach, we fitted linear regression models of VE against each distance and evaluated their predictive performance by forecasting later seasons using data from earlier seasons, with the historical mean VE for each subtype or lineage as a reference. We then applied the same approach to 87 HA sequences collected in August--September 2026 to forecast VE for the 2026--2027 season. Results: We generated component-specific forecasts of influenza VE for the upcoming 2026--2027 U.S. season. Both mathematical distances were negatively associated with historical VE, indicating that greater differences between circulating viruses and vaccine strains were associated with lower VE. The topological model forecast VE of 40.3%, 56.9%, and 47.1% against A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria, respectively, whereas the geometric model forecast corresponding VE values of 34.0%, 56.8%, and 51.1%.
zh_abstract: 【背景】过去二十年来，临床流感疫苗有效性（VE）常常较低，凸显了季前VE预测的必要性。及时的预测可帮助卫生部门规划预防策略并分配医疗资源。然而，临床流感VE的季前预测仍相对少见。【方法】我们从GISAID获取了2010–2011年至2024–2025年每个流感季前8–9月采集的美国标本的血凝素（HA）序列。经质量筛选后，我们使用基于HA蛋白氨基酸模式的两种数学距离，将每个病毒与同一季节及同一亚型或谱系的相应疫苗靶株进行比较。我们计算了每个季节及每个亚型或谱系的平均距离，并与已发表的临床VE估计值配对，得到13个季节共26个观测值。我们采用数学AI方法，拟合VE对各距离的线性回归模型，并以各亚型或谱系的历史平均VE为参照，通过利用早期季节数据预测后续季节来评估其预测性能。随后，我们将同一方法应用于2026年8–9月采集的87条HA序列，以预测2026–2027季节的VE。【结果】我们生成了即将到来的2026–2027年美国流感季各组分特异性的流感VE预测。两种数学距离均与历史VE呈负相关，表明流行病毒与疫苗株之间的差异越大，VE越低。拓扑模型预测针对A(H1N1)pdm09、A(H3N2)和B/Victoria的VE分别为40.3%、56.9%和47.1%，而几何模型预测的相应VE值分别为34.0%、56.8%和51.1%。

title: A Pipeline for Predicting Variant Associations with Complex Disorders via Functional Annotations
zh_title: 基于功能注释预测复杂疾病变异关联的流程
summary: 该预印本提出可扩展、可复现的流程，整合GWAS汇总统计与CADD注释，生成面向复杂疾病的机器学习变异数据集。
key_points: 以EFO术语定义复杂疾病
整合GWAS、基因组映射与染色体分层负采样
生成CADD注释的平衡可复现数据集
reason: 数据构建流程，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: The study of complex disorders is limited by the lack of structured data sets that integrate genetic association signals with rich functional annotations. While genome wide association studies (GWAS) provide large collections of associated variants, these are heterogeneous, studydependent, and not directly suitable for machine learning applications. Although frameworks such as Combined Annotation Dependent Depletion (CADD) offer comprehensive variant-level features, there is no standardised procedure to construct curated, balanced, and reproducible data sets for the systematic study of complex traits. We introduce a scalable and reproducible pipeline for generating CADD-annotated variant data sets associated with complex disorders defined via Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) terms. The pipeline integrates GWAS summary statistics, genome mapping, chromosomestratified negative sampling, and large-scale annotation, while addressing class imbalance and feature redundancy. The resulting data sets provide curated, balanced, and annotation-rich representations of variant-trait associations, suitable for statistical learning, systematic model evaluation and comparison, and analysis of functional annotation contributions and interactions.
zh_abstract: 复杂疾病的研究受限于缺乏将遗传关联信号与丰富功能注释相整合的结构化数据集。全基因组关联研究（GWAS）虽然提供了大量关联变异，但这些数据异质、依赖于具体研究，不能直接用于机器学习应用。尽管联合注释依赖性耗竭（CADD）等框架提供了全面的变异水平特征，但目前尚无标准化流程来构建经过整理、均衡且可重复的数据集，用于复杂性状的系统研究。我们提出了一种可扩展、可重复的流程，用于生成与以实验因子本体（EFO）术语定义的复杂疾病相关的、带有CADD注释的变异数据集。该流程整合了GWAS汇总统计数据、基因组映射、按染色体分层的负样本抽样以及大规模注释，同时处理类别不平衡和特征冗余问题。所得数据集提供了经过整理、均衡且注释丰富的变异-性状关联表示，适用于统计学习、系统性的模型评估与比较，以及功能注释贡献和相互作用的分析。

title: Automated Sleep Staging Performance Across Two Experimental Sleep Manipulation Protocols in Adolescents.
zh_title: 青少年两种睡眠操控方案下的自动睡眠分期表现
summary: 评估POPS、YASA及其组合在睡眠限制与慢波睡眠剥夺实验中对青少年多导睡眠图自动分期的有效性，对照人工判读。
key_points: 睡眠限制组43人，慢波剥夺组18人
比较POPS、YASA与POPS+YASA
检验算法在睡眠结构被操控时是否保持表现
reason: 样本小、单类人群验证的增量研究，预印本
abstract: Automated sleep staging algorithms improve the scalability of polysomnography analysis in adolescent research but are primarily validated in undisturbed, single-night sleep recordings. It remains unclear whether these algorithms maintain performance when sleep architecture is experimentally manipulated. This study evaluated the validity of two popular automated sleep staging approaches across two distinct sleep manipulation paradigms in adolescents: a sleep restriction protocol (N=43, mean age [SD]=13.37[1.06] years; four nights including two sleep extension [10hr] and two restriction [4hr] nights) and a slow-wave sleep deprivation (SWSD) protocol (N=18, mean age [SD]=17.17[1.79] years; baseline, SWSD, and recovery nights). Automated sleep staging was performed using the POPulation-level Sleep Stager (POPS), the Yet Another Spindle Algorithm (YASA), and combined POPS+YASA. Manual polysomnography scoring by experienced sleep technicians served as the reference standard. Agreement was assessed using Cohen's k, and stage-specific performance was evaluated using F1 scores and confusion matrices. Mixed-effects models tested differences in overall and stage-specific agreement across nights. All staging approaches demonstrated moderate-to-substantial agreement with manual scoring across manipulated sleep conditions (k range; range=0.53-0.76). In the sleep restriction study, agreement was lower in restricted versus extended sleep (P<0.05), and agreement declined across restriction nights, with poorer Wake, N1, and N2 classification, while N3 remained preserved. In the SWSD study, overall agreement was lower on the SWSD night, with poorer N3 classification while other stages were preserved. Automated sleep staging performance may be less consistent in adolescents when sleep is curtailed or fragmented; future studies should develop and validate these algorithms under multiple sleep conditions.
zh_abstract: 自动化睡眠分期算法提高了青少年研究中多导睡眠图分析的可扩展性，但其验证主要基于未受干扰的单夜睡眠记录。目前尚不清楚当睡眠结构被实验性操控时，这些算法能否保持性能。本研究在两种不同的青少年睡眠操控范式中评估了两种常用自动化睡眠分期方法的有效性：睡眠限制方案（N=43，平均年龄[标准差]=13.37[1.06]岁；共四个夜晚，包括两个睡眠延长[10小时]夜和两个睡眠限制[4小时]夜）和慢波睡眠剥夺（SWSD）方案（N=18，平均年龄[标准差]=17.17[1.79]岁；基线夜、SWSD夜和恢复夜）。自动化睡眠分期使用群体水平睡眠分期器（POPS）、又一种纺锤波算法（YASA）以及二者联合（POPS+YASA）进行。以经验丰富的睡眠技师手工多导睡眠图评分作为参考标准。一致性采用Cohen's k评估，各期别表现采用F1分数和混淆矩阵评估。使用混合效应模型检验不同夜晚间总体及各期别一致性的差异。在被操控的睡眠条件下，所有分期方法与手工评分均表现出中等至高度的一致性（k范围=0.53–0.76）。在睡眠限制研究中，限制睡眠与延长睡眠相比一致性较低（P<0.05），且一致性随限制夜数增加而下降，清醒期、N1和N2的分类较差，而N3保持稳定。在SWSD研究中，SWSD夜的总体一致性较低，N3分类较差，而其他期别保持稳定。当睡眠被缩短或碎片化时，自动化睡眠分期在青少年中的表现可能不够一致；未来研究应在多种睡眠条件下开发并验证这些算法。

title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
zh_title: 改进CBAM-ENet跳跃连接的节能肺肿瘤分割
summary: 该预印本在ENet上加入UNet式跳跃连接与CBAM注意力，用MSD公开数据训练，目标是降低计算量以便临床部署。
key_points: 基于ENet的轻量实时架构
加入跳跃连接与CBAM模块
使用TCIA/MSD公开数据训练
reason: 轻量分割小改进，仅公开数据，无外部验证
abstract: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset. Our model achieves a DSC of 0.90812 (threshold of 0.5) with its compact architecture of 430,052 parameters and 0.549 Giga Multiply-Accumulate operations (GMAC), making it up to 10 times faster, requires 79 times less GMAC than UNet, and has 22 times fewer parameters than SegNet. These characteristics make it well-suited for deployment in clinical settings where computational resources are limited and decrease the cost of utilizing such a system. Additionally, the explainable AI technique of Grad-CAM is used to provide visual interpretability of the model's predictions and to identify regions where segmentation performance requires improvement.
zh_abstract: 肺肿瘤分割在肺癌的早期检测和治疗规划中起着至关重要的作用。尽管最先进的深度学习模型能够取得较高的 Dice 相似系数（DSC），但每次前向传播都需要进行大量浮点运算，计算成本高昂，需要 GPU 加速，且推理速度慢，限制了其在真实临床环境中的部署。我们提出一种轻量级、节能的模型：利用 ENet 架构的实时推理能力和低计算成本，并在编码器与解码器阶段之间加入 UNet 式跳跃连接以实现特征复用，同时引入轻量级卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）以改进特征表示。该模型使用通过医学分割十项全能挑战赛（MSD）获取的癌症影像档案库（TCIA）公开数据进行训练，并在肺部影像数据库联盟和影像数据库资源倡议（LIDC-IDRI）数据集上进行评估。我们的模型在阈值为0.5时 DSC 达到0.90812，其紧凑架构仅有430,052个参数和0.549十亿次乘加运算（GMAC），速度最高可达 UNet 的10倍，所需 GMAC 比 UNet 少79倍，参数量比 SegNet 少22倍。这些特点使其非常适合在计算资源有限的临床环境中部署，并可降低使用此类系统的成本。此外，还采用可解释人工智能技术 Grad-CAM，对模型预测提供可视化解释，并识别分割性能有待改进的区域。

title: Gender Associations in LLM-Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis
zh_title: LLM辅助ADHD自我诊断中的性别关联
summary: 借用上下文关联测试，评估GPT-4o在零样本ADHD自我诊断场景中对性别线索的响应，发现显式与隐式线索表现不同。
key_points: 改编Context Association Test评估GPT-4o
显式性别线索会放大部分ADHD亚型关联
隐式线索更接近代理分布，显式可能过度纠偏
reason: 预印本，单模型偏倚评估，证据有限；心理健康LLM略加分
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model's default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于医学自我诊断。然而，在这类交互中，人口统计学线索如何影响输出，目前仍知之甚少。这对于 ADHD 等诊断尤为重要，因为其持续存在的性别差异与临床证据并不完全一致。我们改编了语境关联测试（Context Association Test，CAT），以评估 GPT-4o 在零样本自我诊断情境下是否会对带有性别色彩的 ADHD 关联作出反应。我们发现，显式提示会持续放大某些 ADHD 亚型的关联，而隐式提示产生的分布则接近代理（proxy）基准。这些差异表明，显式人口统计学线索可能激活偏见缓解机制，而该机制会矫枉过正而非消除偏见，而隐式线索似乎反映了模型的默认行为。我们的结果表明，评估 LLM 介导的自我诊断中的性别偏见，需要认真关注模型所编码的人口统计学关联。

title: Multiscale Topology-Regulated Nonlinear Dynamics for Protein B-Factor Prediction and Single-Cell Type Classification
zh_title: 多尺度拓扑调控非线性动力学用于蛋白B因子预测与单细胞分型
summary: 提出MGCBRL框架，结合代数拓扑与Burgers非线性动力学，从蛋白坐标或细胞主成分得分构建多尺度图表示，用于B因子预测和单细胞类型分类。
key_points: 在十个邻域尺度上构建加权图
节点单位脉冲响应由非线性Burgers动力学支配
同时面向蛋白结构与单细胞分类
reason: 预印本新方法，摘要未给出对比结果，属增量档
abstract: Protein B-factor prediction and single-cell type classification are important for characterizing structural variability and cellular heterogeneity, with applications in biological function analysis and drug discovery. However, static geometric descriptors do not directly capture how multiscale connectivity shapes responses to local perturbations. Here, we introduce multiscale graph-coupled Burgers response learning (MGCBRL), a framework integrating algebraic topology and nonlinear dynamics to construct predictive biological representations. Specifically, a filtration converts protein coordinates or cellular principal component scores into weighted graphs at ten neighborhood scales. Independent unit impulses initiate node-specific responses governed by nonlinear Burgers dynamics. Statistical summaries or sampled source-node trajectories then encode the influence of structural neighborhoods on transient signal evolution. The simulated responses serve as computational probes rather than models of biological motion. For cross-protein prediction, multiscale response statistics are combined with spectral perturbation descriptors measuring changes in Laplacian spectra after node removal. For single-cell classification, principal component scores augment these features to retain explicit expression-space information, and the resulting descriptors support downstream supervised learning. Across 104 proteins and 13 single-cell datasets, MGCBRL achieved configuration-selected mean scores of 0.888 for within-protein Pearson correlation and 0.950 for transductive cell classification balanced accuracy, with leave-one-protein-out mean correlations of 0.496-0.558. Our framework provides a shared strategy for transforming multiscale biological connectivity into informative response descriptors, supporting predictive analysis of protein structures and transcriptomic profiles.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质 B 因子预测和单细胞类型分类对于刻画结构变异性和细胞异质性非常重要，可应用于生物功能分析和药物发现。然而，静态几何描述符无法直接捕捉多尺度连接性如何塑造对局部扰动的响应。在此，我们提出了多尺度图耦合 Burgers 响应学习（MGCBRL），这是一个整合代数拓扑与非线性动力学以构建预测性生物学表征的框架。具体而言，通过过滤（filtration）将蛋白质坐标或细胞主成分得分转换为十个邻域尺度上的加权图。独立的单位脉冲引发由非线性 Burgers 动力学支配的节点特异性响应。随后，统计摘要或采样的源节点轨迹对结构邻域对瞬态信号演化的影响进行编码。这些模拟响应仅作为计算探针，而非生物运动的模型。对于跨蛋白质预测，将多尺度响应统计量与谱扰动描述符相结合，后者度量移除节点后 Laplacian 谱的变化。对于单细胞分类，主成分得分用于增强这些特征，以保留显式的表达空间信息，所得描述符支持下游的监督学习。在104个蛋白质和13个单细胞数据集上，MGCBRL 在配置选择下，蛋白质内 Pearson 相关性的平均得分为0.888，转导式细胞分类的平衡准确率为0.950，留一蛋白质交叉验证的平均相关性为0.496–0.558。我们的框架提供了一种共享策略，可将多尺度生物连接性转化为信息丰富的响应描述符，支持对蛋白质结构和转录组谱的预测分析。

title: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
zh_title: 面向医学问答的基于扰动的数据选择
summary: 提出基于表征高斯扰动的数据选择方法RSP及RSP-Drop，在MedGemma-4B和五个医学问答数据集上，128样本预算下Macro-F1为47.55和48.28，高于随机选择的45.11（预印本）。
key_points: 利用预测变化频率与边际收缩两种信号
仅用问题与选项进行选择
预算64/128/256条，对比熵池匹配随机选择
reason: 小幅提升的方法改进，预印本，增量
abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 从现有问答库中为医学语言模型适配选择紧凑的训练子集是重要的一步。我们研究基于扰动的数据选择方法，使用对最后一个模块表征施加高斯扰动所得的两个信号：预测变化频率和非翻转间隔收缩。在共同的熵预过滤之后，表征敏感性优先排序（Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization，RSP）通过自动均方根缩放来组合这两个信号，而 RSP-Drop 仅按收缩程度对候选样本排序。两种选择器在选择过程中都只使用问题和答案选项。我们以 MedGemma-4B 在五个医学问答数据集上、保留集规模为 64、128 和 256 个样本的条件下对其进行评估。在主要规模 128 时，RSP 和 RSP-Drop 的数据集平均 Macro-F1 分别为 47.55 和 48.28，而与熵池匹配的随机选择为 45.11。二者的相对表现随数据集和规模而变化。一项针对所选集合的案例研究发现，两种规则所交换的样本具有相反的干净间隔特征；而一项全池消融实验表明，熵预过滤并非在所有情况下都有益。这些回顾性结果刻画了在固定适配方案下基于扰动的选择方法的经验效用与局限。评估仅使用一个骨干模型，且所用基准与训练数据存在已记录的同源重叠；这些结果并不能证明其临床有效性。

title: Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights
zh_title: 蒸馏、辩论、发现：基于图蒸馏洞见的多智能体科研构想
summary: 提出InsightAgents框架，从相关论文图中蒸馏洞见赋予智能体专长，经多智能体辩论形成研究提案（预印本）。
key_points: 从论文图提炼研究演进、假设与未解难题
智能体通过提出、质疑、完善形成提案
面向LLM辅助科学发现
reason: AI科学发现类方法，摘要未显示医疗关联与结果
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于支持研究想法的生成和科学发现。多智能体辩论通过汇集多元视角来发展研究想法，为这一任务提供了一种协作方式。然而，一个关键挑战在于如何赋予各智能体独特而有意义的专业知识，以指导其贡献。受研究人员在协作中借鉴既往研究经验的启发，我们提出 InsightAgents，该框架通过从相关论文图谱中提炼洞见，构建以文献为依据的智能体专业知识。在这些洞见的引导下——它们追溯某一研究方向内研究方法的演变、揭示其潜在假设并指出尚未解决的挑战——智能体共同确定研究问题，并通过辩论提出、质疑和完善潜在方法，从而形成研究方案。我们在 100 个自然语言处理研究主题上，通过两位 LLM 评判者的成对比较，将 InsightAgents 与三种研究想法生成框架进行评估。在在线和离线知识设置下，InsightAgents 在两位评判者的评价中，五个评估维度的平均得分均最高。

abstract: Equation discovery solvers often use different data interfaces, equation representations and evaluation criteria, making their results difficult to compare. We present LegoSR, a unified framework for algebraic symbolic regression and differential equation discovery. LegoSR integrates seven solvers through a common equation representation and evaluation process, and supports searches constrained by partially known equations. Researchers can run solvers directly or use LegoSR Agent, which selects solvers and adapts searches based on solver knowledge, intermediate results and lessons from earlier tasks. On noisy ordinary and partial differential equation benchmarks, LegoSR Agent recovers nearly as many equations as the union of seven expert-tuned solvers and outperforms a generic agent with the same model, tools and budget by up to 29 percentage points. Three examples demonstrate basic use, adaptive solver selection and discovery guided by partial physical knowledge.
zh_abstract: 方程发现求解器往往采用不同的数据接口、方程表示和评估标准，使其结果难以比较。我们提出了 LegoSR，一个用于代数符号回归和微分方程发现的统一框架。LegoSR 通过共同的方程表示和评估流程整合了七种求解器，并支持以部分已知方程为约束的搜索。研究人员可以直接运行求解器，也可以使用 LegoSR Agent；后者基于求解器知识、中间结果以及先前任务的经验教训来选择求解器并调整搜索。在含噪声的常微分方程和偏微分方程基准上，LegoSR Agent 所恢复的方程数量接近七种经专家调优的求解器的并集，并且比使用相同模型、工具和预算的通用智能体最多高出 29 个百分点。三个示例展示了基本用法、自适应求解器选择以及由部分物理知识引导的发现。

title: VTRL-Med: Progressive Visual Refinement with Topology-Guided Regularization for Medical Image Clustering

summary: 利用SAM提取结构特征并加入拓扑引导正则，用于无标注医学图像深度聚类（预印本）。
