abstract: Deep clustering offers a promising approach for analyzing large unlabeled medical image datasets, yet prevailing methods still face two limitations: they may neglect class-agnostic structural priors that capture object boundaries and regions, and they do not explicitly encode topological patterns (e.g., connectivity and holes). These sources of information play distinct and complementary roles: visual-structural features provide the primary discriminative representation for clustering, while topological features provide additional global geometric cues for residual visual ambiguities. We introduce VTRL-Med, a progressive visual-structural learning framework with topology-guided regularization for medical image clustering. VTRL-Med first adapts the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to extract image features that retain structural cues inherited from mask-supervised pretraining. It then generates reliable pseudo-labels through a two-step filtering process that combines prototype-based selection with k-nearest neighbor consistency validation. Finally, it progressively refines the visual branch while an auxiliary topology branch, constructed from persistent homology (PH) descriptors, provides additional geometric regularization during training. Across 13 medical image benchmarks, VTRL-Med achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance, improving average accuracy by 4.48% over existing methods. On three representative datasets, topology-guided regularization further improves accuracy by 1.3--4.3% over visual refinement alone.
zh_abstract: 深度聚类为分析大规模无标注医学图像数据集提供了一种有前景的方法，但现有主流方法仍面临两方面局限：它们可能忽略能够刻画物体边界和区域的、与类别无关的结构先验，并且没有显式编码拓扑模式（例如连通性和孔洞）。这两类信息发挥着不同且互补的作用：视觉-结构特征为聚类提供主要的判别性表示，而拓扑特征则为残余的视觉模糊提供额外的全局几何线索。我们提出了 VTRL-Med，一种用于医学图像聚类的、带有拓扑引导正则化的渐进式视觉-结构学习框架。VTRL-Med 首先对 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 进行适配，以提取保留了源自掩码监督预训练的结构线索的图像特征。随后，它通过结合基于原型的选择与 k 近邻一致性验证的两步过滤流程生成可靠的伪标签。最后，它在训练过程中逐步优化视觉分支，同时由基于持续同调（PH）描述符构建的辅助拓扑分支提供额外的几何正则化。在 13 个医学图像基准上，VTRL-Med 取得了最先进的聚类性能，平均准确率比现有方法提高 4.48%。在三个代表性数据集上，拓扑引导正则化相比仅进行视觉优化进一步将准确率提高了 1.3–4.3%。

title: In-silico Tandem Mass Spectral Libraries for the Blood Exposome and Metabolomics Workbench Databases: Application of Gemini Large Language Model

summary: 利用Gemini大模型与思维链提示，为91,231个独特2D结构生成高/中/低能量碎裂的模拟质谱库，采用NIST MSP格式。

abstract: Human body contains endogenous metabolites, nutrients and xenobiotics chemicals. These chemicals can be detected in a biospecimen using high-resolution mass spectrometry instruments, yielding metabolomic and exposomic datasets. Mass spectral libraries are critical components of these workflows to annotate experimental data with chemical information. In this data descriptor, we report mass spectral libraries for human-relevant small molecules, that are generated using Google Gemini large-language model. Using an optimized chain-of-thought prompt and instructions, we have generated mass spectra for each compound at high/medium/low energy fragmentation level. Each spectrum was reported in the NIST MSP text format for easy to use by metabolomics software. These libraries cover 91,231 unique 2D structures from the Blood Exposome Database and the Metabolomics Workbench data repository. Technical validation was shown by comparing the Gemini-generated spectra against NIST 23 mass spectral database, which demonstrated 55% accuracy. LLMs represent a useful and accessible tool for expanding in-silico spectral libraries to annotate compounds in the HRMS data for human biospecimens and may accelerate the compound annotation in metabolomics and exposomics.
zh_abstract: 人体含有内源性代谢物、营养物质和外源性化学物质。这些化学物质可使用高分辨率质谱仪在生物样本中检测，从而产生代谢组学和暴露组学数据集。质谱库是这些工作流程中用化学信息注释实验数据的关键组成部分。在本数据说明中，我们报告了使用 Google Gemini 大语言模型生成的、面向人体相关小分子的质谱库。通过优化的思维链提示和指令，我们为每种化合物生成了高/中/低能量碎裂水平的质谱。每个谱图均以 NIST MSP 文本格式报告，便于代谢组学软件使用。这些谱库涵盖来自血液暴露组数据库（Blood Exposome Database）和 Metabolomics Workbench 数据仓库的 91,231 个独特二维结构。技术验证通过将 Gemini 生成的谱图与 NIST 23 质谱数据库进行比较完成，结果显示准确率为 55%。大语言模型是扩展计算机模拟谱库的一种有用且易得的工具，可用于注释人体生物样本高分辨质谱数据中的化合物，并可能加速代谢组学和暴露组学中的化合物注释。

title: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of HER2 Status from Whole-Brain MRI in Breast Cancer Brain Metastases

summary: 基于公开数据集135例乳腺癌脑转移患者，比较影像组学与SFCN（含/不含肿瘤掩膜）预测HER2状态。

abstract: Purpose: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) status is a key biomarker relevant for prognostication and treatment decision making in metastatic breast cancer. Thus, the aim of this work was to explore whether HER2 status can be predicted directly from whole-brain post-contrast T1-weighted (T1w) MRI scans in breast cancer brain metastases (BCBM) using deep learning, and whether providing explicit tumour segmentation information improves prediction. Methods: Using the publicly available BCBM-Radiogenomics dataset, we analysed 135 patients, including 70 HER2+ and 65 HER2- patients. Three approaches were implemented and evaluated: a conventional radiomics model, a simple fully convolutional network (SFCN) using T1w MRI scans alone, and an SFCN using T1w MRI scans with an expert-derived tumour mask as an additional input channel. Results: The radiomics model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.602 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.528--0.677) while the SFCN achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.667 (95% CI, 0.63--0.71) using T1w MRI scans alone, which increased to 0.692 (95% CI, 0.58--0.81) when an explicit tumour mask was additionally provided. Conclusion: However, the modest performance across all approaches demonstrates the difficulty of predicting HER2 status from structural MRI scans alone. The difference between the segmentation-free and mask-guided SFCN models suggests that much of the predictive signal captured by the deep-learning model may be learned directly from whole-brain T1w MRI without requiring explicit tumour delineation. These findings support further investigation of segmentation-free deep-learning approaches as a potential non-invasive strategy to support HER2 status determination in BCBM.
zh_abstract: 【目的】人表皮生长因子受体 2（HER2）状态是转移性乳腺癌预后判断和治疗决策的关键生物标志物。因此，本研究旨在探讨能否利用深度学习，直接从乳腺癌脑转移（BCBM）患者的全脑增强后 T1 加权（T1w）MRI 扫描中预测 HER2 状态，以及提供明确的肿瘤分割信息是否能改善预测。【方法】利用公开的 BCBM-Radiogenomics 数据集，我们分析了 135 名患者，其中 HER2 阳性 70 例，HER2 阴性 65 例。实施并评估了三种方法：传统影像组学模型、仅使用 T1w MRI 扫描的简单全卷积网络（SFCN），以及将专家勾画的肿瘤掩膜作为额外输入通道、与 T1w MRI 扫描一起输入的 SFCN。【结果】影像组学模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）为 0.602（95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.528–0.677）；仅使用 T1w MRI 扫描时，SFCN 的 ROC-AUC 为 0.667（95% CI：0.63–0.71），额外提供明确的肿瘤掩膜后升至 0.692（95% CI：0.58–0.81）。【结论】然而，所有方法的表现均较为有限，表明仅凭结构 MRI 扫描预测 HER2 状态存在困难。无分割与掩膜引导的 SFCN 模型之间的差异提示，深度学习模型所捕获的预测信号很大一部分可能直接来自全脑 T1w MRI，而无需明确的肿瘤勾画。这些发现支持进一步研究无需分割的深度学习方法，作为辅助确定 BCBM 患者 HER2 状态的一种潜在无创策略。

title: Investigating the trackability of landmarks in NBI and WLI

abstract: Reliable visual tracking of anatomical landmarks in endoscopic video is a key prerequisite for computer-assisted interventions in laryngeal surgery. While Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) is clinically established for enhancing vascular contrast, its effect on automated tracking relative to conventional White Light Imaging (WLI) remains unexplored. We present a quantitative comparison of landmark trackability in NBI and WLI using a forward-backward error framework applied to 61 endoscopic videos from 39 patients. Two regions of interest are evaluated: the vocal folds (VF) and mucosa with a prominent vascular pattern (MPVP). We compare a classical feature-based tracker (CSRT) against learning-based point trackers (CoTracker3-Online and TrackOnR) across both modalities. NBI consistently reduced the forward-backward error in both regions, reaching statistical significance for the vocal folds, while failure rates stayed low. These findings indicate that NBI can improve tracking robustness in laryngeal endoscopy, with implications for motion analysis, navigation, and robotic assistance.
zh_abstract: 在内镜视频中可靠地视觉跟踪解剖标志点，是喉部手术中计算机辅助干预的关键前提。窄带成像（NBI）在临床上已被确立可增强血管对比度，但相对于传统白光成像（WLI），其对自动跟踪的影响尚未得到研究。我们采用前向-后向误差框架，对来自 39 名患者的 61 段内镜视频进行了 NBI 与 WLI 下标志点可跟踪性的定量比较。评估了两个感兴趣区域：声带（VF）和具有明显血管模式的黏膜（MPVP）。我们在两种成像模式下比较了经典的基于特征的跟踪器（CSRT）与基于学习的点跟踪器（CoTracker3-Online 和 TrackOnR）。NBI 在两个区域均持续降低了前向-后向误差，其中声带区域达到统计学显著性，同时失败率保持在较低水平。这些发现表明，NBI 可以提高喉内镜中跟踪的稳健性，对运动分析、导航和机器人辅助具有重要意义。

title: Computational De Novo Design of Miniprotein Candidate Neutralizers Targeting the IL-23 Cytokine Subunit p19

summary: 用计算方法设计靶向IL-23 p19的微型蛋白结合剂，并以ipSAE评分；常规流程未获可靠界面（预印本）。

abstract: Interleukin-23 (IL-23) drives T-helper-17 inflammation underlying inflammatory bowel disease and psoriasis; anti-p19 antibodies are clinically effective but large, costly, and injectable. De novo miniproteins are an attractive alternative, yet published designs target the IL-23 receptor; the IL-23 cytokine itself has not been addressed. A further obstacle is that the standard confidence score (ipTM) tracks construct length rather than interface quality. We computationally design miniprotein binders against the IL-23R-binding face of p19 (PDB 3DUH) and score every design with ipSAE, a length-robust interface metric derived from AlphaFold-initial-guess predicted aligned error. A conventional RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN/ColabFold pipeline yields no reliable predicted interface across 972 designs (best ipSAE 0.30), and a scoring artifact, in which single-sequence ColabFold under-rates binder pLDDT by approximately 56 points, explains an earlier misleading "binders do not fold" signal. An interface-optimized hallucination method (BindCraft), scored identically, yields 42 of 50 designs above ipSAE 0.60 (best 0.804). An AlphaFold-independent geometric check reproduces the conventional failure: no top-ranked conventional design reaches the buried area or interface hydrogen-bond count of the weakest lead. Five all-alpha-helical leads (72-104 residues) collectively engage all six targeted hotspots; two dock within the intact p40/p19 heterodimer and all show favorable Rosetta energetics. A p40-alone counter-screen returns ipSAE 0.00 for all five, indicating no spurious p40 interface. To our knowledge, these are the first computationally proposed de novo miniprotein candidates designed to occlude the IL-23R-binding face of IL-23 p19. All results require experimental validation.

title: Bottlenecks in cardiovascular prevention: Can artificial intelligence close the gap?

abstract: [Archives of cardiovascular diseases] Cardiovascular diseases are a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in France, despite current preventive strategies and evidence-based therapies. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising approach to overcoming several of these barriers, with the potential to improve cardiovascular prevention across the entire spectrum of care. Upstream, AI can enhance risk stratification through the integration of clinical, biological, imaging, environmental, behavioural and longitudinal data, thereby moving cardiovascular prevention toward an AI-augmented precision medicine paradigm, in which risk assessments are increasingly individualized. Downstream, AI-enabled clinical decision support systems may improve guideline implementation, reduce therapeutic inertia and support individualized treatment optimization. Generative AI may also strengthen patient education, personalize risk communication, promote healthy behaviours and improve long-term adherence through adaptive coaching and continuous monitoring. However, translating these promises into meaningful improvements in cardiovascular outcomes will require overcoming substantial technological, organizational, regulatory and societal challenges. These challenges include ensuring data quality and information system interoperability, addressing inequalities in access to digital health technologies, improving the acceptability of AI among patients and healthcare professionals through rigorous evaluation and, critically, adapting healthcare systems to absorb, triage and manage the potentially large number of at-risk individuals identified by AI-enabled prevention strategies. By examining these barriers, this review highlights that AI mainly shifts the bottlenecks of prevention downstream, rather than removing them, and outlines the conditions required for AI, beyond intrinsic performance, to improve cardiovascular prevention in routine clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Archives of cardiovascular diseases] 尽管已有现行的预防策略和循证治疗，心血管疾病仍是法国发病和死亡的主要原因。人工智能（AI）已成为克服其中若干障碍的有前景的途径，有望改善整个医疗链条上的心血管预防。在上游，AI可通过整合临床、生物学、影像、环境、行为和纵向数据来增强风险分层，从而使心血管预防迈向AI增强的精准医学范式，其中风险评估日益个体化。在下游，AI赋能的临床决策支持系统可改善指南的落实，减少治疗惰性，并支持个体化治疗优化。生成式AI还可通过自适应指导和持续监测，加强患者教育、实现个性化风险沟通、促进健康行为并提高长期依从性。然而，要将这些前景转化为心血管结局的切实改善，需要克服重大的技术、组织、监管和社会挑战。这些挑战包括：确保数据质量和信息系统的互操作性；解决数字健康技术可及性方面的不平等；通过严格评估提高患者和医疗专业人员对AI的接受度；以及至关重要的是，使医疗体系能够吸收、分诊和管理由AI赋能的预防策略所识别出的可能数量庞大的高风险个体。通过审视这些障碍，本综述指出，AI主要是将预防的瓶颈转移到下游，而非将其消除，并概述了除自身性能之外，AI在常规临床实践中改善心血管预防所需的条件。

key_points: 检索到184条记录，纳入11项
涉及临床决策支持与工作流等应用
证据基础有限，范围综述
reason: 纳入研究很少的范围综述，属增量档
abstract: [Nursing reports (Pavia, Italy)] Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical gastroenterology, with emerging applications in nursing contexts. However, the extent and nature of these applications in gastroenterology nursing remain under-explored. This scoping review aimed to map the current landscape of AI and closely related AI-adjacent digital technologies in gastroenterology nursing. Methods: Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guideline, PubMed, Medline, Web of Science, and Scopus were searched for peer-reviewed, English-language studies published since 2000, and the findings were synthesized narratively. Results: Of 184 records identified, 11 studies were included, highlighting the potential of these technologies in clinical decision support, workflow optimization, patient education, and endoscopy assistance. Reported benefits include gains in workflow efficiency, technical accuracy, and reduced administrative workload; direct evidence of improved nursing-led patient outcomes was reported in only a minority of studies. Challenges encompass limited nurse-led research, insufficient external validation, implementation gaps, and ethical concerns. Conclusions: Greater nurse involvement in AI development is essential to drive paradigm shifts in clinical practice. This review synthesizes evidence to inform future applications, research, and policy in AI-enhanced gastroenterology nursing.
zh_abstract: [Nursing reports（意大利帕维亚）]【背景/目的】人工智能（AI）日益融入临床胃肠病学，并在护理场景中出现新的应用。然而，这些应用在胃肠病护理中的范围和性质仍未得到充分探讨。本范围综述旨在描绘胃肠病护理中AI及与AI密切相关的数字技术的现状。【方法】遵循系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目的范围综述扩展版（PRISMA-ScR）指南，检索PubMed、Medline、Web of Science和Scopus中2000年以来发表的同行评审英文研究，并对结果进行叙述性综合。【结果】在检索到的184条记录中，纳入11项研究，这些研究凸显了这些技术在临床决策支持、工作流程优化、患者教育和内镜辅助方面的潜力。报告的获益包括工作流程效率提高、技术准确性提升以及行政工作负担减轻；仅少数研究报告了由护士主导的患者结局改善的直接证据。挑战包括护士主导的研究有限、外部验证不足、实施差距和伦理问题。【结论】护士更多地参与AI开发对于推动临床实践的范式转变至关重要。本综述综合了相关证据，以为AI增强的胃肠病护理的未来应用、研究和政策提供参考。

title: A Computationally Efficient Non-Interpolation Virtual Trellis Approach for Mammogram Gradient-based Patterns Analysis
zh_title: 用于乳腺X线梯度模式分析的非插值虚拟网格算子
summary: 提出非插值虚拟网格算子，无需转换到六边形网格，用于降低乳腺X线特征提取的计算与存储成本。
key_points: 在方形图像上直接使用滤波核
旨在降低计算和存储开销
用于乳腺癌分类的特征提取
reason: 传统特征算子，证据有限，增量档
abstract: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveraging a hexagonal pixel representation while maintaining high sensitivity in different directions with less storage.
zh_abstract: 特征分析是医学图像分析中的关键步骤，尤其是在乳腺癌分类中。传统图像分析方法往往难以处理沿对角线方向的最优模式，并且在计算效率和特征缓冲存储方面存在困难。不同的经典算子需要高效能硬件来完成复杂运算，例如图像卷积和梯度分析，而这些运算用于处理复杂机器学习模型的训练和测试。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于非插值虚拟网格（non-interpolation virtual trellis，NVHT）的算子，该算子在同一幅方形图像上使用滤波核，而无需将其转换为六边形网格。所提出的方法在降低计算和存储成本方面非常高效。该算子用于提高疾病分类中特征提取的效率和准确性。该方法利用六边形像素表示，同时以更少的存储在不同方向上保持高灵敏度，从而优于传统方法。

title: Semantic-Aware Deformable Feature Alignment for Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound
zh_title: 面向超声甲状腺结节分割的语义感知可变形特征对齐网络
summary: 提出SDFA-Net，通过语义感知可变形特征对齐，解耦全局语义与局部几何，用于超声甲状腺结节分割。
key_points: 聚类线性上下文聚合模块建模长程依赖
基于动态原型的亲和驱动token调制抑制背景
级联空间对齐特征融合实现亚像素对齐
reason: 常规分割网络改进，摘要无外部验证信息
abstract: Accurate segmentation of thyroid nodules in ultrasound images is essential for clinical diagnosis yet remains challenging due to boundary ambiguity, speckle noise, and complex geometric variability. Existing methods often fail to reconcile global semantic understanding with precise local boundary delineation, leading to errors in irregular cases. To address this, we propose SDFA-Net, a framework built on semantic-aware deformable feature alignment that explicitly decouples the learning of robust global semantics and detailed local geometry. Our approach integrates three main components: a clustered linear context aggregation module for efficient long-range dependency modeling, an affinity-driven token modulation mechanism using dynamic prototypes to suppress background interference, and a cascaded spatially-aligned feature fusion strategy that achieves sub-pixel geometric alignment across multiple resolution stages. By filtering and aligning multi-scale features, SDFA-Net ensures robust fusion that is both semantically meaningful and geometrically accurate. We validate our method through extensive experiments on three public thyroid ultrasound datasets, TN3K, TUCC, and DDTI, where it demonstrates superior performance over state-of-the-art methods. The proposed framework offers a generalizable solution for precise medical image segmentation in boundary-ambiguous scenarios.
zh_abstract: 超声图像中甲状腺结节的精确分割对临床诊断至关重要，但由于边界模糊、斑点噪声和复杂的几何变异性，仍具挑战性。现有方法往往难以兼顾全局语义理解与精确的局部边界勾画，导致在不规则病例中出现误差。为此，我们提出SDFA-Net，这是一个基于语义感知可变形特征对齐的框架，明确解耦了稳健全局语义与精细局部几何的学习。我们的方法包含三个主要组成部分：用于高效建模长程依赖的聚类线性上下文聚合模块；使用动态原型抑制背景干扰的亲和力驱动的token调制机制；以及在多个分辨率阶段实现亚像素几何对齐的级联空间对齐特征融合策略。通过对多尺度特征进行过滤和对齐，SDFA-Net确保了在语义上有意义且在几何上准确的稳健融合。我们在三个公开的甲状腺超声数据集TN3K、TUCC和DDTI上进行了大量实验验证，结果显示其性能优于最先进的方法。所提出的框架为边界模糊场景下的精确医学图像分割提供了一种可推广的解决方案。

title: StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation
zh_title: StaX-Net：用于跨模态医学图像转换的Stackelberg交错非对称网络
summary: 提出StaX-Net，用部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构和FAST层，在训练中蒸馏目标域先验，以减少跨模态合成中的解剖不一致。
key_points: 生成器与判别器共享部分模块以对齐特征
Stackelberg式非对称优化，冻结共享参数并用不同学习率
FAST层训练时蒸馏先验，推理仅用源模态变换
reason: 图像转换方法改进，摘要无外部验证或临床评估
abstract: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures. The code is available on GitHub for public use.
zh_abstract: 跨模态医学图像转换面临解剖结构不一致的合成问题，这可能影响临床诊断。我们提出 StaX-Net（Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network，Stackelberg 交错非对称网络），其包含部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构，以及一个二维特征聚合与空间变换（feature aggregation and spatial transformation，FAST）层，该层在利用特权信息学习（learning using privileged information）范式下提炼受目标域监督的先验。生成器与判别器之间的共享模块增强了架构层面的特征对齐。为稳定领导者-跟随者式训练，受 Stackelberg 博弈启发的非对称优化方案采用显式的共享参数冻结和非对称学习率。FAST 层在训练期间提炼目标域先验，并在推理时仅对源域输入应用变换。相对于标准生成架构，这通过目标信息化的特征表示约束了合成过程。代码已在 GitHub 上公开。

title: Prior-Data Fitted Networks for In-Context Off-Policy Evaluation
zh_title: 用于上下文离策略评估的先验数据拟合网络
summary: 提出InCOPE，预训练网络在合成任务上学习策略价值预测，用于表格决策问题的离策略评估，含半合成临床场景（预印本）。
key_points: 基于合成MDP任务先验预训练
无需任务特定参数更新即可预测期望回报
在四个表格域含半合成临床场景实验
reason: 通用OPE方法，医疗仅为半合成场景，预印本
abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) is essential for assessing decision policies before deployment when online experimentation is costly or unsafe. Accurate estimation remains difficult when behavior-policy data are limited and the target policy favors states and actions rarely observed in those data. We propose InCOPE, a prior-data fitted network that learns a shared policy-value prediction rule across synthetic OPE tasks. We construct an OPE task prior over Markov decision processes and behavior-target policy pairs, generating behavior-policy datasets and exact target-policy values for pretraining. For a new tabular decision problem, the pretrained network uses the behavior-policy dataset, target policy, and known task settings as context to predict the policy's expected return without task-specific parameter updates. Experiments across four tabular domains, including a semi-synthetic clinical setting, demonstrate InCOPE's effectiveness for policy-value estimation.
zh_abstract: 当在线实验成本高昂或不安全时，离策略评估（off-policy evaluation，OPE）对于在部署前评估决策策略至关重要。当行为策略数据有限，且目标策略偏好这些数据中很少观察到的状态和动作时，准确估计仍然困难。我们提出 InCOPE，这是一种先验数据拟合网络（prior-data fitted network），可在合成的 OPE 任务之间学习共享的策略价值预测规则。我们在马尔可夫决策过程以及行为-目标策略对之上构建了一个 OPE 任务先验，生成行为策略数据集和精确的目标策略价值用于预训练。对于一个新的表格型决策问题，预训练网络将行为策略数据集、目标策略和已知的任务设置作为上下文，无需针对特定任务更新参数即可预测该策略的期望回报。在四个表格型领域（包括一个半合成的临床场景）中开展的实验证明了 InCOPE 在策略价值估计方面的有效性。

title: flodl-bio: First Rust data, transformers and model layer for entire deep learning on biological sequences
zh_title: flodl-bio：面向生物序列深度学习的Rust库
summary: 该预印本介绍基于libtorch的Rust库flodl-bio，提供序列编码、FASTA解析、图构建、评估指标及卷积滤波器motif导出等功能。
key_points: 称为首个面向生物应用的Rust深度学习库
含one-hot与k-mer编码、图构建工具
支持AUROC/AUPRC及MEME motif导出
reason: 工具库，增量档，摘要无性能验证
abstract: Python ecosystem dominates the deep learning framework. flodl-bio is a Rust crate that extends flodl, a libtorch-backed deep-learning framework, with deep learning on biological sequences. To our knowledge, flodl-bio is the first Rust crate that provides a comprehensive and practical deep learning for the biological applications, which includes the alphabet-aware sequence encoding, including one-hot and k-mer representations, padded sequences, and channels-first batches. It also includes several FASTA parsing and graph construction utilities for adjacency matrices, GCN-normalised adjacency matrices, graph Laplacians, residue contact maps, and de Bruijn graphs. Among the added functionalities, it includes AUROC and AUPRC with their associated curves; classification metrics, and the export of learned convolutional filters as MEME motifs and seeded splits. Deep biological learning includes a multi-width motif CNN, a dilated residual CNN, bidirectional LSTM and GRU architectures, and transformer encoder. On the five human transcription-factor-binding datasets in the GUE benchmark, a motif CNN with approximately 10,000 parameters, trained from scratch, outperforms all published CNN baselines. It also superseded the 2.5-billion-parameter Nucleotide Transformer on two datasets and DNABERT-2 on one. Given a fixed hardware configuration and software stack, experiments are reproducible at the bit level. See Supplementary Table S2 of Supplementary Material. flodl-bio is written in Rust and released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/sablokg/flodl-bio. The core builds with stable Rust and has no dependencies. The model tier is enabled with the flodl Cargo feature (cuda for NVIDIA GPUs) and requires libtorch and Rust 1.91 or later. The evaluation harness is in the repository's experiments directory, and the complete run outputs are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23321850
zh_abstract: Python 生态系统在深度学习框架中占据主导地位。flodl-bio 是一个 Rust crate，它在基于 libtorch 的深度学习框架 flodl 之上，扩展了面向生物序列的深度学习功能。据我们所知，flodl-bio 是首个为生物学应用提供全面且实用的深度学习功能的 Rust crate，其包括感知字母表的序列编码（含 one-hot 和 k-mer 表示）、填充序列以及通道优先（channels-first）的批次。它还包括若干 FASTA 解析和图构建工具，可用于邻接矩阵、GCN 归一化邻接矩阵、图拉普拉斯矩阵、残基接触图和 de Bruijn 图。在新增功能中，包含 AUROC 和 AUPRC 及其相应曲线、分类指标，以及将学习到的卷积滤波器导出为 MEME 基序和带种子的数据划分。深度生物学习部分包括多宽度基序 CNN、扩张残差 CNN、双向 LSTM 和 GRU 架构以及 Transformer 编码器。在 GUE 基准的五个人类转录因子结合数据集上，一个约有10,000个参数、从头训练的基序 CNN 优于所有已发表的 CNN 基线；它在两个数据集上还超过了25亿参数的 Nucleotide Transformer，在一个数据集上超过了 DNABERT-2。在固定的硬件配置和软件栈下，实验可在比特级别复现。参见补充材料的补充表 S2。flodl-bio 以 Rust 编写，采用 MIT 许可发布，地址为 https://github.com/sablokg/flodl-bio。核心部分可用稳定版 Rust 构建，且无依赖项。模型层通过 flodl Cargo 特性启用（NVIDIA GPU 使用 cuda），需要 libtorch 和 Rust 1.91 或更高版本。评估工具位于仓库的 experiments 目录中，完整的运行输出已存档于 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23321850

title: Promise and Limits of Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Medical Vision Transformers (LiteMed-ViT)
zh_title: 轻量医学ViT的跨架构知识蒸馏：LiteMed-ViT的前景与局限
summary: 提出0.234M参数的双token ViT，从ResNet18蒸馏，在三个MedMNIST子集上优于三个紧凑CNN基线（预印本）。
key_points: 参数量比ResNet18教师少47.8倍
内存占用仅0.89 MB
含卷积stem与类别均衡蒸馏目标
reason: 仅在小型MedMNIST上评估，无外部验证，增量档
abstract: Running deep models for medical image analysis at the point of care is challenging with standard architectures: convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often too heavy for edge devices, while Vision Transformers (ViTs) require massive training datasets to compensate for missing inductive biases. This study investigates how far the dual-token distillation used to train data-efficient ViTs can be pushed when applied across architectures, from a CNN-based teacher into a lightweight ViT student. LiteMed-ViT is introduced as a dual-token ViT featuring a convolutional stem and a class-balanced distillation objective; at 0.234M parameters, LiteMed-ViT carries 47.8x fewer parameters than its ResNet18 teacher at a memory footprint of just 0.89 MB. Evaluated against three compact CNN baselines on three MedMNIST subsets of varying modality and class balance, LiteMed-ViT attains higher accuracy than all three baselines on BloodMNIST (95.05%) and two on PathMNIST (89.15%). Under MedMNIST-C corruptions, it is at least as robust as every compact CNN across all subsets, outperforming them on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST without declining in relative standing as severity increases. Particular attention is devoted to identifying the exact conditions where performance plateaus. On DermaMNIST, LiteMed-ViT's balanced accuracy remains up to 1.9 points below the strongest compact CNNs and does not benefit from higher input resolutions up to 224 pixels, where ResNet18 gains 12.6 points. Stronger teachers do not yield a more accurate student, and overconfident ones lower its DermaMNIST balanced accuracy unless calibrated.
zh_abstract: 在医疗现场运行用于医学图像分析的深度模型，对标准架构而言颇具挑战：卷积神经网络（CNN）对边缘设备往往过于笨重，而视觉 Transformer（ViT）需要海量训练数据来弥补缺失的归纳偏置。本研究探讨了用于训练数据高效 ViT 的双 token 蒸馏在跨架构应用时（从基于 CNN 的教师模型到轻量级 ViT 学生模型）能推进到何种程度。我们提出 LiteMed-ViT，一种具有卷积主干（stem）和类别均衡蒸馏目标的双 token ViT；其参数量为 0.234M，比其 ResNet18 教师模型少 47.8 倍，内存占用仅 0.89 MB。在三个模态和类别均衡程度各异的 MedMNIST 子集上与三种紧凑型 CNN 基线比较，LiteMed-ViT 在 BloodMNIST（95.05%）上的准确率高于全部三个基线，在 PathMNIST（89.15%）上高于其中两个。在 MedMNIST-C 损坏条件下，它在所有子集上的鲁棒性至少与每个紧凑型 CNN 相当，在 BloodMNIST 和 PathMNIST 上优于它们，且随着严重程度增加，其相对地位并未下降。我们特别关注确定性能出现平台期的具体条件。在 DermaMNIST 上，LiteMed-ViT 的平衡准确率仍比最强的紧凑型 CNN 低最多 1.9 个点，且在输入分辨率提高至 224 像素时并未获益，而 ResNet18 则提升了 12.6 个点。更强的教师模型并不会产生更准确的学生模型，而过度自信的教师模型会降低其在 DermaMNIST 上的平衡准确率，除非加以校准。

title: Exploring Artificial Intelligence-Generated Feedback for Pharmacy Students.
zh_title: 药学学生对AI生成反馈的探索性研究
summary: 对148名药学二年级学生的试点调查，评估AI助手依据评分标准生成的作业反馈在质量与学习影响上的感受。
key_points: 148名学生使用AI助手对草稿作业给出反馈
问卷评估反馈与评分标准的一致性、准确性、清晰度和语气
为单课程试点，主要为学生主观感知
reason: 单课程试点、主观问卷，属增量档
abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into educational environments is accelerating, with growing interest in its potential to enhance learning outcomes. This pilot study aimed to assess student perceptions regarding the quality and educational impact of AI-generated feedback. Second-professional-year pharmacy students (n = 148) enrolled in a drug literature evaluation course received AI-generated feedback for a draft assignment which required students to critically evaluate a recently published journal article. Feedback was generated by an AI assistant that offered iterative feedback based on the assignment rubric. After the activity, students completed an electronic survey instrument evaluating the AI feedback regarding its alignment with rubric criteria, accuracy, clarity, and tone. Student perceptions of the feedback's impact on learning were also assessed. A total of 148 students (100%) completed the activity and responded to at least one item of the survey tool. Most students agreed with the AI-generated feedback for each section of the assignment in regard to clarity (61.5% to 76.2%) and tone (66.9% to 74.3%), with lower agreement related to alignment with the rubric (33.8% to 60.4%) and accuracy (34.5% to 54.2%). Students also expressed concern about the reliability of AI feedback (71.2%) and risk for plagiarism (50%). AI-generated feedback was positively received in some areas. However, students expressed apprehension regarding its accuracy, reliability, and potential accusation of plagiarism. These findings suggest further refinement is necessary to enhance AI trustworthiness and educational value in academic settings.
zh_abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）正加速融入教育环境，人们对其提升学习成效的潜力兴趣日增。本试点研究旨在评估学生对 AI 生成反馈的质量及其教育影响的看法。修读药物文献评价课程的药学专业二年级学生（n = 148）对一份作业草稿获得了 AI 生成的反馈，该作业要求学生对一篇新近发表的期刊文章进行批判性评价。反馈由一个 AI 助手生成，该助手依据作业评分标准提供迭代式反馈。活动结束后，学生填写电子问卷，从与评分标准的契合度、准确性、清晰度和语气等方面评价 AI 反馈，同时也评估了学生对该反馈对学习影响的看法。共有 148 名学生（100%）完成了活动，并至少回答了问卷中的一个条目。对于作业的每个部分，多数学生认同 AI 生成反馈的清晰度（61.5% 至 76.2%）和语气（66.9% 至 74.3%），而对与评分标准的契合度（33.8% 至 60.4%）和准确性（34.5% 至 54.2%）的认同度较低。学生还对 AI 反馈的可靠性（71.2%）和抄袭风险（50%）表示担忧。AI 生成的反馈在某些方面获得了积极评价。然而，学生对其准确性、可靠性以及可能被指控抄袭表示忧虑。这些发现提示，需要进一步改进，以提高 AI 在学术环境中的可信度和教育价值。

abstract: Type 2 diabetes is a widespread chronic disease that requires early and accurate diagnosis to prevent serious complications. Traditional diagnostic methods often lack sufficient accuracy, which highlights the need for more reliable computational solutions. In this study, we propose a model that integrates the Random Forest classifier with the Bat Optimization Algorithm for simultaneous feature selection and hyperparameter tuning. The SMOTE-ENN method was first applied to the Pima Indians Diabetes Database to correct class imbalance and remove noisy or ambiguous samples, producing a more balanced and cleaner dataset. The optimized model trained on this refined dataset achieved 89% accuracy, 88% precision, 90% recall, and an F1-score of 89%, clearly outperforming the baseline Random Forest and other existing approaches. These results demonstrate the potential of combining evolutionary algorithms with ensemble learning to provide a practical and cost-effective tool for early detection of type 2 diabetes in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 2型糖尿病是一种广泛存在的慢性疾病，需要早期且准确的诊断以预防严重并发症。传统诊断方法往往缺乏足够的准确性，这凸显了对更可靠计算方案的需求。在本研究中，我们提出了一种模型，将随机森林（Random Forest）分类器与蝙蝠优化算法（Bat Optimization Algorithm）相结合，同时进行特征选择和超参数调优。首先对皮马印第安人糖尿病数据库（Pima Indians Diabetes Database）应用SMOTE-ENN方法，以纠正类别不平衡并去除噪声或含糊的样本，从而得到更均衡、更干净的数据集。在该精炼数据集上训练的优化模型取得了89%的准确率、88%的精确率、90%的召回率和89%的F1分数，明显优于基线随机森林及其他现有方法。这些结果表明，将进化算法与集成学习相结合，有潜力为临床实践中2型糖尿病的早期检测提供一种实用且经济有效的工具。
